Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of Max Health or lower.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Initiate World Transformation</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Removes all <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> from all enemies and deals heavy damage. This attack ignores the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color>.
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【世界変容の始まり】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。

若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。狂暴化效果持续3回合。

解除全体敌人的所有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，并造成巨额伤害。该攻击无视目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>。
China_Traditional:
若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果。狂暴化持續3回合。

English: Attacks all enemies. Increases damage dealt when there is no Healer enemy.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。回復型の敵が戦場にいない場合、ダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。若不存在恢复型敌人，则伤害提升。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。若沒有恢復型敵人，傷害增加。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 획득합니다.\n대상의 수가 적을수록 피해가 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_3] turn(s)</color>.\nDamage dealt increases inversely proportional to the number of targets.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、自分に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n対象が少ないほどダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_3]回合</color>。\n目标数量越少，则该技能的伤害越高。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_3]回合</color>內獲得<color=#28d9ed>護盾</color>。\n目標數量越少，傷害越大。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>전열</color>의 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>속도형</color>이 아닌 적 공격 시 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_02_1_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy.\nPrioritizes enemies in the <color=#28d9ed>front line</color>. When attacking a non-<color=#28d9ed>Ranger</color> enemies, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_02_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n<color=#28d9ed>前衛</color>の敵を優先的に攻撃する。<color=#28d9ed>スピード型</color>以外の敵を攻撃時、対象に<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_02_1_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n优先攻击<color=#28d9ed>前排</color>敌人。非<color=#28d9ed>速度型</color>敌人攻击时，对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_02_1_1]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n優先攻擊<color=#28d9ed>前排</color>的敵人。非<color=#28d9ed>速度型</color>敵人攻擊時，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_02_1_1]回合</color>內賦予目標<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_5]턴</color> 동안 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>반격</color>합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. <color=#28d9ed>Counterattacks</color> when hit for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_5] turn(s)</color> after attacking.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_5]ターン</color>の間、1度でもダメージを受けた場合、<color=#28d9ed>反撃</color>する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，在受到伤害时发动<color=#28d9ed>反击</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_5]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_5]回合</color>內受擊時\n<color=#28d9ed>反擊</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_6]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>가 증가합니다.\n대상의 수가 적을수록 피해가 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_6] turn(s)</color>.\nDamage dealt increases inversely proportional to the number of targets.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_6]ターン</color>の間UPする。\n対象が少ないほどダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_6]回合</color>。\n目标数量越少，则该技能的伤害越高。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_6]回合</color>內<color=#28d9ed>暴擊傷害</color>增加。\n目標數量越少，傷害越大。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n수속성 적에게 입히는 피해가 감소하고, 받는 피해가 증가합니다. 수속성이 아닌 적의 효과 적중과 효과 저항이 감소합니다.\n속도형 적에게 받는 피해가 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces damage dealt to Water enemies, and increases damage taken from them. Reduces Effectiveness and Resilience of non-Water enemies.\nIncreases damage taken from Ranger enemies.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n水属性の敵に与えるダメージがDOWNし、受けるダメージがUPする。水属性以外の敵の効果命中・抵抗をDOWNさせる。\nスピード型の敵から受けるダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n对水属性敌人造成的伤害降低，且所受伤害提升。非水属性敌人的效果命中和效果抵抗降低。\n受到来自速度型敌人的伤害提升。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n對水屬性敵人造成的傷害減少，受到的傷害增加。非水屬性敵人的效果命中和效果抵抗減少。\n速度型敵人造成的傷害增加。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 종료 시 적의 <color=#28d9ed>CP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>12</color> 감소시킵니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces the enemy's <color=#28d9ed>Chain Points</color> by <color=#28d9ed>12</color> at the end of the turn.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン終了時、敵の<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>12</color>DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n回合结束时，使敌人<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>12</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n回合結束時，使敵人的<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>12</color>。

Korean: 적이 8회 행동할 때마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여 후 가디언 캐논을 사용합니다.
English: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every time the enemy performs 8 actions, and grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns, then activates Guardian Cannon.
Japanese: 敵が8回行動するたびに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間継続する。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】と【必殺スキル】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与した後、【ガーディアンキャノン】を使用する。
China_Simplified: 敌人每行动8次，便转化为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合后，使用守护者加农炮。
China_Traditional: 每當敵人行動8次時，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，並在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化與必殺技</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果後，使用守護者加農炮。

China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n對水屬性敵人造成的傷害減少，受到的傷害增加。非水屬性敵人的效果命中和效果抵抗減少。\n速度型敵人造成的傷害增加。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 종료 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_7]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 각각 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_guild_raid_sub_02_7]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 감소시킵니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nHas a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_guild_raid_sub_02_7]</color> chance each to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_7] turn(s)</color> at the end of the turn.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン終了時、敵全体にそれぞれ<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_guild_raid_sub_02_7]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_7]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n回合结束时，各有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_guild_raid_sub_02_7]</color>的几率使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_7]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n回合結束時，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_sub_02_7]回合</color>內使全體敵人各以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_guild_raid_sub_02_7]</color>的機率<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>減少。

English: Enduring Rage
Japanese: 収まらない憤り
China_Simplified: 无法熄灭的愤怒
China_Traditional: 怒氣難消

Korean:
속성 보정에 따른 피해 증감량이 크게 강화됩니다. 
유리한 속성에게 입히는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가하며, 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다. 불리한 속성에게는 입히는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 감소하며 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가합니다.
화속성 및 수속성인 적의 효과 적중과 효과 저항이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_guild_raid_debuff_fire_1]</color> 감소합니다.
마법형 및 속도형 적에게 받는 피해가 증가하지만, 공격형 적에게 받는 피해가 감소합니다.
English:
Greatly increases the damage bonus and damage reduction of elemental modifiers.
Increases damage dealt to enemies with an elemental disadvantage by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> and reduces damage taken from them by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>. Reduces damage dealt to enemies with an elemental advantage by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> and increases damage received from them by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.
Reduces Effectiveness and Resilience of Fire and Water enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_guild_raid_debuff_fire_1]</color>.
Increases damage received from Mage and Ranger enemies but reduces damage received from Striker enemies.
Japanese:
属性補正によるダメージUP・DOWN量が大幅に強化される。
有利属性に与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>UPし、受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNする。不利属性には与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>DOWNし、受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>UPする。
火・水属性の敵の効果命中・抵抗が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_guild_raid_debuff_fire_1]</color>DOWNする。
魔法型およびスピード型の敵から受けるダメージがUPし、攻撃型の敵から受けるダメージがDOWNする。
China_Simplified:
属性相克所造成的伤害增减量将大幅提升。
使优势属性造成的伤害量提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，且所受伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>；使劣势属性造成的伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>，且所受伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
使火属性和水属性敌人的效果命中和效果抵抗降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_guild_raid_debuff_fire_1]</color>。
受到来自魔法型和速度型敌人的伤害提升，来自攻击型敌人的伤害降低。
China_Traditional:
大幅強化根據屬性修正的傷害增減量。
對有利屬性造成的傷害量增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，受到的傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。對不利屬性造成的傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>，受到的傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
火屬性及水屬性敵人的效果命中及效果抵抗減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_guild_raid_debuff_fire_1]</color>。
雖然魔法型及速度型敵人造成的傷害增加，但攻擊型敵人造成的傷害會減少。

Korean: 계약자를 위하여
English: For the Core
Japanese: 契約者のために
China_Simplified: 为了契约者
China_Traditional: 為了締約者

Korean: 속성 보정에 따른 피해 증감량이 크게 강화됩니다. \n유리한 속성에게 입히는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가하며, 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다. 불리한 속성에게는 입히는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 감소하며 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가합니다.\n속도가 0으로 고정됩니다.
English: Greatly increases the damage bonus and damage reduction of elemental modifiers. \nIncreases damage dealt to enemies with an elemental disadvantage by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> and reduces damage taken from them by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>. Reduces damage dealt to enemies with an elemental advantage by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> and increases damage received from them by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.\nSpeed is fixed at 0.
Japanese: 属性補正によるダメージ増減量が大幅に強化される。\n有利属性に与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>UPし、受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNする。不利属性には与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>DOWNし、受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>UPする。\nスピードが0に固定される。

(패시브 효과)
전투 시작 시 적 팀 4명이 모두 동일 속성이라면 받는 피해량이 증가합니다. (영구 지속)
<color=#28d9ed>방어력</color> 증가 효과를 보유하고 있으면 받는 피해량이 크게 감소합니다.
약화 효과 피격 시 마다 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_03_1_5_3]턴</color> 증가 합니다.

(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, when all four enemy team members have same elements, increases damage taken. (Permanent)
When granted increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> effect, greatly reduces damage taken.
Every time inflicted with a debuff, grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_03_1_5_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時､敵全体がすべて同じ属性の場合、受けるダメージがUPする。(永続効果)
<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>がUP状態の場合、受けるダメージが大幅にDOWNする。
弱体効果を付与された時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_03_1_5_3]ターン</color>UPさせる。

(被动效果)
战斗开始时，若敌人队伍4名人员全部为相同属性，则所受伤害量提升。(永久持续)
若附带<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升效果，则所受伤害量大幅降
低。
每当受到弱化效果攻击时，自身<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_guild_raid_03_1_5_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional:
被動效果)
戰鬥開始時，若敵人隊伍4名均為同一屬性，受到的傷害量增加。(永久持續)
若具有<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>增加效果，受到的傷害量大幅減

Korean:
5턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 모두 해제한 후 공격합니다. 이 공격은 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 무시합니다.
광폭화 할 때마다 피해량이 증가합니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 5 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Removes all <color=#28d9ed>Buffs</color> from all enemies then attacks. This attack ignores the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.
Increases damage dealt every time the caster becomes Enraged.

5ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】と【必殺スキル】</color>：敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>をすべて解除した後ダメージを与える。この攻撃は対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を無視する。
【狂暴化】状態になるたびに、ダメージがUPする。

每5回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：解除全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>后发动攻击。该攻击无视目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。
每次陷入狂暴化时，伤害量提升。

每5回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化與必殺技</color>：解除全體敵人的所有<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>後發動攻擊。此攻擊無視目標的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>。
每當狂暴化時，傷害量增加。

Korean:
체력이 <color=#28d9ed>50000</color> 감소할 때마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>서스페리아</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체에게 큰 피해를 입힙니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> each time Health is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>50,000</color>.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Suspiria</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Deals heavy damage to all enemies.
Japanese:
HPが<color=#28d9ed>50,000</color>DOWNするたびに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間継続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【サスペリア】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に使用する。
敵全体に大ダメージを与える。
China_Simplified:
生命值每降低<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>，则进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。狂暴化持续3回
合。

<color=#28d9ed>阴风阵阵</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
对全体敌人造成巨额伤害。
China_Traditional:
每當生命力減少<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>時，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>窒息</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
對全體敵人造成極大傷害。

Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

属性補正によるダメージUP・DOWN量が大幅に強化される。

大地屬性及火屬性敵人的效果命中和效果抵抗大幅減少，因夾攻受到的傷害增加。

每回合結束時，獲得與攻擊力成等比的護盾。

Korean:
속성 보정에 따른 피해 증감량이 크게 강화됩니다. 
유리한 속성에게 입히는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가하며, 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다. 불리한 속성에게는 입히는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 감소하며 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가합니다.
사망에 이르는 피해를 입으면, 즉시 <color=#28d9ed>부활</color>하고, 전체 공격으로 받는 피해 및 회복형 캐릭터의 공격으로 받는 피해를 무효화합니다.

사망 시 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>, <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>, <color=#28d9ed>피해량</color>이 증가합니다.
English:
Greatly increases the damage bonus and damage reduction of elemental modifiers.
Increases damage dealt to enemies with an elemental disadvantage by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> and reduces damage taken from them by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>. Reduces damage dealt to enemies with an elemental advantage by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> and increases damage taken from them by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.
Upon taking fatal damage, is <color=#28d9ed>Resurrected</color> immediately and nullifies damage from attacks that target all enemies and attacks from Healer characters.

Upon death, increases the <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>, and <color=#28d9ed>damage</color> of all enemies.
Japanese:
属性補正によるダメージ増減量が大幅に強化される。
有利属性に与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>UPし、受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNする。不利属性には与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>DOWNし、受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>UPする。
戦闘不能に至るダメージを受けた場合、直ちに<color=#28d9ed>復活</color>し、全体攻撃で受けるダメージと回復型の敵から受けるダメージを無効化する。

倒れた時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>ダメージ</color>がUPする。
China_Simplified:
属性相克所造成的伤害增减量将大幅提升。
使优势属性造成的伤害量提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，且所受伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>；使劣势属性造成的伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>，且所受伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
若受到致死伤害，则立即<color=#28d9ed>复活</color>，并使全体攻击和恢复型角色攻击造成的伤害无效。

死亡时，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>伤害量</color>提升。
China_Traditional:
大幅強化根據屬性修正的傷害增減量。
對有利屬性造成的傷害量增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，受到的傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。對不利屬性造成的傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>，受到的傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
受到致命傷害時，立即<color=#28d9ed>復活</color>，並將全體攻擊所造成的傷害及恢復型角色攻擊造成的傷害無效化。

死亡時，全體敵人隊伍的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>傷害量</color>增加。

(Passive Effect)
Increases Counterattack Chance by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.
Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4004003_11_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> on all enemies at the start of each turn.

<color=#ffd732>Inflicts Petrified on all enemies for [Buff_T_4004003_15_1] turn(s) when inflicted with Break, then stops taking Weakness Gauge damage.</color>

(パッシブ効果)

ターン開始時、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4004003_11_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を付与する。

<color=#ffd732>ブレイク時、敵全体に石化を[Buff_T_4004003_15_1]ターンの間付与し、WGダメージを受けない。</color>

(被动效果)
使反击率提升<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。
每回合开始时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4004003_11_2]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>效果。

<color=#ffd732>力竭时，使全体敌人陷入石化状态，持续[Buff_T_4004003_15_1]回合，此后不会受到WG伤害。</color>

(被動效果)
反擊率增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

매 턴 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_8]</color> 증가하지만, <color=#28d9ed>브레이크</color> 시 초기화됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>브레이크 시 더 큰 피해를 받습니다.</color>
English:
(Passive Effect)
Reduces damage taken from skills other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, and Skill Chains by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_1]</color>, and reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_2]</color> when not <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>.
Reduces Critical Hit Damage of all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.

Increases <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_8]</color> each turn. This effect is reset when the caster is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Break</color>.

<color=#28d9ed>Increases damage taken when inflicted with Break.</color>

(パッシブ効果)

敵全体の会心ダメージを<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNさせる。

毎ターン<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_8]</color>UPし、<color=#28d9ed>ブレイク</color>すると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>ブレイク状態の場合</color>、通常のブレイク時より受けるダメージがUPする。

(被动效果)
使受到除爆发技能、夹攻、连携技能外的技能伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_1]</color>，若未处于<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，则使受到的WG伤害量降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_2]</color>。

(被動效果)

使全體敵人的暴擊傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

雖然每回合<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4004003_12_8]</color>，但<color=#28d9ed>休息</color>時將重置。

<color=#28d9ed>休息時會受到更大的傷害。</color>

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고, WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>미래를 예지했어요.</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
지금까지 경험한 시간을 되돌려, 가장 유리한 시간대로 회귀하고, 적에게 회복 불가를 부여합니다.

<color=#ffd732>3턴 안에 광폭화할 시 80의 CP를 회복시킵니다.</color>
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower. Increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Recovers [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2] Weakness Gauge. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>I Foresaw the Future</color>: Used when Enraged ends. Reverses the flow of time and returns to the most advantageous time period, inflicting Unhealable on enemies. 

<color=#ffd732>If Enraged within 3 turns or fewer, grants 80 Chain Points.</color>
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>UPする。この効果はブレイクすると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【未来を予知しました】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
ステラが時間を巻き戻し、HPを全回復し、スキルターンを初期化し、すべての弱体効果を解除する。敵に<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を付与する。

<color=#ffd732>戦闘開始時から3ターン以内に【狂暴化】した場合、敵にCPを80獲得させる。</color>
China_Simplified:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。该效果将持续至进入力竭状态为止。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>预见未来</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
将时间回溯至战局最有利的时刻。

<color=#ffd732>在3回合内陷入狂暴化状态时，使CP恢复80。</color>
China_Traditional:
若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，且攻擊力及速度增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。此效果持續至進入休息前為止。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>預見未來</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
回溯至今所經歷過的時間，回到最有利的時段，賦予敵人無法恢復。

<color=#ffd732>3回合內進入狂暴化時，恢復80的CP。</color>

China_Traditional: 敵人造成的傷害雖然減少，但敵人造成的傷害會隨所具有的強化效果數量增加而提升。\n對未具有強化效果的敵人造成的傷害大幅增加。\n不會受到未具有強化效果之敵人的WG傷害。

Korean:
4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제 불가능한 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>월야의 녹턴</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체에게 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Moonlit Nocturne</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Deals lethal damage to all enemies.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与する。狂暴化は3ターンの間継続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【月夜のノクターン】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体に致命的なダメージを与える。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>月夜的夜曲</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
对全体敌人造成致命伤害。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身無法被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>月夜曲</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
對全體敵人造成致命傷害。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_1_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_1_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_1_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_1_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_1_1]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_1_1]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_1_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_1_1]回合</color>內賦予目標<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>。

Korean: (발동 효과) 공격 당할 시 적 전체에게 반격합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_200005299_2_3]</color> 증가하고, 각각 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_2_2]</color> 확률로 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 2개 부여합니다.\n반격은 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color>에 한 번만 발동합니다.
English: (Triggered Effect) Counterattacks all enemies when attacked.\nIncreases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_200005299_2_3]</color>, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_2_2]</color> chance each to inflict 2 <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> effects on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_2_2] turn(s)</color>.\nThe counterattack effect is only activated once every <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
Japanese: (発動効果)攻撃を受けた場合､敵全体に反撃する。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_200005299_2_3]</color>UPし、敵全体にそれぞれ<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_2_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>2個を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n反撃は<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>に1回発動する。
China_Simplified: (触发效果)受到攻击时，对全体敌人发动反击。\n自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_200005299_2_3]</color>，并各有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_2_2]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成2个<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_2_2]回合</color>。\n反击<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>仅能发动1次。
China_Traditional: (發動效果)受到攻擊時，對全體敵人發動反擊。\n自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_200005299_2_3]</color>，各以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_200005299_2_2]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_2_2]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人2個<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>。\n反擊<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>只會發動一次。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color> 상태라면 피해량이 증가하고, 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color>시킵니다.\n공격 후 시그마는 취약상태가 되어, 적 전체의 필살기의 피해량이<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_3_2]턴</color> 동안 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nIf the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color>, damage dealt increases, and <color=#28d9ed>detonates</color> all <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> stacks on the target after attacking.\nSigma becomes Vulnerable after attacking, and all enemies' Ultimate Skill damage increases for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_3_2] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>状態の場合ダメージがUPする。攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>をすべて<color=#28d9ed>破裂</color>させる。\nこの攻撃後、【シグマ】は【脆弱状態】となり、必殺スキルで受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_3_2]ターン</color>の間UPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>状态，则使伤害量提升，攻击后使所有<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果<color=#28d9ed>爆炸</color>。\n攻击后西格玛会进入衰弱状态，使全体敌人的必杀技伤害量提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_3_2]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>狀態，傷害量增加，攻擊後使所有<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>全部<color=#28d9ed>引爆</color>。\n攻擊後，西格瑪會進入微弱狀態，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_3_2]回合</color>內全體敵人的必殺技傷害量增加。

Korean: (발동 효과) 자신이 공격받았을 때 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>시그마 캐논</color>을 사용하여 반격합니다.
English: (Triggered Effect) When attacked, has a <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> chance to Counterattack with <color=#28d9ed>Sigma Cannon</color>.
Japanese: (発動効果)自分が攻撃を受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>【シグマキャノン】</color>を発動して反撃する。
China_Simplified: (触发效果)自身受到攻击时，有<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>的几率用<color=#28d9ed>西格玛加农炮</color>进行反击。
China_Traditional: (發動效果)自身受到攻擊時，以<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>的機率使用<color=#28d9ed>西格瑪加農炮</color>來反擊。

English: Attacks an enemy. After attacking, grants self <color=#28d9ed>ATK Up</color> and <color=#28d9ed>SPD Up</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500265_1_1] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵を攻撃。攻撃後、自分に<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力UP</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピードUP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500265_1_1]ターン</color>の間付与。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。攻击后，自身获得<color=#28d9ed>攻击力提升</color>与<color=#28d9ed>速度提升</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500265_1_1]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。攻擊後，自身獲得<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力提升</color>與<color=#28d9ed>速度提升</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500265_1_1]回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>스킬 쿨타임</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, increases all enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Skill Cooldown</color> by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体を攻撃。攻撃後、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>増加。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>技能冷却</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>技能冷卻</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 자신이 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있을 경우, 자신에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>방어력 증가</color> 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. If the caster has a <color=#28d9ed>Buff</color>, grants an undispellable <color=#28d9ed>Defense Up</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体を攻撃。自分が<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を持つ場合、解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>防御力UP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。若自身拥有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，则赋予自身不可驱散的<color=#28d9ed>防御力提升</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。若自身擁有<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>，則賦予自身不可驅散的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力提升</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

Korean: <color=#28d9ed>방어형</color>에게 받는 피해가 증가합니다.\n적 전체를 공격할 경우, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 증가합니다.
English: Takes increased damage from <color=#28d9ed>Defense-type</color> enemies.\nWhen attacking all enemies, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color>.
Japanese: <color=#28d9ed>防御型</color>から受けるダメージが増加。\n敵全体を攻撃した場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が増加。
China_Simplified:
受到来自<color=#28d9ed>防御型</color>敌人的伤害增加。
当攻击所有敌人时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加。
China_Traditional:
受到來自<color=#28d9ed>防禦型</color>敵人的傷害增加。
當攻擊所有敵人時，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加。

Korean: 턴 시작 시 자신에게 걸려 있는 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 모두 해제합니다.\n자신이 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있을 경우, 적에게 입히는 피해량이 증가합니다.
English: When the turn starts, remove all <color=#28d9ed>Debuffs</color> from the caster. \nIf the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Buffs</color>, increase the damage dealth to the enemy.
Japanese: ターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>をすべて解除する。\n自分に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がある場合、 敵に与えるダメージが大幅にUPする。
China_Simplified: 回合开始时，解除自身附带的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。\n或泰格里尔附带<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>时，敌人造成的伤害大幅提升。
China_Traditional: 回合開始時，解除自己身上的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。\n或泰格里爾具有<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>時，敵人造成的傷害大幅增加。

Korean:
<color=#28d9ed>4턴</color> 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 치명 확률 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG의 30%를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> : 단일 공격 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>해골 가르기</color>를 발동합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 필살기</color> : 광폭화가 종료될 시 사용합니다.
적 전체를 공격합니다.
English:
Switches to <color=#28d9ed>Enrage</color> state every <color=#28d9ed>4 turns</color>. 

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Entry</color>: Grants self an unremovable Critical Chance Increase and DMG Reduction effect for 3 turns and recovers 30% of WG. Enrage lasts for 3 turns. 

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage</color>: When hit by a single-target attack, activates <color=#28d9ed>Skull Splitter</color>. 

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Ultimate</color>: Activates when Enrage ends. Attacks all enemies.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n<color=#28d9ed>命中</color>がDOWNした敵に、与えるダメージが大幅にUPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n对<color=#28d9ed>命中</color>降低的
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n對<color=#28d9ed>命中</color>減少的敵人造成的傷害大幅增加。

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> : 적 전체를 공격 후, 대상 모두에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_14_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 2개 부여합니다. 이후 영구적으로 WG 피해를 받지 않고, <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>/<color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 증가하고 <color=#28d9ed>받는 피해</color>가 감소합니다. 화상을 제외한 효과들은 해제되지 않습니다.

<color=#ffd732>3턴 안에 광폭화할 시 80의 CP를 회복시킵니다.</color>
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Attacks all enemies, then inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> twice on each target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_14_3] turn(s)</color>. Permanently stops taking Weakness Gauge damage, increases <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color>, and reduces <color=#28d9ed>damage taken</color>. Aside from Burned, the aforementioned effects are irremovable.

<color=#ffd732>If Enraged within 3 turns or fewer, grants 80 Chain Points.</color>
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、対象全体に<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を2個<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_14_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。その後WGダメージを受けなくなり、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>がUPし、<color=#28d9ed>受けるダメージ</color>がDOWNする。火傷以外の効果は解除されない。

<color=#ffd732>3ターン以内に【狂暴化】した場合、敵にCPを80獲得させる。</color>
China_Simplified:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>：攻击全体敌人后，对所有目标造成2个<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_14_3]回合</color>。此后永久不受WG伤害，且<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>/<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升，<color=#28d9ed>所受伤害</color>降低。除烧伤外的效果不会被解除。

<color=#ffd732>在3回合内陷入狂暴化时，使CP恢复80。</color>
China_Traditional:
若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>：攻擊全體敵人後，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_200005299_14_3]回合</color>內賦予全體目標2個<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>。之後永久不會受到WG傷害，<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>/<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>增加，且<color=#28d9ed>受到的傷害</color>減少。除了燒傷以外的效果不會被解除。

<color=#ffd732>3回合內進入狂暴化時，恢復80的CP。</color>

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_14]턴</color> 동안 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 감소시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_14] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_14]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使目标<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_14]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_14]回合</color>內使目標的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>減少。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다. 이 공격은 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 보유한 대상의 방어력을 모두 무시합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy. When the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color>, this attack completely ignores the target's Defense.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\nこの攻撃は<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>状態の敵の防御力をすべて無視する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。该攻击无视附带<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>目标的所有防御力。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。此攻擊無視所有具有<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>的目標的防禦力。

Korean: 적이 공격이 아닌 스킬 사용 시 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 감소시킵니다.\n치명타가 아닌 공격 피격 시 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_17]</color> 회복합니다.
English: When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, reduces the duration of <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> on all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.\nWhen hit by a non-critical hit, recovers Weakness Gauge by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_17]</color>.
Japanese: 敵が攻撃以外のスキルを使用時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>DOWNさせる。\nダメージを受け、そのダメージに会心が発生しなかった場合、WGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_17]</color>回復する。
China_Simplified: 敌人使用非攻击技能时，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>减少<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。\n受到非暴击攻击时，WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_17]</color>。
China_Traditional: 敵人使用非攻擊的技能時，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。\n受到非暴擊的攻擊時，WG恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_17]</color>。

4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제 불가능한 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

적 전체에게 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Furious Lands</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Deals lethal damage to all enemies.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与する。狂暴化は3ターンの間継続する。

敵全体に致命的なダメージを与える。

每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>激昂大地</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。

China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>激昂的大地</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 적의 <color=#28d9ed>CP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>30</color> 감소시킵니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and reduces the enemy's <color=#28d9ed>Chain Points</color> by <color=#28d9ed>30</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.

China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，使敵人的<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>30</color>。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_20]턴</color> 동안 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다.

After attacking, removes <color=#28d9ed>all</color> <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> from the target, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_22] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.

China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，并造成<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_22]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，解除目標的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color><color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>，並在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_22]回合</color>內賦予<color=#28d9ed>無法強化</color>。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

English: Reduces damage taken from enemies, but takes greater damage upon being inflicted with Break.\nIncreases Weakness Gauge damage taken by Dual Attacks and Skill Chains by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_24]</color>.
Japanese: 敵から受けるダメージがDOWNするが、ブレイク状態の場合、より大ダメージを受ける。\n連携とチェーンスキルで受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_24]</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: 来自敌人的伤害降低，但力竭时将承受更高伤害。\n因夹攻和连携技能而受到的WG伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_24]</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>The Price of a Wrong Answer</color>: Used when Enraged ends.

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n가장 <color=#28d9ed>좌측</color>에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격하며 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>방어형</color>이 아닐 경우 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_25_1]턴</color> 동안  <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy.\nThis attack prioritizes the <color=#28d9ed>leftmost</color> enemy, and if the target is a non-<color=#28d9ed>Defender</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_25_1] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n一番<color=#28d9ed>左側</color>にいる敵を優先的に攻撃し、対象が<color=#28d9ed>防御型</color>でない場合、<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_25_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n优先攻击最<color=#28d9ed>左侧</color>的敌人，若目标非<color=#28d9ed>防御型</color>，则对其造成<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_25_1]回合</color>。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
적 처치 시 자신의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_29]</color> 증가시킵니다.

(발동 효과)
적이 공격이 아닌 스킬 사용 시 약한 피해를 입히지만, <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 보유한 대상에게는 큰 피해를 입힙니다. 공격 후 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 모두 해제시킵니다
English:
(Passive Effect)
When defeating an enemy, increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_29]</color>.

(Triggered Effect)
When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, deals minor damage, but deals heavy damage to targets inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color>. After attacking, removes all <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> from the target.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
敵を倒した時、自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_29]</color>UPさせる。

(発動効果)
敵が攻撃以外のスキルを使用時、小さなダメージを与えるが、<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>状態の対象には大ダメージを与える。攻撃後、対象の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>をすべて解除する。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
击杀敌人时，使自身行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_29]</color>。

(触发效果)
敌人使用非攻击类技能时造成较低伤害，但对附带<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>效果的目标造成巨额伤害。攻击后，解除目标附带的所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
消滅敵人時，使自身的速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_new_guild_raid_29]</color>。

(發動效果)
敵人使用非攻擊的技能時，雖然造成的傷害較弱，但對具有<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>的目標會造成較大的傷害。攻擊後，使目標的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>全部解除。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_30]턴</color>동안 마법형 적에게 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 부여합니다. 마법형 적이 없다면 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_32]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>도발</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> on Mage enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_30] turn(s)</color>. When there is no Mage enemy, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Taunted</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_32] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、魔法型の敵に<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_30]ターン</color>の間付与する。魔法型の敵が戦場にいない場合、敵全体を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_new_guild_raid_32]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>挑発</color>する。

최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#ffd732>3턴 안에 광폭화할 시 60의 CP를 회복시킵니다.</color>
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower, and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns and recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Attack of the Void</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies. Reduces the target's Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_403400301_12_1]</color> and inflicts Burned for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_403400301_12_2] turn(s)</color>.
This attack ignores the target's <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color>.

<color=#ffd732>If Enraged within 3 turns, grants 60 Chain Points.</color>
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>UPする。この効果はブレイクすると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWNを3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【ヴォイドアタック】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与える。対象の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_403400301_12_1]</color>DOWNさせ、火傷を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_403400301_12_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
この攻撃は対象の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を無視する。

<color=#ffd732>戦闘開始時から3ターン以内に【狂暴化】した場合、敵にCPを60獲得させる。</color>

若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。该效果将持续至进入力竭状态为止。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>虚空入侵</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。

该攻击无视目标的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>。

<color=#ffd732>在3回合内陷入狂暴化状态时，使CP恢复60。</color>

若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，且攻擊力及速度增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。此效果持續至進入休息前為止。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復 [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>空虛襲擊</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人。使目標的速攻值減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_403400301_12_1]</color>，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_403400301_12_2]回合</color>內賦予燒傷。
此攻擊無視目標的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>。

<color=#ffd732>3回合內進入狂暴化時，恢復60的CP。</color>

4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターン間持続する。

Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態の対象に与えるダメージがUPする。\n対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4004008_2_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。

English: Attacks an enemy.\nThis skill's damage increased proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>missing Health</color> and against targets with an active <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color>.\nGains an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color> when defeating an enemy.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\nこのスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>残りHP</color>が低いほどダメージがUPし、対象が<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。\n敵を倒した時、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n自身的<color=#28d9ed>当前生命值</color>越低，则该技能的伤害越高，且目标附带<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果时，伤害提升。\n击杀敌人时，获得<color=#28d9ed>额外回合</color>。

Korean: 결투자의 맹세
English: Duelist's Pledge
Japanese: 決闘者の誓い
China_Simplified: 决斗者的誓言
China_Traditional: 決鬥者的誓言

Korean:
공격팀의 턴 횟수에 따라 쿨타임이 감소하며, 쿨타임이 0이 될 경우 모든 생존자 전체에게 최대 HP의 <color=#28d9ed>{0}%</color>의 피해를 입히고 받는 회복량을 <color=#28d9ed>{1}%</color> 감소시킵니다.

피해량과 회복량 감소치는 결투자의 맹세가 발동할 때마다 증가합니다.(피해량 3%씩 증가 / 회복량 25%씩 감소)

결투장 전투에서는 부활 시 행동 게이지 회복이 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 감소합니다.
English:
Reduces the cooldown based on the attacking team’s turn count. When the cooldown reaches 0, deals damage equal to <color=#28d9ed>{0}%</color> of Max Health to all survivors and reduces healing received by <color=#28d9ed>{1}%</color>.

The damage and healing reduction increase each time Duelist’s Pledge is activated. (Damage increases by 3% / healing received decreases by 25%.)

In Arena battles, Priority recovery upon resurrection is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.
Japanese:
攻撃側のターン数に応じてスキルターンが減少し、スキルターンが0になると、生存している全員に最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>{0}%</color>のダメージを与え、受ける回復量を<color=#28d9ed>{1}%</color>DOWNさせる。

ダメージ量と回復量DOWNの数値は【決闘者の誓い】が発動するたびに増加する。（ダメージは3%ずつ増加／回復量DOWNは25%ずつ増加）

アリーナ戦では復活時の行動ゲージ回復量が<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>DOWNする。
China_Simplified:
根据攻击方的回合数减少冷却时间，冷却时间归零时，对所有存活者造成最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>{0}%</color>的伤害，并使其受到的回复量降低<color=#28d9ed>{1}%</color>。

伤害量与回复量降低效果会在每次触发「决斗者的誓言」时提升。（伤害提高3%／回复量降低25%）

在竞技场战斗中复活时，行动值恢复减少<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
China_Traditional:
依照攻擊方的回合數減少冷卻時間，當冷卻歸零時，對所有生存者造成最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>{0}%</color>的傷害，並使其受到的回復量降低<color=#28d9ed>{1}%</color>。

傷害量與回復量降低效果會在每次觸發「決鬥者的誓言」時提升。（傷害提高3%／回復量降低25%）

在決鬥場戰鬥中復活時，速攻值恢復將減少<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, <color=#28d9ed>선혈의 검</color> 을 즉시 사용합니다.

이 공격은 전체 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 확률로 대상에게 2개의 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
이 후, 베스에게 <color=#28d9ed>방어력, 공격력</color> 증가 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>5턴</color> 동안 부여하지만, 자신은 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color> 감소 상태에 빠집니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower, then immediately uses <color=#28d9ed>Sword of Pure Blood</color>.

This attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> chance to inflict two <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> effects for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
Then grants Beth increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>5 turns</color>, while inflicting decreased <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> on the caster for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、<color=#28d9ed>【鮮血の剣】</color>を発動する。

<color=#28d9ed>【鮮血の剣】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>2個を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。
その後、【ベス】の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>5ターン</color>の間UPさせるが、自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間DOWNする。
China_Simplified:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并立即发动<color=#28d9ed>鲜血之剑</color>。

该攻击会攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的几率对目标造成2个<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
此后，贝丝会获得<color=#28d9ed>防御力、攻击力</color>提升效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>5回合</color>，但会使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
China_Traditional:
若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，立即使用<color=#28d9ed>鮮血之劍</color>。

此攻擊將攻擊全體敵人，並以<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>機率在<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>回合內賦予目標2個<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>。
此後，雖然會在<color=#28d9ed>5回合</color>內賦予貝絲<color=#28d9ed>防禦力、攻擊力</color>增加效果，但自身會在<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>內陷入<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>減少狀態。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n자신이 턴을 획득할 때마다, 공격력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_13]</color> 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)

Korean: 적을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 감소시킵니다.

Korean: (발동 효과) 아군이 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>피안의 겁화</color>로 반격 합니다.\n 공격 전 대상의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000080_2_2_1]개</color> 해제하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_2_4_1]턴</color> 동안 회피를 감소시킵니다. 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>지속성</color>이라면 대상의 효과 저항을 무시하고, 빗나감이 발생하지 않습니다.
English: (Triggered Effect) When an ally is hit, counterattacks with <color=#28d9ed>Nirvana's Inferno</color>.\nBefore attacking, removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000080_2_2_1]</color> buff(s) from the target, and reduces Evasion for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_2_4_1] turn(s)</color>. Korean:
(패시브 효과)
자신이 공격 받았을 때 50% 확률로 반격합니다.
단일 공격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_roguelight_502]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_502]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>출혈, 저주, 중독</color>을 부여합니다.

(Passive Effect)
Has a 50% chance to counterattack when the caster is attacked.
When attacking a single target, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_roguelight_502]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding, Cursed</color>, and <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_502] turn(s)</color>.

(パッシブ効果)
自分がダメージを受けた場合、50%の確率で反撃する。
単体攻撃時、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_roguelight_502]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>出血、呪い、中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_502]ターン</color>の間付与する。
火属性以外の敵が行動時、HPを20%回復する。

(被动效果)
自身受到攻击时，有50%的几率反击。
单体攻击时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_roguelight_502]</color>的几率造成<color=#28d9ed>出血、诅咒、中毒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_502]回合</color>。
若攻击者为非火属性敌人，则生命值恢复20%。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
自身受到攻擊時，以50%的機率反擊。
單一攻擊時，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_roguelight_502]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_502]回合</color>內賦予<color=#28d9ed>出血、詛咒、中毒</color>。
非火屬性的敵人行動時，生命力恢復20%。

English: Territory of Bane
Japanese: 劇毒の領土
China_Simplified: 剧毒领域
China_Traditional: 劇毒領域

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n버스트 스킬과 협공, 스킬 체인을 제외한 공격으로 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color> 감소합니다.\n협공으로 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_2]</color> 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from attacks other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, or Skill Chains by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>.\nIncreases Weakness Gauge damage taken from Dual Attacks by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_2]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nバーストスキル、連携、チェーンスキル以外の攻撃で受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>DOWNする。\n連携で受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_2]</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n除爆发技能、夹攻和连携技能以外的攻击技能造成的WG伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>。\n夹攻造成的WG伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_2]</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n除了爆發技能、夾攻及連鎖技能之外的攻擊所受到的WG傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>。\n因夾攻受到的WG傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_2]</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n버스트 스킬과 협공, 스킬 체인을 제외한 공격으로 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color> 감소합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces the Weakness Gauge damage taken from attacks other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, or Skill Chains by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nバーストスキル、連携、チェーンスキル以外の攻撃で受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>DOWNする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n除爆发技能、夹攻和连携技能以外的攻击技能造成的WG伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n除了爆發技能、夾攻及連鎖技能之外的攻擊所受到的WG傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_1]</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 시작 시 치명 확률과 공격력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color> 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of each turn, increases Critical Hit Chance and Attack by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、会心率と攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n每回合开始时，暴击率和攻击力提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n每回合開始時，暴擊率與攻擊力增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 시작 시 치명 확률과 공격력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color> 증가합니다. \n대상이 보유한 약화 효과 수량에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of each turn, increases Critical Hit Chance and Attack by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>. \nDamage increases proportional to the number of debuffs on the target.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、会心率と攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>UPする。\n対象の弱体効果の数に応じてダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n每回合开始时，暴击率和攻击力提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>。\n根据目标附带的弱化效果数量等比提升伤害。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n每回合開始時，暴擊率與攻擊力增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_4]</color>。\n傷害隨目標具有的弱化效果數量等比增加。

Korean: 4턴 마다 광폭화 상태로 전환하고 자신에게 해제 불가능한 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다. \n\n광폭화 돌입과 필살기 : 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_6]턴</color> 동안 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다. (대상의 면역 무시)
English: Becomes Enraged every 4 turns and grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. \n\nEnraged Activation and Ultimate Skill: Attacks all enemies and inflicts an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_6] turns</color> (Ignores target's Immunity).
Japanese: 4ターンごとに【狂暴化】状態に切り替わり、自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UPとダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与する。\n\n【狂暴化】と【必殺スキル】：敵全体にダメージを与え、解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_6]ターン</color>の間付与する。(対象の免疫を無視)
China_Simplified: 每4回合转化为狂暴化状态，并使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。\n\n陷入狂暴化和必杀技：攻击全体敌人，并造成无法解除的<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_6]回合</color>。(无视目标的免疫)
China_Traditional: 每4回合轉換為狂暴化狀態，並在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果。\n\n進入狂暴化與必殺技：攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_6]回合</color>內賦予無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>。(無視目標的免疫)

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_monad_gate_monster_7]</color> 확률로 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_7]턴</color> 동안 도발합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_monad_gate_monster_7]</color> chance to provoke the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_7] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_monad_gate_monster_7]</color>の確率で対象を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_7]ターン</color>の間挑発する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_monad_gate_monster_7]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>挑衅</color>效果，持续[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_7]回合。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，並以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_monad_gate_monster_7]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_7]回合</color>內挑釁目標。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_8]턴</color> 동안 방어력이 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and increases Defense for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_8]</color> turns.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、防御力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_8]ターン</color>の間UPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，防御力提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_8]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_8]回合</color>內防禦力增加。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 자신의 방어력에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Damage increases based on the caster’s Defense.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。自分の防御力が高いほどダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。根据自身防御力等比提升伤害。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。傷害會隨自身的防禦力等比增加。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 자신의 방어력에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다. \n방어력이 증가했다면 해당 공격의 치명 확률이 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Damage increases based on the caster’s Defense. \nWhen granted increased Defense, increases the Critical Hit Chance of this attack by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。自分の防御力が高いほどダメージがUPする。\n防御力がUPした状態の場合、この攻撃の会心率が<color=#28d9ed>100％</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。根据自身防御力等比提升伤害。\n若防御力提升，则相应攻击的暴击率提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。傷害會隨自身的防禦力等比增加。\n若防禦力已增加，該攻擊的暴擊率增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。

Korean: 방어력이 증가했다면 받는 피해가 크게 감소합니다.
English: When granted increased Defense, the damage taken is significantly reduced.
Japanese: 防御力がUPした状態の場合、受けるダメージが大幅にDOWNする。
China_Simplified: 若防御力提升，则所受伤害大幅降低。
China_Traditional: 若防禦力已增加，受到的傷害大幅減少。

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고, WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>대원수의 이름으로</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>CP/AP</color>를 모두 감소시킵니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> of Max Health or lower, and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns, and recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>In the Name of the General</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies and reduces all enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Chain Points/Action Points</color>.
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>UPする。この効果はブレイクすると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UPとダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【大元帥の名において】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>CP/AP</color>をすべてDOWNさせる。
China_Simplified:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。该效果将持续至进入力竭状态为止。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，且WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>以大元帅之名</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>CP/AP</color>降低。
China_Traditional:
若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，且攻擊力及速度增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。此效果持續至進入休息前為止。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>以統帥之名</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>CP/AP</color>全部減少。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_14]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_14] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_14]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_14]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_14]回合</color>內賦予目標<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고, 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 동일한 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>추가 공격</color>을 사용합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and if the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color>, performs an <color=#28d9ed>additional attack</color> on the same target.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の場合、同じ対象に<color=#28d9ed>追加攻撃</color>を与える。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，则对相同目标发动<color=#28d9ed>额外攻击</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態，對相同目標發動<color=#28d9ed>追加攻擊</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고, 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 동일한 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>추가 공격</color>을 사용합니다.\n추가 공격을 사용할 때마다 프란시스카의 모든 피해량이 증가합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and if the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color>, performs an <color=#28d9ed>additional attack</color> on the same target.\nEach time an additional attack is triggered, all of Francisca's damage increases.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の場合、同じ対象に<color=#28d9ed>追加攻撃</color>を与える。\n追加攻撃を与えるたびに、フランシスカのすべてのダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，则对相同目标发动<color=#28d9ed>额外攻击</color>。\n每次使用额外攻击时，弗朗西丝卡的所有伤害量提升。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態，對相同目標發動<color=#28d9ed>追加攻擊</color>。\n每當使用追加攻擊時，弗朗西絲卡的所有傷害量增加。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다. 대상이 출혈 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>필그림 에이지</color>의 스킬 쿨타임이 초기화됩니다.
English: Attacks an enemy. If the target is inflicted with Bleeding, resets the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Pilgrim Age</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。対象が出血状態の場合、<color=#28d9ed>【ピルグリムエイジ】</color>のスキルターンがリセットされる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。若目标处于出血状态，则重置<color=#28d9ed>朝圣</color>的技能冷却时间。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。若目標處於出血狀態，<color=#28d9ed>朝聖</color>的技能冷卻時間重置。

Korean: 출혈 보유 대상 공격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_22]턴</color> 동안 실드를 획득합니다.
English: When attacking a target inflicted with Bleeding, a Barrier is gained for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_22] turns</color>.
Japanese: 出血状態の対象を攻撃時、自分にシールドを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_22]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击附带出血状态的目标时，获得护盾，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_22]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊具有出血的目標時，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_22]回合</color>內獲得護盾。

Korean: 적을 공격하고, 무작위 아군 한 명의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_23]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and increases the <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> of a random ally for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_23] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、ランダムの味方単体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_23]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。

(해제 불가)\n이미 <color=#28d9ed>징벌의 영역</color>을 보유 중이었다면 대상이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>영원한 출혈</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color>시키며, 폭발에 의한 피해는  <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_29]</color> 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, and gains <color=#28d9ed>Retribution's Dominion</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_28] turns</color>. (Irremovable)\nIf already granted <color=#28d9ed>Retribution's Dominion</color>, <color=#28d9ed>detonates</color> all <color=#28d9ed>Eternal Bleeding</color> effects on the target and increases damage dealt by detonation by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_monad_gate_monster_29]</color>.

Korean: 4턴 마다 광폭화 상태로 전환하고 자신에게 해제 불가능한 공격력 증가/효과 적중 증가 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다. \n\n광폭화 돌입과 필살기 : 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_31]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>영원한 출혈</color>을 부여합니다. (대상의 면역 무시)
English: Becomes Enraged every 4 turns and grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack/Grants increased Effectiveness for 3 turns. \n\nEnraged and Ultimate Skill: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Eternal Bleeding</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_31] turns</color>.  (Ignores the target's immunity)
Japanese: 4ターンごとに【狂暴化】状態に切り替わり、自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/効果命中UP効果を3ターンの間付与する。\n\n【狂暴化】と【必殺スキル】：敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>【絶えざる出血】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_31]ターン</color>の間付与する。(対象の免疫を無視)

China_Traditional: 每4回合轉換為狂暴化狀態，並在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/效果命中增加效果。\n\n進入狂暴化與必殺技：攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_31]回合</color>內賦予無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>永久出血</color>。(無視目標的免疫)

Korean: 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 대상이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color>시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy. After attacking, <color=#28d9ed>detonates</color> all <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> stacks on the target.

China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。攻击后，使目标附带的所有<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果<color=#28d9ed>爆发</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。攻擊後，使目標具有的<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>全部<color=#28d9ed>引爆</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_33]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 2회 부여합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on the target 2 times for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_33] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>2個を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_33]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并对目标造成2次<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_33]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_33]回合</color>內賦予目標2次<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상 1명에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_34]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>표식</color>을 부여합니다. 가장 왼쪽에 적이 배치되어 있다면 해당 대상에게 표식이 우선 적용됩니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Marked</color> on one target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_34] turns</color>. If the enemy is placed on the far left, inflicts Marked on the target first.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。対象単体に<color=#28d9ed>標的</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_34]ターン</color>の間付与する。一番左側に敵が配置されている場合、その対象が優先的に標的として適用される。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。对1名目标造成<color=#28d9ed>标记</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_34]回合</color>。若最左侧存在敌人，则优先对该目标应用标记。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_34]回合</color>內賦予1名目標<color=#28d9ed>標記</color>。若敵人位於最左側，則優先對該目標套用標記。

Korean: 적은 부활/소생이 불가능합니다.
English: The enemy cannot be resurrected or revived.
Japanese: 敵は復活と蘇生ができない。
China_Simplified: 敌人无法复活/苏醒。
China_Traditional: 敵人無法復活/復甦。

Korean: 중독 보유 대상 공격 시 추가 턴을 획득합니다.
English: Gains an extra turn when attacking targets inflicted with Poisoned.
Japanese: 中毒状態の対象を攻撃時、追加ターンを獲得する。
China_Simplified: 攻击附带中毒效果的目标时，获得额外回合。
China_Traditional: 攻擊具有中毒的目標時，獲得追加回合。

Korean: 중독 보유 대상 공격 시 추가 턴을 획득합니다.\n속도형 적이 편성되어 있다면 적 전체에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>를 부여합니다.
English: Gains an extra turn when attacking targets inflicted with Poisoned.\nIf a Ranger enemy is deployed, inflicts irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> on all enemies.
Japanese: 中毒状態の対象を攻撃時、追加ターンを獲得する。\nスピード型の敵が編成されている場合、敵全体に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击附带中毒效果的目标时，获得额外回合。\n若配置有速度型敌人，则对全体敌人造成无法解除的<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊具有中毒的目標時，獲得追加回合。\n若敵方隊伍中編制有速度型敵人，賦予全體敵人無法解除的<color=#28d9ed>無法強化</color>。

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고, WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>날개를 꺾는 절망</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_38]턴</color> 동안 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> of Max Health or lower, and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Recovers [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1] Weakness Gauge. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Wings of Despair</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
 Attacks all enemies and inflicts unremovable <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_38] turns</color>.
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>UPする。この効果はブレイクすると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【翼を折る絶望】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与え、解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_38]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下，则转化为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。该效果将持续至陷入力竭状态为止。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>折翼之绝望</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人，并造成<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_monad_gate_monster_38]回合</color>。
China_Traditional:

Attacks an enemy.
Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_41]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_41] turn(s)</color>, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_40]</color> chance to grant <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to all allies. Barrier strength is proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color>.

Grants an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color> when defeating an enemy.

敵単体にダメージを与える。

敵を倒した場合、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。

有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_41]</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_41]回合</color>，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_40]</color>的几率使全体友军获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果。自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>越高，则护盾量越高。

Attacks an enemy, and grants Increased <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000044_2_1] turn(s)</color>.

攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000044_2_1]回合</color>內使自身的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中</color>增加。
此攻擊在自身<color=#28d9ed>具有強化效果</color>時，傷害量大幅
增加。

若消滅敵人，獲得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。

Barrier strength is proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> and it cannot be removed.

China_Traditional: 若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，攻擊全體目標。\n此後，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_42]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_42]回合</color>內賦予全體我軍<color=#28d9ed>護盾</color>。護盾量隨自身的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提升而增加，無法被解除。

(パッシブ効果)

Korean:
4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고, WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화 돌입 시, 적의 CP를 15 감소시킵니다. 광폭화는 4턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>탈라소포비아</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_22]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도, 공격력</color> 감소 효과를 부여하고 가장 공격력이 높은 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_24]턴</color> 동안 효과 저항을 무시하는 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>을 부여합니다.
English:
Enters <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Onset</color>: Grants self irremovable Attack increase and DMG Reduc for 3 turns and restores WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]. When entering Berserk, reduces enemies’ CP by 15. Berserk lasts 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Thalassophobia</color>: Used when Berserk ends.
Attacks all enemies and, with <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> chance, decreases targets’ <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_22]</color> turns, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color> that ignores <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color> on the enemy with the highest Attack for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_24]</color> turns.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に移行する。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可の攻撃力UP/ダメージ減少効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。突入時、敵のCPを15減少させる。【狂暴化】は4ターン持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>タラソフォビア</color>：狂暴化終了時に使用。
敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_22]</color>ターンの間<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>と<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を減少させ、最も攻撃力が高い敵に<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を無視する<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_24]</color>ターン付与する。
China_Simplified:
每4回合进入一次<color=#28d9ed>狂暴</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化开始</color>：为自身赋予不可解除的攻击力提升与伤害降低效果3回合，并恢复WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。进入狂暴时使敌方CP减少15点，狂暴持续4回合。

<color=#28d9ed>深海恐惧</color>：狂暴结束时使用。
攻击全体敌人，并以<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>概率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_22]</color>回合内降低目标<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>与<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>，并对攻击力最高的敌人施加无视<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>的<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_24]</color>回合。
China_Traditional:
每4回合進入一次<color=#28d9ed>狂暴</color>狀態。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n<color=#28d9ed>화, 수, 지</color> 속성 적에게 받는 피해가 감소하지만, <color=#28d9ed>협공, 스킬 체인, 버스트 스킬</color>로 받는 피해가 증가합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>실드</color> 보유 시 적에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.

3턴마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color> 증가합니다. 해당 효과는 최대 3회 누적되며, 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>제노사이더</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격합니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 3 turns and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants the caster irremovable increased Attack, reduced damage taken, and a Barrier for 2 turns. Recovers [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1] Weakness Gauge. Enraged lasts for 2 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Genocider</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies.
Japanese:
3ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>UPする。この効果は最大3回まで累積し、ブレイクすると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN、シールドを3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復させる。【狂暴化】は2ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【ジェノサイダー】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与える。

每3回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>。该效果最多可叠加3次，且将持续至进入力竭状态为止。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低，以及护盾效果，持续2回合，并恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]WG。狂暴化持续2回合。

<color=#28d9ed>种族灭绝</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人。
China_Traditional:
每3回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，攻擊力及速度增加
<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>。此效果最多累積3次，持續至進入休息前為止。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在2回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少以及護盾效果，並恢復
[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]的WG。狂暴化持續2回合。

<color=#28d9ed>集體屠殺</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人。
