China_Simplified: 每3回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：攻击全体敌人。攻击后，使<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_85]回合</color>。该效果不会被解除。
China_Traditional: 每3回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化與必殺技</color>：攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_85]回合</color>內<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>增加。此效果不會被解除。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>공격형</color>이 아닌 적에게는 입히는 피해가 증가하며, <color=#28d9ed>공격형</color>인 적에게는 4턴 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color> 감소를 부여합니다. (대상의 효과 저항과 면역 무시)\n이 스킬은 전열의 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy. Increases damage dealt to <color=#28d9ed>non-Striker</color> enemies, and inflicts an irremovable reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> on <color=#28d9ed>Striker</color> enemies for 4 turns. (Ignores the target's Resilience and Immunity)\nThis skill prioritizes the enemy's front line.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>攻撃型</color>以外の敵に与えるダメージがUPし、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃型</color>の敵には解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力DOWN</color>を4ターンの間付与する。この攻撃は対象の効果抵抗と免疫を無視する。\nこのスキルは前衛の敵を優先的に攻撃する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。对非<color=#28d9ed>攻击型</color>敌人造成的伤害提升，且对<color=#28d9ed>攻击型</color>敌人造成无法解除的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低效果，持续4回合。(无视目标的效果抵抗和免疫)\n该技能优先攻击处于前排的敌人。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。對非<color=#28d9ed>攻擊型</color>敵人造成的傷害增加，在4回合內賦予<color=#28d9ed>攻擊型</color>敵人無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>減少。(無視目標的效果抵抗及免疫)\n此技能優先攻擊前排的敵人。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>가 없는 대상은 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 0이 됩니다. (대상의 효과 저항과 면역 무시)
English: Attacks all enemies, and when the target is not granted any <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color>, reduces <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> to 0. (Ignores the target's Resilience and Immunity)
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がない場合、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を0にさせる。この攻撃は対象の効果抵抗と免疫を無視する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使未附带<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>的目标<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>变为0。(无视目标的效果抵抗和免疫)
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，未具有<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>目標的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>變為0。(無視目標的效果抵抗及免疫)

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, 자신은 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color> 상태가 됩니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, and grants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使自身获得<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。在<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>內使自身進入<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>\n狀態。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
화속성, 수속성 이외 속성에게 받는 피해량이 감소합니다.
적 턴 종료 시 마지막 행동 한 적이 강화 효과가 없다면 자신의 행동 게이지가<color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가합니다.
대상의 수가 적을수록 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Reduces damage taken from non-Fire and non-Water enemies.
At the end of an enemy's turn, if the enemy who last performed an action was not granted any buffs, increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.
Increases damage dealt inversely proportional to the number of targets.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
火・水属性以外の敵から受けるダメージがDOWNする。
敵のターン終了時、一番最後に行動した敵に強化効果がない場合、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>UPする。
対象の数が少ないほど与えるダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
除火属性、水属性外的属性带来的伤害量降低。
敌人回合结束时，最后行动的敌人若未附带强化效果，则使自身行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
目标数量越少，则造成的伤害越高。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
火屬性、水屬性以外的屬性造成的傷害量減少。
敵人回合結束時，若最後行動的敵人未具有強化效果，自身的速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
目標的數量越少，造成的傷害越大。

Korean: 적을 공격하고, 적 전체에게 효과 저항을 무시하는 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_310]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> on all enemies that ignores the target's Resilience for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_310] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_310]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并对全体敌人造成无视效果抵抗的<color=#28d9ed>触电</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_310]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，敌人不会触发反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_310]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人無視效果抵抗的<color=#28d9ed>觸電</color>。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 적 전체에게 효과 저항을 무시하는 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_311]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> on all enemies that ignores the target's Resilience for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_311] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_311]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。对全体敌人造成无视效果抵抗的<color=#28d9ed>触电</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_311]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，敌人不会触发反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_311]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人無視效果抵抗的<color=#28d9ed>觸電</color>。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 약화 효과를 보유한 대상에게 효과 저항 및 면역을 무시하고  <color=#28d9ed>AP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 감소시킵니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. When the target is inflicted with a debuff, ignores the target's Resilience and Immunity and reduces <color=#28d9ed>all</color> <color=#28d9ed>Action Points</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。弱体効果がある対象を攻撃時、効果抵抗および免疫を無視し、<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。对附带弱化效果的目标无视效果抵抗和免疫，并使<color=#28d9ed>AP</color><color=#28d9ed>全部</color>降低。\n此技能发动后，敌人不会触发反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。無視具有弱化效果之目標的效果抵抗及免疫，使<color=#28d9ed>AP</color><color=#28d9ed>全部</color>減少。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
적 행동 시 자신이 감전 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_317]</color>의 CP를 회복시킵니다.
적이 <color=#28d9ed>공격이 아닌 스킬</color> 사용 시 반격하고, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 모두 해제합니다. 추가로 CP를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 감소시킵니다.

고정 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
단, <color=#28d9ed>스킬 체인</color>으로 받는 <color=#28d9ed>고정 피해</color>는 최대 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_316]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.

<color=#28d9ed>스킬 체인</color> 및 <color=#28d9ed>버스트 스킬</color> 피격 시에만 <color=#28d9ed>WG</color>가 감소하고, 자신이 받는 피해량이 증가합니다.
마법형이 아닌 적의 효과 적중이 90% 감소합니다.
대상의 수가 적을수록 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
When an enemy performs an action, if the caster is inflicted with Shocked, recovers <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_317]</color> Chain Points.
When an enemy uses a <color=#28d9ed>non-attack skill</color>, counterattacks, and removes all <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> from the caster. Additionally, reduces <color=#28d9ed>all</color> Chain Points.

Fixed damage does not exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>.
However, <color=#28d9ed>fixed damage</color> from <color=#28d9ed>Skill Chains</color> does not exceed a maximum of <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_316]</color>.

Only reduces <color=#28d9ed>Weakness Gauge</color> when hit by <color=#28d9ed>Skill Chains</color> or <color=#28d9ed>Burst Skills</color> and increases damage taken by the caster.
Reduces Effectiveness of non-Mage enemies by 90%.
Increases damage dealt inversely proportional to the number of targets.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
敵が行動時、自分が感電状態の場合、CPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_317]</color>獲得させる。
敵が<color=#28d9ed>攻撃以外のスキル</color>を使用時、対象に反撃し、自分の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>をすべて解除する。また、CPを<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>DOWNさせる。

固定ダメージで受けるダメージは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>を超えない。
ただし、<color=#28d9ed>チェーンスキル</color>で受ける<color=#28d9ed>固定ダメージ</color>は最大<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_316]</color>を超えない。

<color=#28d9ed>チェーンスキル</color>と<color=#28d9ed>バーストスキル</color>で受けるダメージでのみ<color=#28d9ed>WG</color>がDOWNし、自分が受けるダメージがUPする。
魔法型以外の敵の効果命中が90％DOWNする。
対象の数が少ないほど与えるダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
敌人行动时，如果自身处于触电状态，则使CP恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_317]</color>。
当敌人使用<color=#28d9ed>非攻击类技能</color>时进行反击，并解除自身所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。此外，使敌人的CP<color=#28d9ed>全部</color>
降低。

固定伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>。
但是，通过<color=#28d9ed>连携技能</color>受到的<color=#28d9ed>固定伤害</color>最多不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_316]</color>。

只有在受到<color=#28d9ed>连携技能</color>和<color=#28d9ed>爆发技能</color>攻击时， <color=#28d9ed>WG</color>才会降低，同时提升自身所受伤害量。
非魔法型敌人的效果命中率降低90%。
目标数量越少，则造成的伤害越高。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
敵人行動時，若自身處於觸電狀態，恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_317]</color>的CP。
敵人使用<color=#28d9ed>非攻擊的技能</color>時反擊，解除自身的所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。額外使CP<color=#28d9ed>全部</color>減少。

固定傷害不會超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>。
但因<color=#28d9ed>連鎖技能</color>受到的<color=#28d9ed>固定傷害</color>最多不會超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_316]</color>。

只有在受到<color=#28d9ed>連鎖技能</color>及<color=#28d9ed>爆發技能</color>的攻擊時，<color=#28d9ed>WG</color>會減少，自身受到的傷害量增加。
非魔法型敵人的效果命中減少90%。
目標的數量越少，造成的傷害越大。

Korean:
전투 입장 시 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_323]턴</color> 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 필살기</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체의 강화 효과를 모두 해제하고 즉사 시킵니다. 이 스킬로 사망한 적은 부활 및 소생이 불가능합니다.
English:
At the start of battle, becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_323] turn(s)</color>. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Removes all buffs from all enemies and inflicts instant death. Enemies killed by this skill cannot be Resurrected or Revived.
Japanese:
戦闘開始時、<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_323]ターン</color>の間付与する。狂暴化は3ターンの間継続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【必殺スキル】</color>：狂暴化終了時に使用する。
敵全体の強化効果をすべて解除し、即死させる。このスキルで倒れた敵は復活と蘇生ができなくなる。
China_Simplified:
战斗开始时转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_323]回合</color>。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化必杀技</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
解除全体敌人的所有强化效果并使其立即死亡。被此技能击杀的敌人无法复活与苏醒。
China_Traditional:
進入戰鬥時，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_323]回合</color>內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化必殺技</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
解除全體敵人的所有強化效果，使其立即死亡。因此技能死亡的敵人無法復活及復甦。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_356]턴</color> 동안 지속되는 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_356] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_356]ターン</color>持続する<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を付与。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并赋予持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_356]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並賦予持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_356]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。

Korean: (발동 효과) 스킬의 <color=#28d9ed>쿨타임</color>마다 <color=#28d9ed>복수</color> 효과를 준비합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>복수</color> 발동 시 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_358]턴</color> 동안 지속되는 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 2회 부여합니다.
English: (Trigger Effect) Every time a skill goes on <color=#28d9ed>Cooldown</color>, prepares a <color=#28d9ed>Revenge</color> effect.\nWhen <color=#28d9ed>Revenge</color> activates, attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> twice for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_358] turns</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)スキルが<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>に入るたび、<color=#28d9ed>復讐</color>効果を準備。\n<color=#28d9ed>復讐</color>発動時、敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_358]ターン</color>持続する<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を2回付与。
China_Simplified: （触发效果）每当技能进入<color=#28d9ed>冷却</color>，准备一次<color=#28d9ed>复仇</color>效果。\n<color=#28d9ed>复仇</color>发动时，攻击全体敌人，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>×2，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_358]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: （觸發效果）每當技能進入<color=#28d9ed>冷卻</color>，準備一次<color=#28d9ed>復仇</color>效果。\n<color=#28d9ed>復仇</color>發動時，攻擊全體敵人，並賦予<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>×2，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_358]回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_359]턴</color> 동안 지속되는 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 2회 부여하고 공격합니다. 공격 시 자신이 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있다면 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color>시키며, 폭발에 의한 피해는 999% 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> twice for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_359] turns</color>. If the caster has a <color=#28d9ed>Buff</color>, all <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> effects on the targets <color=#28d9ed>Detonate</color>, dealing 999% increased damage.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_359]ターン</color>持続する<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を2回付与。攻撃時、自分が<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を持つ場合、対象の<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を全て<color=#28d9ed>爆発</color>させ、爆発によるダメージが999%増加。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>×2，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_359]回合</color>。若自身拥有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，则引爆目标所有<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，<color=#28d9ed>爆炸</color>伤害提高999%。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並賦予<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>×2，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_359]回合</color>。若自身擁有<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>，則引爆目標所有<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，<color=#28d9ed>爆炸</color>傷害提高999%。

Korean:
턴 시작 시 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>가 없다면 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_361]턴</color> 동안 지속되는 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여하고, 자신에게는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_337]턴</color> 동안 해제 되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>피해 감소</color> 효과를 부여합니다.

치명 피격 시 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1]턴</color> 동안 무작위 능력치 증가 효과를 부여합니다.

명속성, 지속성이 아닌 적의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> 감소합니다.

고정 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
단, <color=#28d9ed>스킬 체인</color>으로 받는 <color=#28d9ed>고정 피해</color>는 최대 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_8st_368]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.

지속성 및 공격형 적에게 받는 피해량이 증가합니다.
모든 공격은 대상이 적을 수록 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
At the start of the turn, if there are no <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> on self, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_361] turn(s)</color> and grants unremovable <color=#28d9ed>DMG Reduc</color> to self for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_337] turn(s)</color>.

When hit by a Critical Hit, grants random stat increase effect(s) to self for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1] turn(s)</color>.

Decreases <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness</color> of non-Light and non-Earth elemental enemies by <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>.

Damage received from Fixed Damage cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>.
However, <color=#28d9ed>Fixed Damage</color> received from <color=#28d9ed>Skill Chains</color> cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_8st_368]</color>.

Increases damage received from Earth element and Striker enemies.
Damage of all attacks increases as the number of targets decreases.
Japanese:
ターン開始時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がない場合、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_361]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を付与し、自分に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_337]ターン</color>の間、解除されない<color=#28d9ed>ダメージ減少</color>効果を付与する。

会心被弾時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1]ターン</color>の間、ランダムな能力値増加効果を付与する。

光属性、地属性でない敵の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中</color>が<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>減少する。

受ける固定ダメージは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>を超えない。
ただし、<color=#28d9ed>スキルチェーン</color>による<color=#28d9ed>固定ダメージ</color>は最大<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_8st_368]</color>を超えない。

地属性および攻撃型の敵から受けるダメージが増加する。
すべての攻撃は、対象が少ないほどダメージが増加する。
China_Simplified:
回合开始时，若自身没有<color=#28d9ed>减益效果</color>，对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_361]回合</color>，并赋予自身<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_337]回合</color>（无法解除）。

受到暴击时，自身获得随机能力值提升效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1]回合</color>。

非光属性、地属性敌人的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>。

承受的固定伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>。
但因<color=#28d9ed>连携技能</color>受到的<color=#28d9ed>固定伤害</color>最多不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_8st_368]</color>。

受到地属性及攻击型敌人造成的伤害提升。
所有攻击的目标越少，伤害越高。
China_Traditional:
回合開始時，若自身沒有<color=#28d9ed>減益效果</color>，對全體敵人造成<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_8st_361]回合</color>，並賦予自身<color=#28d9ed>傷害減少</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_337]回合</color>（無法解除）。

受到暴擊時，自身獲得隨機能力值增加效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1]回合</color>。

非光屬性、地屬性敵人的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>。

承受的固定傷害不超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>。
但因<color=#28d9ed>連鎖技能</color>受到的<color=#28d9ed>固定傷害</color>最多不超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_8st_368]</color>。

受到地屬性及攻擊型敵人造成的傷害增加。
所有攻擊的目標越少，傷害增加。

Korean: 가장 <color=#28d9ed>좌측</color>에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.
English: Prioritizes attacking the enemy on the far <color=#28d9ed>left</color>.
Japanese: 最も<color=#28d9ed>左端</color>の敵を優先的に攻撃。
China_Simplified: 优先攻击最<color=#28d9ed>左侧</color>的敌人。
China_Traditional: 優先攻擊最<color=#28d9ed>左側</color>的敵人。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n이 공격은 대상이 적을 수록 피해가 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nDeals more damage when fewer enemies remain.
Japanese: 敵全体を攻撃。\n敵が少ないほど与えるダメージが増加。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n敌人越少，造成的伤害越高。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n敵人越少，造成的傷害越高。

Korean: (발동 효과) <color=#28d9ed>적은 어디냐… / 네가 적인가…</color>로 적을 처치하거나, <color=#28d9ed>적은 어디냐…</color>의 공격 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>속도형</color>이 아닐 경우 적 전체에게 공격합니다.\n이 공격은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 무시합니다.
English: (Trigger Effect) If <color=#28d9ed>Where is the Enemy… / Are You the Enemy…</color> kills an enemy, or if the target of <color=#28d9ed>Where is the Enemy…</color> is not <color=#28d9ed>Speed-type</color>, attacks all enemies.\nThis attack ignores <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> of Defense.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)<color=#28d9ed>敵はどこだ…／お前が敵か…</color>で敵を倒すか、または<color=#28d9ed>敵はどこだ…</color>の対象が<color=#28d9ed>スピード型</color>でない場合、敵全体を攻撃。この攻撃は対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>無視。
China_Simplified: （触发效果）若以<color=#28d9ed>敌在哪… / 你是敌人吗…</color>击杀敌人，或<color=#28d9ed>敌在哪…</color>的目标不是<color=#28d9ed>速度型</color>时，攻击全体敌人。\n此攻击无视目标<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>防御力。
China_Traditional: （觸發效果）若以<color=#28d9ed>敵在哪… / 你是敵人嗎…</color>擊殺敵人，或<color=#28d9ed>敵在哪…</color>的目標不是<color=#28d9ed>速度型</color>時，攻擊全體敵人。\n此攻擊無視目標<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>防禦力。

Korean:
(패시브 효과) 전투 입장 시 <color=#28d9ed>메테우스의 맹세</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_10st_412]회</color> 발생시킵니다. 
속도형 적에게 받는 WG 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_415]</color> 증가합니다.
지속 피해로 받는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_417_1]</color>증가합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
메테우스의 모든 공격 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English:
(Passive Effect) Upon entering battle, triggers <color=#28d9ed>Oath of Meteus</color> <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_10st_412]</color> times.
Increases WG damage taken from <color=#28d9ed>Speed-type enemies</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_415]</color>.
Increases damage taken from <color=#28d9ed>Damage over Time</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_417_1]</color>.

Damage from <color=#28d9ed>Curses/Fixed Damage</color> cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>.
Immediately after Meteus’s attacks, enemies cannot trigger Counter, Revenge, or Quick Response.
Japanese:
（パッシブ効果）戦闘開始時、<color=#28d9ed>メテウスの誓い</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_10st_412]</color>回発動。
<color=#28d9ed>スピード型</color>の敵から受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_415]</color>増加。
<color=#28d9ed>持続ダメージ</color>による被ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_417_1]</color>増加。

<color=#28d9ed>呪い／固定ダメージ</color>は<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>を超えない。
メテウスの攻撃直後は、敵の反撃・復讐・迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified:
（被动效果）战斗开始时触发<color=#28d9ed>梅修斯的誓约</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_10st_412]</color>次。
受到<color=#28d9ed>速度型敌人</color>的WG伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_415]</color>。
受到<color=#28d9ed>持续伤害</color>的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_417_1]</color>。

来自<color=#28d9ed>诅咒/固定伤害</color>的伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>。
梅修斯的攻击后，敌人无法触发反击、复仇或迅速应对。
China_Traditional:
（被動效果）戰鬥開始時觸發<color=#28d9ed>梅修斯的誓約</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_10st_412]</color>次。
受到<color=#28d9ed>速度型敵人</color>的WG傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_415]</color>。
受到<color=#28d9ed>持續傷害</color>的傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_10st_417_1]</color>。

來自<color=#28d9ed>詛咒/固定傷害</color>的傷害不超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>。
梅修斯的攻擊後，敵人無法觸發反擊、復仇或迅速應對。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n이 공격은 <color=#28d9ed>공격형</color> 적을 우선적으로 공격하며, 공격 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>공격형</color>이 아니라면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>프로그램 말살</color>의 쿨타임이 초기화되고 <color=#28d9ed>추가턴</color>을 획득합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy.\nPrioritizes <color=#28d9ed>Attack-type</color> enemies. If the target is not <color=#28d9ed>Attack-type</color>, resets the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Program Eradication</color> and gains an <color=#28d9ed>Extra Turn</color>.
Japanese: 敵を攻撃。\n<color=#28d9ed>攻撃型</color>の敵を優先して攻撃し、対象が<color=#28d9ed>攻撃型</color>でない場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>プログラム抹殺</color>のスキルターンを初期化し、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n优先攻击<color=#28d9ed>攻击型</color>敌人。若目标不是<color=#28d9ed>攻击型</color>，则重置自身<color=#28d9ed>程序抹杀</color>的冷却时间，并获得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n優先攻擊<color=#28d9ed>攻擊型</color>敵人。若目標不是<color=#28d9ed>攻擊型</color>，則重置自身<color=#28d9ed>程式抹殺</color>的冷卻時間，並獲得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 제거하고, <color=#28d9ed>암속성</color>이 아닌 적에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_427]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>를 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, dispels all their <color=#28d9ed>Buffs</color>, and inflicts undispellable <color=#28d9ed>Buff Block</color> on non-<color=#28d9ed>Dark</color> enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_427]</color> turns.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、全ての<<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を解除する。さらに<color=#28d9ed>闇属性</color>以外の敵に、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_427]</color>ターン持続の解除不可<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，驱散其全部<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，并对非<color=#28d9ed>暗属性</color>敌人施加持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_427]</color>回合的不可驱散<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，驅散其全部<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>，並對非<color=#28d9ed>暗屬性</color>敵人施加持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_427]</color>回合的不可驅散<color=#28d9ed>無法強化</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>공격력이 가장 높은 적</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 적</color>에게는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_429]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color> 감소를 부여하고, 입히는 피해량이 크게 증가합니다.\n이 스킬로 사망한 적은 부활 및 소생이 불가능합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts undispellable <color=#28d9ed>Defense Down</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_429]</color> turns on the <color=#28d9ed>enemy with the highest Attack</color> and the <color=#28d9ed>enemy in the worst HP condition</color>, and greatly increases damage dealt.\nEnemies killed by this skill cannot be revived.
Japanese: 敵全体を攻撃。<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力が最も高い敵</color>と<color=#28d9ed>残りHPが最も低い敵</color>に、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_429]</color>ターンの解除不可<color=#28d9ed>防御力ダウン</color>を付与し、与ダメージが大幅増加。\nこのスキルで倒された敵は復活できない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。对<color=#28d9ed>攻击力最高的敌人</color>与<color=#28d9ed>血量情况最差的敌人</color>施加持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_429]</color>回合的不可驱散<color=#28d9ed>防御力下降</color>，造成的伤害大幅提高。\n被此技能击杀的敌人无法复活。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。對<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力最高的敵人</color>與<color=#28d9ed>血量情況最差的敵人</color>施加持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_429]</color>回合的不可驅散<color=#28d9ed>防禦力下降</color>，造成的傷害大幅提高。\n被此技能擊殺的敵人無法復活。

Korean:
반격 및 암속성 적에게 받는 피해량이 증가합니다.
암속성이 아닌 적은 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다.
매 턴 시작 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_436]</color> 증가합니다. (최대 5회 누적)
피격 후 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_438]</color> 증가합니다.
보스가 입는 <color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
모든 공격은 대상이 적을 수록 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
Takes increased damage from Counter and Dark-type enemies.
Non-Dark enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> is decreased by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.
At the start of each turn, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_436]</color> (up to 5 stacks).
When hit, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_438]</color>.
Boss’s damage from <color=#28d9ed>Curses/Fixed Damage</color> cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>.
Deals more damage when fewer enemies remain.
Japanese: 反撃および闇属性の敵から受けるダメージが増加。<color=#28d9ed>闇属性以外</color>の敵の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>減少。毎ターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_436]</color>増加（最大5回まで累積）。被弾時、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_438]</color>増加。ボスが受ける<color=#28d9ed>呪い／固定ダメージ</color>は<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>を超えない。敵が少ないほど与えるダメージ増加。
China_Simplified: 受到反击及<color=#28d9ed>暗属性</color>敌人伤害增加。<color=#28d9ed>非暗属性</color>敌人的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。每回合开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_436]</color>（最多5层）。被击时，<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_438]</color>。Boss受到的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒/固定伤害</color>不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>。敌人越少，造成的伤害越高。
China_Traditional: 受到反擊及<color=#28d9ed>暗屬性</color>敵人傷害增加。<color=#28d9ed>非暗屬性</color>敵人的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。每回合開始時，自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_436]</color>（最多5層）。被擊時，<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_438]</color>。Boss受到的<color=#28d9ed>詛咒/固定傷害</color>不超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_390]</color>。敵人越少，造成的傷害越高。

Korean:
4턴마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 필살기</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>모든 스킬</color>의 쿨타임이 초기화 됩니다.
English:
Transitions into <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Entry</color>: Grants self undispellable Attack Up/DMG Reduction for 3 turns and recovers WG <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]</color>. Berserk lasts 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Finisher</color>: Used when Berserk ends.
Attacks all enemies and resets the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>all skills</color>.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に移行。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可の攻撃力UP／被ダメージ減少を3ターン付与し、WG <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]</color>を回復。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【必殺スキル】</color>：狂暴化終了時に使用。敵全体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>全スキル</color>のスキルターンを初期化。

每4回合进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化进入</color>：赋予自身3回合不可驱散的攻击力提升/伤害减少，并恢复WG <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]</color>。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化终结技</color>：狂暴化结束时使用。攻击全体敌人并重置自身<color=#28d9ed>所有技能</color>的冷却。
China_Traditional:
每4回合進入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化進入</color>：賦予自身3回合不可驅散的攻擊力提升/傷害減少，並恢復WG <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]</color>。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化必殺技</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。攻擊全體敵人並重置自身<color=#28d9ed>所有技能</color>的冷卻。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>회복형</color>이 아닌 적 AP를 <color=#28d9ed>50</color> 감소시킵니다.\n대상이 적을수록 입히는 피해량이 증가합니다.

Japanese: 敵全体を攻撃。<color=#28d9ed>回復型</color>以外の敵のAPを<color=#28d9ed>50</color>減少。\n敵が少ないほど与ダメージ増加。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。使非<color=#28d9ed>恢复型</color>敌人AP减少<color=#28d9ed>50</color>。\n敌人越少，造成的伤害越高。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。使非<color=#28d9ed>恢復型</color>敵人AP減少<color=#28d9ed>50</color>。\n敵人越少，造成的傷害越高。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_450]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 부여하고, AP를 <color=#28d9ed>50</color> 감소시킵니다. 이 스킬은 면역을 무시합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Shock</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_450]</color> turns, and reduces AP by <color=#28d9ed>50</color>. This skill ignores Immunity.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_450]</color>ターンの<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を付与、APを<color=#28d9ed>50</color>減少。このスキルは免疫を無視。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_452]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만들고, 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_451]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n이 스킬은 면역을 무시합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, <color=#28d9ed>Stuns</color> them for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_452]</color> turns, and inflicts undispellable <color=#28d9ed>Shock</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_451]</color> turns.\nThis skill ignores Immunity.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_452]</color>ターンの<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>状態にし、解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_451]</color>ターン付与。\nこのスキルは免疫を無視。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，使目标<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_452]</color>回合<color=#28d9ed>眩晕</color>，并施加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_451]</color>回合不可驱散的<color=#28d9ed>感电</color>。\n该技能无视免疫。

Korean:
전투 개시 시점에 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가하며, 추가 스킬 및 협공이 불가능합니다. (영구 지속)
<color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 보유한 적이 턴 종료 시 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_455]</color> 증가합니다.
배틀 타입이 모두 다르면 적 전체의 효과 저항이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_456_1]</color> 증가합니다.
추가로 반격 및 복수 피격 시 적 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 저항</color>을, 버스트 스킬 피격 시 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 저항</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_458_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
적 대상의 효과 저항이 높을수록 받는 피해량이 증가합니다.
English:
At battle start, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> and disables Additional Skills and Assist Attacks. (Permanent)
When an enemy with <color=#28d9ed>Shock</color> ends their turn, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_455]</color>.
If all Battle Types are different, increases all enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_456_1]</color>.
Additionally, when hit by Counter or Revenge, increases the target enemy’s <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color>; when hit by a Burst Skill, increases all enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_458_1]</color> turns.
The higher the target’s <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color>, the more damage they take.
Japanese:
戦闘開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>増加し、追加スキルおよび協攻が不可（永続）。
<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を持つ敵がターン終了時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_455]</color>増加。
バトルタイプが全て異なる場合、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_456_1]</color>増加。
さらに反撃・復讐被弾時は敵対象の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を、バーストスキル被弾時は敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_458_1]</color>ターン増加。
敵の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>が高いほど、受けるダメージが増加。
China_Simplified:
战斗开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，并禁用追加技能与协同攻击（永久）。
当敌人带有<color=#28d9ed>感电</color>并在回合结束时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_455]</color>。
若战斗类型均不同，则全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_456_1]</color>。
另外，遭受反击或复仇时提升目标敌人的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>；遭受爆发技能时提升全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_12st_458_1]</color>回合。
目标<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>越高，受到的伤害越大。
China_Traditional:
戰鬥開始時，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，並禁用追加技能與協同攻擊（永久）。
當敵人帶有<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>並於回合結束時，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_12st_455]</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상 중 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 보유한 캐릭터가 있으면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_182]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 획득합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. When a target is inflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color>, grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_182] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。対象に<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_182]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。目标中存在附带<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>的角色，则获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_182]回合</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 시작 시 모든 적의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 제거하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 보유한 대상에게 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_185]</color> 감소합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of the turn, removes <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> from all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184] turn(s)</color>.\nReduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from targets inflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_185]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を解除し、<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n対象に<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がある場合、受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_185]</color>DOWNする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n回合开始时，解除所有敌人的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，并造成<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184]回合</color>。\n使受到来自附带<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>目标的WG伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_185]</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
回合開始時，移除所有敵人的<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184]回合</color>內賦予<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。
具有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>的目標造成的WG傷害減少
<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_185]</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 시작 시 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of the turn, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_184]ターン</color>の間付与する。

Korean:
4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 매 턴 적 전체의 공격력을 [Buff_T_event_monster_buff_186]턴 동안 감소시킵니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>탈라소포비아</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체에게 큰 피해를 입힙니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Reduces Attack of all enemies for [Buff_T_event_monster_buff_186] turn(s), each turn. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Thalassophobia</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Deals heavy damage to all enemies.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：毎ターン敵全体の攻撃力を[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_186]ターンの間DOWNさせる。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【海洋恐怖症】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動し、
敵全体に大ダメージを与える。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：每回合使全体敌人的攻击力降低，持续[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_186]回合。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>深海恐惧症</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
对全体敌人造成巨额伤害。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：每回合在[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_186]回合內使全體敵人的攻擊力減少。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>深海恐懼</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
對全體敵人造成極大傷害。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 해제합니다.

English: Grants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Increased Critical Hit Chance</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_188] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>と<color=#28d9ed>会心発生率UP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_188]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 使全体友军获得<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>和<color=#28d9ed>暴击率提升</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_188]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_188]回合</color>內賦予全體我軍<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>及<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率增加</color>。

Korean: 아에르가 살아있다면 아에르의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_190]</color> 증가시키고, 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_191]</color> 회복시킵니다.\n아에르가 사망한 상태라면 아에르를 <color=#28d9ed>부활</color> 시킵니다.
English: If Aer is alive, increases Priority of Aer by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_190]</color> and heals <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_191]</color> Health.\nIf Aer is defeated, <color=#28d9ed>resurrects</color> Aer.
Japanese: 戦場にアエルがいる場合、アエルの行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_190]</color>UPさせる。またHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_191]</color>回復する。\n戦場にアエルがいない場合、アエルを<color=#28d9ed>復活</color>させる。
China_Simplified: 若艾耶尔存活，则使艾耶尔的行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_190]</color>，并恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_191]</color>生命值。\n若艾耶尔已死亡，则使艾耶尔<color=#28d9ed>复活</color>。
China_Traditional: 艾耶爾生存時，使艾耶爾的速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_190]</color>，使生命力恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_191]</color>。\n若艾耶爾為死亡狀態，使艾耶爾<color=#28d9ed>復活</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n베로니카에게 영구적으로 <color=#28d9ed>소생</color> 효과가 적용됩니다.\n스텔라가 받는 피해의 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>를 대신 받습니다.

China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n使维罗妮卡获得永久的<color=#28d9ed>苏醒</color>效果。\n代替斯黛拉承受所受伤害的<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

If the target is not a <color=#28d9ed>defender</color>, reduces the target's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color> and increases the <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>.

China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n優先攻擊最<color=#28d9ed>左側</color>的敵人，若目標非<color=#28d9ed>防禦型</color>，使目標的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>，並使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 획득 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_26]개</color> 해제하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_106]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중</color> 을 증가시킵니다.\n대신 자신의 방어력이 매 턴 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_107]</color> 감소합니다. (Max 10 stacks)

Korean:
4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>스턴 캐논</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4044001_12_1]</color> 확률로 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044001_12_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만든 뒤, 자신에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률 증가</color>를 영구적으로 부여합니다.
<color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 효과는 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 저항</color>을 무시합니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns. 

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Recovers [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1] Weakness Gauge. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Stun Cannon</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4044001_12_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044001_12_1] turn(s)</color>, then permanently grants the caster irremovable <color=#28d9ed>increased Critical Damage</color>.
The <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> effect ignores the target's <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color>.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【スタンキャノン】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4044001_12_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044001_12_1]ターン</color>の間付与した後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を永続的にUPする。この効果は解除されない。
<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>は対象の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を無視する。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>晕眩加农炮</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4044001_12_1]</color>的几率使目标陷入<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044001_12_1]回合</color>后，使自身永久获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率提升</color>效果。
<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>效果无视目标的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>暈眩加農炮</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_4044001_12_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044001_12_1]回合</color>內使目標進入<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>狀態後，賦予自身永久不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率增加</color>。
<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>效果無視目標的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n가장 <color=#28d9ed>좌측</color>에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격하며 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>방어형</color>이 아닐 경우, 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color> 감소시키고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_102]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다. 이후, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color> 증가시킵니다.

If the target is not a <color=#28d9ed>defender</color>, reduces the target's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color> and inflicts irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_102] turn(s)</color>. Afterward, increases the <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n一番<color=#28d9ed>左側の敵</color>を優先的に攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>防御型</color>以外の敵を攻撃した場合、対象の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>DOWNさせ、<color=#28d9ed>沈黙</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_102]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は解除されない。その後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n优先攻击最<color=#28d9ed>左侧</color>的敌人，且若该目标为非 <color=#28d9ed>防御型</color>，则使目标的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>，并造成无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_102]回合</color>。随后，使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n優先攻擊最<color=#28d9ed>左側</color>的敵人，若目標非<color=#28d9ed>防禦型</color>，使目標的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_102]回合</color>內賦予無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>。之後，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_91]</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_104]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_104]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_104]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_104] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_104]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_104]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_104]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>触电</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_104]回合</color>。

Korean: 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 모두 <color=#28d9ed>해제</color>하고, 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_105_2]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_105_2]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 부여합니다.\n자신이 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있을 경우 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_105_3]</color> 증가합니다.
English: <color=#28d9ed>Removes</color> all <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> from the caster, and attacks all enemies.\nHas a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_105_2]</color> chance to inflict irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_105_2] turn(s)</color>.\nIf the caster has a <color=#28d9ed>buff</color>, increases damage dealt by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_105_3]</color>.

English: Kill Mode
Japanese: ジェノサイドモード
China_Simplified: 屠杀模式
China_Traditional: 屠殺模式

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
적 사망 시 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>영구적인 속도 증가</color>를 부여하고 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.(감전 피해로 인한 사망에서는 효과 발동하지 않습니다.)

지속성/명속성/암속성 대상에게 받는 피해가 감소하며, 방어형 및 수속성/화속성 대상에게 받는 피해가 증가합니다.

피격 시 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_115]</color> 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
When an enemy dies, grants <color=#28d9ed>permanent increased Speed</color> and an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color> to the caster. (The effect does not activate if the enemy dies to damage from Shocked)

Reduces damage taken from Earth, Light, and Dark targets, and increases damage taken from Defenders as well as Water and Fire targets.

Increases Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_115]</color> when hit.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)敵が倒れた時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を永続的にUPし、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。感電のダメージによって敵が倒れた場合、この効果は発動しない。

地・光・闇属性の敵から受けるダメージがDOWNし、防御型および水・火属性の敵から受けるダメージがUPする。

ダメージを受けた時、行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_115]</color>UPする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
敌人死亡时，使自身<color=#28d9ed>永久提升速度</color>，并获得<color=#28d9ed>额外回合</color>。（因触电伤害死亡时，无法触发效果。）

受到来自土属性/光属性/暗属性目标的伤害降低，且受到来自防御型和水属性/火属性目标的伤害提升。

受到攻击时，行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_115]</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
敵人死亡時，賦予自身<color=#28d9ed>永久的速度增加</color>，獲得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。(因觸電傷害死亡時，不會發動效果。)

大地屬性/光屬性/暗屬性目標造成的傷害減少，防禦型與水屬性/火屬性目標造成的傷害增加。

受擊時，速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_115]</color>。

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 적 전체를 공격합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고, WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화 돌입 시, 적의 CP를 15 감소시킵니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>거대 가위 시소</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.

English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower, and attacks all enemies.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns and recovers [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1] Weakness Gauge. Upon becoming Enraged, reduces the enemy's Chain Points by 15. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Giant Scissor Seesaw</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies, dealing heavy damage, and has a <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>2 stacks</color> of <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_507] turn(s)</color>. (Ignores Resilience)

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】に切り替わる時、敵のCPを15DOWNさせる。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【おっきなシーソーハサミ】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体に大ダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>の確率で効果抵抗を無視する<color=#28d9ed>出血</color><color=#28d9ed>2個</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_507]ターン</color>の間付与する。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。陷入狂暴化时，使敌人CP降低15。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>巨型剪刀梦魇</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人，造成巨额伤害，并有<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>2个</color><color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_507]回合</color>。（无视抵抗）

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]的WG。進入狂暴化時，使敵人的CP減少15。狂暴化持續3回合。

(パッシブ効果)自分がターンを獲得するたびに、攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_tower_buff_4]</color>UPする。

China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_mob_7_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_7_1]回合</color>內使目標進入<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>狀態。無視目標的效果抵抗。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n전투 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_common_monster_passive_20]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중</color>이 증가합니다. 또한 공격 시 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>강탈</color>합니다.

Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_9_1]</color>DOWNさせ、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_05]</color>UPさせる。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n공격 시 대상 한 명의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_15]</color> 감소시킵니다.\n적의 전체 공격으로 받는 피해량이 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of one target by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_15]</color> when attacking.\nIncreases damage taken from attacks that target all enemies.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n攻撃時、対象単体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_15]</color>DOWNさせる。\n敵の全体攻撃で受けるダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n攻击时，使1名敌人的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_15]</color>。\n由敌人的全体攻击造成的伤害量提升。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n攻擊時，使一名目標的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_15]</color>。\n因敵人的全體攻擊所受到的傷害量增加。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_05]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy.\nIncreases the <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_05]</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_05]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_05]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_05]</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>확률로 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nHas a <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on all enemies.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を与える。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n并有<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n以<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的機率賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>。

Korean: 적 전체에게 큰 피해를 입힙니다. 해당 공격 시 관통력이 <color=#28d9ed>15%</color>증가하며, 자신이 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있다면 피해량이 감소합니다.
English: Deals a large amount of damage to all enemies. This attack has <color=#28d9ed>15%</color> increased Penetration, but deals reduced damage if the caster is inflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体に大ダメージを与える。スキル使用時、貫通力が<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>UPし、自分に<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がある場合、与えるダメージがDOWNする。
China_Simplified: 对全体敌人造成巨额伤害。发动该攻击时，穿透力提升<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>，且若自身附带<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，则伤害量降低。
China_Traditional: 對全體敵人造成極大傷害。\n進行該攻擊時，貫穿力增加<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>，若自身具有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，傷害量減少。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color> 이 증가합니다. WG 피해를 입지 않습니다. 추가로 적의 치명 공격이 발생하지 않았다면 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_4]</color> 증가하고, <color=#28d9ed>가디언 캐논</color>의 쿨타임이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076006_11_2]턴</color> 감소합니다.\n치명 피해를 입을 경우 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_12]</color> 감소합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nIncreases <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> every turn. Does not take Weakness Gauge damage. Additionally, when an enemy makes a non-critical hit, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_4]</color> and reduces the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Guardian Cannon</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076006_11_2] turn(s)</color>.\nReduces <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_12]</color> when taking critical damage.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n毎ターンに<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>がUPする。WGダメージを受けない。敵の攻撃時、会心が発生しなかった場合は味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_4]</color>UPし、<color=#28d9ed>【ガーディアンキャノン】</color>のスキルターンが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076006_11_2]ターン</color>減少する。\n会心ダメージを受けた場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_12]</color>DOWNする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n每回合使<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，且不会受到WG伤害。若没有发生额外的致命攻击，则使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_4]</color>，且<color=#28d9ed>守护者加农炮</color>的冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076006_11_2]回合</color>。\n受到暴击伤害时，使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_12]</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n每回合<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>增加。不會受到WG傷害。若敵人沒有產生額外的暴擊攻擊，全體我軍的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_4]</color>，<color=#28d9ed>守護者加農炮</color>的冷卻時間減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076006_11_2]回合</color>。\n受到暴擊傷害時，自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_12]</color>。

Korean: 10턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 광폭화 상태는 스킬 시전 후 종료됩니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : <color=#28d9ed>가디언 캐논</color>을 발사하고 피해를 입힙니다.
English: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 10 turns. Enraged ends after a skill is used.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Fires <color=#28d9ed>Guardian Cannon</color>, dealing damage.
Japanese: 10ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：<color=#28d9ed>【ガーディアンキャノン】</color>を発射してダメージを与える。【狂暴化】の持続ターンはない。

Korean: 공격력이 가장 높은 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 해제한 뒤, 가장 공격력이 높은 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_11]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: Removes <color=#28d9ed>1</color> <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color> from the ally with the highest Attack, then increases their <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_11]</color>.
Japanese: 攻撃力が最も高い味方単体の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1個</color>解除した後、攻撃力が最も高い味方単体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_11]</color>UPさせる。

China_Traditional: 解除攻擊力最高的我軍的<color=#28d9ed>1個</color><color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>後，使攻擊力最高的我軍的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_10_11]</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n전투 입장 시, 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color> 효과를 영구적으로 부여합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nPermanently grants irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to the caster at the start of battle.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を永続的に付与する。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，使自身永久获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n進入戰鬥時，賦予自身永久不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>效果。

Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower. Increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的几率发动<color=#28d9ed>夹攻</color>。\n\n并额外使攻击力最高的友军<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000012_1_1]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的機率發動<color=#28d9ed>夾攻</color>。\n\n額外使攻擊力最高的我軍<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000012_1_1]</color>。

Korean: 트릭 오어 다이
English: Trick-or-Die
Japanese: トリック・オア・ダイ
China_Simplified: 不给糖就杀人
China_Traditional: 耍花招或死亡

Korean: (패시브 효과) 자신이 턴을 획득할 때마다, 자신의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_tower_buff_12]</color> 회복합니다.\n\n(발동 효과) 적이 공격이 아닌 스킬 사용 시 두 배의 피해를 주는 <color=#28d9ed>트리거 해피</color>로 반격한 뒤 <color=#28d9ed>협공</color>을 발생시킵니다. 추가로 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_121_2]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: (Passive Effect) Every time the caster gains a turn, recovers Health of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_tower_buff_12]</color>.\n\n(Triggered Effect) When the enemy uses a non-attack skill, counterattacks with <color=#28d9ed>Trigger Happy</color>, dealing double damage, then activates a <color=#28d9ed>Dual Attack</color>. Additionally, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_121_2]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)自分のターンが来るたびに、自分のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_tower_buff_12]</color>回復する。\n\n(発動効果)敵が攻撃以外のスキルを使用時、ダメージが2倍UPした<color=#28d9ed>【トリガーハッピー】</color>で反撃した後、<color=#28d9ed>連携</color>を追加で発生させる。また、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_121_2]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)每当自身获得回合时，使自身生命值
恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_tower_buff_12]</color>。

(触发效果)敌人使用非攻击类技能时，使用可造成双倍伤害的<color=#28d9ed>快乐扳机</color>进行反击后，发动<color=#28d9ed>夹攻</color>。且使友军全体的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>额外提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_121_2]</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)每當自身獲得回合時，自身的生命力
恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_tower_buff_12]</color>。

(發動效果)敵人使用非攻擊的技能時，以能夠造成兩倍傷害的<color=#28d9ed>快樂板機</color>反擊後，發動<color=#28d9ed>夾攻</color>。額外使全體我軍的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_121_2]</color>。

Korean: 디아 데 무에르토스
English: Día de Muertos
Japanese: ディア・デ・ムエルトス
China_Simplified: 亡灵节
China_Traditional: 亡靈節

Korean: (패시브 효과) 자신이 강화 효과를 보유하고 있을 경우 모든 공격의 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_123]</color> 증가합니다.\n\n전체 공격으로 입는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color> 감소합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
When the caster has a buff, increases damage dealt by all attacks by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_123]</color>.

Reduces the damage taken by attacks that target all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>.
Japanese: パッシブ効果)自分に強化効果がある場合、与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_123]</color>UPする。\n\n全体攻撃で受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>DOWNする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)若自身附带强化效果，则所有攻击的伤害量提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_123]</color>。\n\n且使全体攻击受到的伤害量降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)若自身具有強化效果，所有攻擊的傷害量增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_123]</color>。\n\n因全體攻擊受到的傷害量減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>。

Korean: 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 적 전체를 공격하여 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 확률로 대상의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_124]</color>감소시킵니다.\n\n이 후, 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color> 증가 효과를 영구적으로 부여합니다.
English: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower. Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> chance to reduce the target's Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_124]</color>.\n\nAfterward, permanently grants the caster irremovable increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.
Japanese: 最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>の確率で対象の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_124]</color>DOWNさせる。\n\nその後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を永続的にUPする。この効果は解除されない。
China_Simplified: 若生命值降至生命值上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并攻击全体敌人，有<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的几率使目标的行动值降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_124]</color>。\n\n此后，使自身永久获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升效果。
China_Traditional: 若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，攻擊全體敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的機率使目標的速攻值減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_124]</color>。\n\n此後，賦予自身永久不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>增加效果。

Korean: 사신과 함께 춤을
English: Dancing with Death
Japanese: ダンス・ウィズ・ウルブズ
China_Simplified: 与死神共舞
China_Traditional: 與死神共舞

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#28d9ed>영원히 살 수는 없어</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>이터널</color>은 전투 입장 시 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중 증가, 속도 증가</color>를 영구적으로 보유합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Grants an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color> to the the caster when using <color=#28d9ed>No One Lives Forever</color>.

Grants permanent irremovable <color=#28d9ed>increased Effectiveness and Speed</color> to <color=#28d9ed>Eternal</color> at the start of battle.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
<color=#28d9ed>【永遠の命などない】</color>使用時、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。

<color=#28d9ed>戦闘開始時、【エターナル】の</color>効果命中とスピード<color=#28d9ed>が永続的にUPする。この効果は解除されない。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
使用<color=#28d9ed>世上无永生</color>时，获得<color=#28d9ed>额外回合</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>伊特诺</color>在战斗开始时，永久获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中提升、速度提升</color>效果。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
使用<color=#28d9ed>世上無永生</color>時，獲得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>伊特諾</color>進入戰鬥時，將永久具有不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中增加、速度增加</color>。

Korean: (발동 효과) 전체 공격을 받을 경우 <color=#28d9ed>반격</color>하고 자신의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_131]</color> 회복합니다.\n\n반격 시, 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>의 확률로 적이 보유한 약화 효과의 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]턴</color> 증가시킨 후, 약화 효과가 없는 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 저항</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
English: (Triggered Effect) When hit by an attack that targets all enemies, <color=#28d9ed>counterattacks</color> and recovers Health of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_131]</color>.\n\nAttacks all enemies when counterattacking. After attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color> chance to increase the durations of debuffs on enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1] turn(s)</color>, then inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color> on enemies without debuffs for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]</color> turn(s).
Japanese: (発動効果)全体攻撃でダメージを受けた場合、<color=#28d9ed>反撃</color>を発生し、自分のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_131]</color>回復する。\n\n反撃時、敵全体にダメージを与える。その後、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>の確率で対象の弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]ターン</color>増加させた後、弱体効果がない対象の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: (触发效果)受到全体攻击时，发动<color=#28d9ed>反击</color>，并使自身生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_131]</color>。\n\n反击时，攻击全体敌人。攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>的几率使敌人附带的弱化效果持续时间增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]回合</color>后，使未附带弱化效果目标的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: (發動效果)受到全體攻擊時，發動<color=#28d9ed>反擊</color>並使自身的生命力恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_131]</color>。\n\n反擊時，攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>的機率使敵人具有的弱化效果持續時間增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]回合</color>後，使沒有弱化效果的目標的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]回合</color>內減少。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_128]</color>의 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_128]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>와 <color=#28d9ed>방어력 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_127]</color>의 확률로 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_128]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Defense</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_128] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_127]</color> chance to avoid triggering an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_128]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_128]ターン</color>の間付与し、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_128]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_127]</color>の確率で敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_128]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>和<color=#28d9ed>防御力降低</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_128]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_127]</color>的几率不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_128]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_128]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>無法強化</color>與<color=#28d9ed>防禦力減少</color>。\n使用此技能後，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_127]</color>的機率敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces damage taken by attacks that target all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_49]</color> and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_roguelight_561]</color> when hit.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nダメージを受けた場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_roguelight_561]</color>UPさせる。全体攻撃で受けるダメ―ジが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_49]</color>DOWNする。

China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n因全體攻擊受到的傷害量減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_49]</color>，受擊時，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_roguelight_561]</color>。

Korean:
적을 공격합니다.
보유한 강화 효과에 따라 추가 공격이 발생하며, 아래 효과가 적용됩니다.

【우메이치린】 : 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_134]</color>의 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_134]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English:
Attacks an enemy.
Activates an additional attack based on the caster's buff, and applies the following effect:

Ume Ichirin: Attacks an enemy. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_134]</color> chance to increase the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_134]</color> after attacking.
Japanese:
敵単体にダメージを与える。
自分に【梅一輪】が付与された場合、次の効果が発動する。

【梅一輪】：敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_134]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_134]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified:
攻击敌人。
根据附带的强化效果发动额外攻击，并触发以下效果。

【一朵梅花】：攻击敌人。攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_134]</color>的几率使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_134]</color>。
China_Traditional:
攻擊敵人。
根據具有的強化效果發動追加攻擊，套用以下效果。

【梅一輪】：攻擊敵人。攻擊後，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_134]</color>的機率使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_134]</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>15%</color> 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect) Increases <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>15%</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)戦闘開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果) 使<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격 후 추가 턴을 획득합니다.\n\n공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>우메이치린</color> 효과를 획득합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, then grants the caster an extra turn.\n\nGrants the <color=#28d9ed>Ume Ichirin</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132] turn(s)</color> after attacking.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、追加ターンを獲得する。\n\n攻撃後、自分に【梅一輪】を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132]ターン</color>の間付与する。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
전체 공격으로 입는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color> 감소하며, 전체 공격 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_136]</color>의 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_136]턴</color> 동안 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 증가합니다.

수속성 대상에게 주는 피해가 증가하며 지속성/화속성 대상에게 받는 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Reduces damage taken by attacks that target all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_136]</color> chance to grant the caster increased <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_136] turn(s)</color> after being hit by an attack that targets all enemies.

Increases damage dealt to Water targets and increases damage taken from Earth and Fire targets.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
全体攻撃で受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>DOWNし、全体攻撃でダメージを受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_136]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_136]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。

水属性の敵に与えるダメージがUPし、地・火属性の敵から受けるダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
使因全体攻击受到的伤害量降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>，且受到全体攻击时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_136]</color>的几率使自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_136]回合</color>。

对水属性目标造成的伤害提升，且受到来自土属性/火属性目标的伤害提升。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
因全體攻擊受到的傷害量減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_122]</color>，受到全體攻擊時，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_event_monster_buff_136]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_136]回合</color>內自身的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>
增加。

對水屬性目標造成的傷害增加，大地屬性/火屬性目標造成的傷害增加。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n전투 입장 시 적 전체의 효과 적중을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color> 감소시키고, 자신의 효과 저항을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n적 행동 시 자신에게 약화 효과가 없다면 자신의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_214]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of battle, reduces Effectiveness of all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>, and increases Resilience of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>.\nWhen an enemy performs an action, if the caster does not have a debuff, increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_214]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、敵全体の効果命中を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>DOWNし、自分の効果抵抗を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>UPさせる。\n敵の行動時、自分に弱体効果がない場合、自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_214]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，使全体敌人的效果命中降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>，并使自身效果抵抗提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>。\n敌人行动时，若自身未附带弱化效果，则使自身行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_214]</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n進入戰鬥時，使全體敵人的效果命中減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>，使自身的效果抵抗增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_210_2]</color>。\n敵人行動時，若自身不具有弱化效果，使自身的速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_214]</color>。

Korean:
5턴마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하며 적 전체를 공격합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>강화된 미카즈키 3식 : 화람</color>(광폭화 종료 시 사용)
적 전체를 공격하여 큰 피해를 주고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>우메이치린</color> 효과를 획득합니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 5 turns and attacks all enemies.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Restores [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2] Weakness Gauge. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enhanced Mikazuki 3rd Art: Flower Charm</color>(Used when Enraged ends)
Attacks all enemies, dealing heavy damage, and grants the caster the <color=#28d9ed>Ume Ichirin</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese:
5ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、敵全体にダメージを与える。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】と【必殺スキル】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WG[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]を回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターン間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【強・三日月参式：花藍】</color>【狂暴化】終了時に使用する。
敵全体に大ダメージを与え、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【梅一輪】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified:
每5回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并攻击全体敌人。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>已强化的三日月3式：花篮</color>
(狂暴化结束时发动)
攻击全体敌人，造成巨额伤害，并获得<color=#28d9ed>一朵梅花</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132]回合</color>。
China_Traditional:
每5回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，攻擊全體敵人。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>強化後的三日月第3式：花籃</color>
(狂暴化結束時使用)
攻擊全體敵人，造成極大傷害，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_132]回合</color>內獲得<color=#28d9ed>梅一輪</color>效果。

(Passive Effect)
Shichifuja always prioritizes attacking the leftmost target.

Increases damage dealt by all attacks if the target is inflicted with Poisoned when attacking.
Increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_115]</color> when attacked.

(パッシブ効果)
一番左側の敵を優先的に攻撃する。

(被動效果)
<color=#28d9ed>反擊</color>後，使全體我軍的速攻值恢復<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。
