Korean: (패시브 효과)\n모든 공격은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>에 비례하여 피해량이 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nIncreases damage dealt by all attacks proportional to <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> of the caster.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nすべての攻撃は自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n根据自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>等比提升所有攻击的伤害量。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n所有攻擊會隨自身的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>等比增加傷害量。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
모든 공격은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>에 비례하여 피해량이 증가합니다.

또한 <color=#28d9ed>마법형</color> 적에게 받는 피해는 증가하며, <color=#28d9ed>수속성</color>이 아닌 적의 효과 적중은 감소합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Increases damage dealt by all attacks proportional to <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> of the caster.

Additionally, increases damage taken from <color=#28d9ed>Mage</color> enemies, and reduces Effectiveness of <color=#28d9ed>non-Water</color> enemies.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
すべての攻撃は自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。

また、<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>の敵から受けるダメージがUPし、<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>以外の敵の効果命中がDOWNする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
根据自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>等比提升所有攻击的伤害量。

使受到来自<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>敌人的伤害提升，且使非<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>敌人的效果命中降低。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
所有攻擊會隨自身的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>等比增加傷害量。

且<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>敵人造成的傷害增加，非<color=#28d9ed>水屬性</color>敵人的效果命中減少。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n자신의 모든 공격은 <color=#28d9ed>유리한 상성</color>으로 적용됩니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAll attacks by the caster have an <color=#28d9ed>element advantage</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n自分の攻撃はすべて<color=#28d9ed>有利属性</color>の攻撃判定になる。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n使自身的所有攻击以<color=#28d9ed>优势属性</color>施展。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n自身的所有攻擊套用<color=#28d9ed>屬性優勢</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n치명 공격을 적중하지 못했을 때 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>치명확률</color> 증가 효과를 2턴 동안 부여합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nWhen failing to score a critical hit, grants an irremovable increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> to the caster for 2 turns.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n会心が発生しなかった場合、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>UP効果を2ターンの間付与する。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n若暴击未命中，则使自身获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升效果，持续2回合。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n暴擊攻擊未能命中時，在2回合內賦予自身不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>增加效果。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
치명 공격을 적중하지 못했을 때 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>치명확률</color> 증가 효과를 2턴 동안 부여합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>마법형</color> 적에게 받는 피해는 증가하며, <color=#28d9ed>수속성</color>이 아닌 적의 효과 적중은 감소합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
When failing to score a critical hit, grants an irremovable increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> to the caster for 2 turns.

Increases damage taken from <color=#28d9ed>Mage</color> enemies, and reduces Effectiveness of <color=#28d9ed>non-Water</color> enemies.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
会心が発生しなかった場合、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>UP効果を2ターンの間付与する。

<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>の敵から受けるダメージがUPし、<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>以外の敵の効果命中はDOWNする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
若暴击未命中，则使自身获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升效果，持续2回合。

使受到来自<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>敌人的伤害提升，且使非<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>敌人的效果命中降低。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
暴擊攻擊未能命中時，在2回合內賦予自身不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>增加效果。

<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>敵人造成的傷害增加，非<color=#28d9ed>水屬性</color>敵人的效果命中減少。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>실드 및 방어력</color> 증가 효과를 2턴 동안 부여합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nGrants <color=#28d9ed>a Barrier and increased Defense</color> to all allies for 2 turns every turn.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n毎ターン味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>シールドと防御力</color>UP効果を2ターンの間付与する。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n使全体友军每回合获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾和防御力</color>提升效果，持续2回合。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n每回合在2回合內賦予全體我軍<color=#28d9ed>護盾及防禦力</color>增加效果。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n모든 공격은 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태의 적에게 최대 체력의 2%만큼 <color=#28d9ed>고정 피해</color>를 입힙니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nWhen attacking an enemy inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color>, all attacks deal 2% of the target's Max Health as <color=#28d9ed>fixed damage</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nすべての攻撃は<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の敵に最大HPの2%の<color=#28d9ed>固定ダメージ</color>を与える。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n所有攻击对处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态的敌人造成相当于生命值上限2%的<color=#28d9ed>固定伤害</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n所有攻擊對處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態的敵人造成相當於最大生命力2%的<color=#28d9ed>固定傷害</color>。

Korean: 자신은 2턴 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color> 상태가 된 이후 적 전체를 공격합니다. 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동게이지</color>를 40% 감소 시킵니다.
English: Grants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to the caster for 2 turns, then attacks all enemies. Reduces <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of all enemies by 40%.
Japanese: 自分に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を2ターンの間付与した後、敵全体にダメージを与える。敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を40%DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: 使自身获得<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，持续2回合后，攻击全体敌人。使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低40%。
China_Traditional: 自身在2回合內進入<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>狀態後，攻擊全體敵人。使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>減少40%。

Korean: 적 대상을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 15% 감소 시킵니다.\n\n자신이 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 적용받고 있다면 대상의 행동게이지가 50% 추가로 감소시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and reduces <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by 15%.\n\nIf the caster has a <color=#28d9ed>buff</color>, reduces Priority of the target by an additional 50%.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を15%DOWNさせる。\n\n自分に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がある場合、対象の行動ゲージを50%追加でDOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人目标，并使<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低15%。\n\n若自身处于<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>状态，则使目标行动值额外降低50%。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人目標，使<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>減少15%。\n\n若自身正套用<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>時，使目標的速攻值額外減少50%。

Korean: (발동 효과) 단일 공격 이후 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>추가 공격</color>을 사용합니다. 그 이후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동게이지</color>가 15% 회복 됩니다.
English: (Triggered Effect) After attacking with a single-target attack, performs an <color=#28d9ed>additional attack</color> against all enemies. Then, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by 15%.
Japanese: (発動効果)単体攻撃後、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>追加攻撃</color>を与える。その後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が15%UPする。
China_Simplified: (触发效果)发动单一攻击后，对全体敌人发动<color=#28d9ed>额外攻击</color>。随后使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>恢复15%。
China_Traditional: (發動效果)單一攻擊後，對全體敵人發動<color=#28d9ed>追加攻擊</color>。之後使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>恢復15%。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 WG 2 회복하고, 치명 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>서릿발 꽂기</color>를 사용합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nRecovers Weakness Gauge by 2 every turn, and upon taking a critical hit, activates <color=#28d9ed>Impaling Frostblow</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n毎ターンWGを2回復し、会心ダメージを受けた場合、<color=#28d9ed>【霜柱召喚】</color>を使用する。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n每回合恢复2点WG，且受到暴击时，使用<color=#28d9ed>投掷寒霜之箭</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n每回合WG恢復2，受到暴擊攻擊時，使用<color=#28d9ed>刺入寒霜之箭</color>。

Japanese: 吹雪の舞
China_Simplified: 雪人之舞
China_Traditional: 暴雪之舞

Korean: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52671_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and increases the <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52671_1]</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52671_1]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52671_1]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52671_1]</color>。

Korean: 빙결이 없는 대상들의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52672_2]개</color> 해제 후 적 전체를 공격합니다. 이 스킬로 빙결 대상에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.
English: Removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52672_2]</color> buff(s) from targets not inflicted with Frozen, then attacks all enemies. Increases damage dealt to targets inflicted with Frozen.
Japanese: 凍結がない対象の強化効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52672_2]個</color>解除した後、敵全体にダメージを与える。このスキルは凍結がある対象に与えるダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: 解除未处于冰冻状态目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52672_2]个</color>强化效果后，攻击全体敌人。该技能对处于冰冻状态的目标造成的伤害提升。
China_Traditional: 解除身上沒有冰凍效果的目標們的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52672_2]個</color>強化效果後，攻擊全體敵人。對因此技能冰凍的目標造成的傷害增加。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n공격 후 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>을 부여하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_3]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nAfter attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_2] turn(s)</color> and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_3] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n攻撃後、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_2]ターン</color>の間付与し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_3]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_3]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_2]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_2]回合</color>，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_3]</color>的几率造成<color=#28d9ed>速度降低</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_3]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n攻擊後，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_2]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_2]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>冰凍</color>效果，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_element_52673_3]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52673_3]回合</color>內賦予<color=#28d9ed>速度減少</color>。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

English: Grim Ice Wall
Japanese: 冷厳な氷壁
China_Simplified: 冷峻冰壁

China_Traditional: 刺入寒霜之箭

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 적 전체를 공격합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고, WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화 돌입 시, 적의 CP를 15 감소시킵니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>피의 광란</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하여 큰 피해를 입히고, <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_714]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2개</color> 부여합니다.(저항 무시)
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower, and attacks all enemies.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns and recovers [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1] Weakness Gauge. Upon becoming Enraged, reduces the enemy's Chain Points by 15. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Blood Frenzy</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies, dealing heavy damage, and has a <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>2 stacks</color> of <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_714] turn(s)</color>. (Ignores Resilience)
Japanese:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、敵全体にダメージを与える。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】に切り替わる時、敵のCPを15DOWNさせる。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【血の狂乱】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体に大ダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>出血</color><color=#28d9ed>2個</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_714]</color>の間付与する。(抵抗無視)
China_Simplified:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并攻击全体敌人。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复
[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。陷入狂暴化时，使敌人CP降低15。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>血之狂乱</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人，造成巨额伤害，并有<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>2个</color><color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_714]回合</color>。(无视抵抗)
China_Traditional:
若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，攻擊全體敵人。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]的WG。進入狂暴化時，使敵人的CP減少15。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>鮮血狂亂</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人，造成強大傷害，並以<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_roguelight_714]回合</color>內賦予目標<color=#28d9ed>2個</color><color=#28d9ed>出血</color>。(無視抵抗)

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 종료 시, <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 보유하고 있었다면 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>의 지속 시간이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4038003_4_1]턴</color> 증가합니다.\n공격력이 감소하지 않았을 때 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> 감소합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nWhen inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> at the end of the turn, increases the duration of <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4038003_4_1] turn(s)</color>.\nReduces Weakness Gauge damage taken while not under the effect of reduced Attack by <color=#28d9ed>40%</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン終了時、自分が<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>状態の場合、<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4038003_4_1]ターン</color>増加する。\n攻撃力がDOWNしていない場合、受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>DOWNする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n回合结束时，若附带<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果，则使<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>的持续时间增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4038003_4_1]回合</color>。\n若攻击力未降低，则所受WG伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n回合結束時，若具有<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>的持續時間增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4038003_4_1]回合</color>。\n攻擊力未減少時，受到的WG傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 아군 전체의 피해를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_13537]</color> 증가 시킵니다. (최대 15회 누적)
English: Attacks an enemy. After attacking, increases damage dealt by all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_13537]</color>. (Max 15 stacks)
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、味方全体の与えるダメージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_13537]</color>UPさせる。この効果は最大15回まで累積する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。攻击后使全体友军的伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_13537]</color>。(最多可叠加15次)
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。攻擊後，使全體我軍的傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_13537]</color>。(最多累積15次)

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_fire_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_1]턴</color> 동안 자신의 방어력이 증가합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_fire_1]</color> chance to increase Defense of the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_1] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_fire_1]</color>の確率で自分の防御力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_1]ターン</color>の間UPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_fire_1]</color>的几率使自身防御力提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_1]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_fire_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_1]回合</color>內自身的防禦力增加。

Korean: 아군 2인의 <color=#28d9ed>협공</color>을 발생시킵니다.
English: Activates a <color=#28d9ed>Dual Attack</color> from 2 allies.
Japanese: 味方2体に<color=#28d9ed>連携</color>を発生させる。
China_Simplified: 使2名友军发动<color=#28d9ed>夹攻</color>。
China_Traditional: 使2名我軍發動<color=#28d9ed>夾攻</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_3]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>상태로 만듭니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体敌人陷入<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_fire_3]回合</color>內使全體敵人進入<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>狀態。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_water_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_1]턴</color> 동안 자신의 공격력이 증가합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_water_1]</color> chance to increase Attack of the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_1] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_water_1]</color>の確率で自分の攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_1]ターン</color>の間UPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_water_1]</color>的几率使自身攻击力提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_1]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_doppelganger_water_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_1]回合</color>內自身的攻擊力增加。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_3]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>방어력 감소</color>를 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Defense</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>防御力DOWN</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>防御力降低</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_water_3]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>防禦力減少</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 자신의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_earth_1]</color> 회복합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and heals the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_earth_1]</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_earth_1]</color>回復する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使自身生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_earth_1]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，自身的生命力恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_earth_1]</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_earth_3]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>공격력 감소</color>를 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Attack</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_earth_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力DOWN</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_earth_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>攻击力降低</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_earth_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_earth_3]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力減少</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 자신의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color> 회복합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使自身行动值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，自身的速攻值恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_light_3]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>속도 감소</color>를 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Speed</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_light_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_light_3]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>速度降低</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_light_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_light_3]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>速度減少</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 자신의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_dark_1]</color> 회복합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and heals the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_dark_1]</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_dark_1]</color>回復する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使自身生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_dark_1]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，自身的生命力恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_dark_1]</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_dark_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만듭니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_dark_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_dark_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使敌人陷入<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_dark_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_doppelganger_dark_3]回合</color>內進入<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>狀態。

Korean: 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> : 영구적으로 WG 피해를 받지 않고, 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과가 부여됩니다. 해당 효과들은 해제되지 않습니다.
English: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Permanently stops taking Weakness Gauge damage, and grants an effect that increases Attack and reduces damage taken. This effect cannot be removed.
Japanese: 最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：WGダメージを受けず、攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を付与する。この効果は解除されない。
China_Simplified: 若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>：永久不受WG伤害，并使攻击力提升/伤害降低。该效果不会被解除。
China_Traditional: 若生命力降到最大生命力<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>：永久不會受到WG傷害，並賦予攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果。這些效果不會被解除。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n전투 입장 시 해제 불가능한 면역을 얻습니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of battle, grants irremovable Immunity.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、解除不可能な免疫を付与する。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，获得无法被解除的免疫效果。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n進入戰鬥時，獲得無法被解除的免疫。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n전투 입장 시 자신을 제외한 아군 전체에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>을 부여하지만, 속도를 0으로 만듭니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nGrants irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to all allies except for the caster at the start of battle, while making their Speed to 0.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、自分を除く味方全体に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を付与し、スピードを0にする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，使除自身外的全体友军获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，使速度变为0。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n進入戰鬥時，賦予自身除外的全體我軍無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>，但使速度變為0。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_164]턴</color> 동안 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 감소시킵니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, and inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_164] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_164]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并使目标<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_164]\n回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，使敌人无法触发反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_164]回合</color>內使目標的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>減少。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, 대상 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_165]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여하고, 자신에게는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_166]턴</color>  동안 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중</color>, <color=#28d9ed>속도</color> 증가 효과를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_165] turn(s)</color>, and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_166] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.

Greatly increases damage taken from Burst Skills of enemies.
Increases Priority recovery efficiency of all allies and enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_367]</color>.
Fixed damage does not exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_315]</color>. However, fixed damage from Skill Chains can deal up to a maximum of <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_368]</color> damage.

China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n该攻击目标越少，则伤害越高。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n此攻擊的傷害會隨目標數量減少而提升。

Korean: (발동 효과) <color=#28d9ed>적은 어디냐… / 네가 적인가…</color>로 적을 처치하거나, <color=#28d9ed>적은 어디냐…</color>의 공격 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>마법형</color>이 아닐 경우 적 전체에게 공격합니다.\n이 공격은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 무시합니다.
English: (Triggered Effect) When an enemy is killed by <color=#28d9ed>Lead Me to the Enemy.../You Must be the Enemy...</color>, or when attacking a non-<color=#28d9ed>Mage</color> target with <color=#28d9ed>Lead Me to the Enemy...</color>, attacks all enemies.\nThis attack ignores the target's Defense by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>.
Japanese: (発動効果)<color=#28d9ed>【敵はどこだ…】/【オマエが敵か…】</color>で敵を倒した場合、または<color=#28d9ed>【敵はどこだ…】</color>で攻撃した対象が<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>以外の場合、敵全体にダメージを与える。\nこの攻撃は対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>無視する。
China_Simplified: (触发效果)使用<color=#28d9ed>敌人在哪里……/敌人就是你吗……</color>击杀敌人，或者<color=#28d9ed>敌人在哪里……</color>的攻击目标为非<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>时，攻击全体敌人。\n该攻击无视目标防御力的<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。
China_Traditional: (發動效果)使用<color=#28d9ed>敵人在何處…/敵人就是你嗎…</color>消滅敵人，或是<color=#28d9ed>敵人在何處…</color>的攻擊目標非<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>時，攻擊全體敵人。\n此攻擊無視目標<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的防禦力。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
명속성 적은 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> 증가합니다. (영구 지속)
적 전체의 행동 게이지 증가 효율을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_499]</color> 증가시키는 대신 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다.
공격이 아닌 스킬을 사용한 적은 치명 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가합니다. (최대 3회 누적)
매 턴 자신의 방어력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_501]</color> 증가하지만, <color=#28d9ed>브레이크 시</color> 초기화 됩니다.
저주 및 고정 피해로 받는 피해는 각각 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Light enemies gain <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> increased <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color>. (Permanent)
Increases the Priority Increase efficiency of all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_499]</color>, but reduces their <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.
Enemies that use non-attack skills take <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> increased Critical Damage. (Max 3 stacks)
Increases the caster's Defense by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_501]</color> each turn, but resets upon being inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Break</color>.
Damage taken from Curse and Fixed Damage does not exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color> respectively.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
光属性の敵は<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>UPする。(永続効果)
敵全体の行動ゲージUPの効率を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_499]</color>UPさせる代わりに、<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>50％</color>DOWNさせる。
攻撃以外のスキルを使用した敵は会心ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>100％</color>UPする。(最大3回まで累積)
毎ターン、自分の防御力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_501]</color>UPするが、<color=#28d9ed>ブレイク時</color>リセットされる。
呪い/固定ダメージで受けるダメージはそれぞれ<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>を超えない。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
光属性敌人的<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>。(永久持续)
使全体敌人的行动值提升效率提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_499]</color>，但<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。
使用非攻击类技能的敌人造成的暴击伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。(最多可叠加3次)
每回合自身防御力提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_501]</color>，<color=#28d9ed>力竭时</color>重置。
因诅咒和固定伤害而所受伤害分别不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
光屬性敵人<color=#28d9ed>貫穿力</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>。(永久持續)
使全體敵人的速攻值增加效率增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_499]</color>，但<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>減少<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。
使用非攻擊技能的敵人暴擊傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。（最多累積3次）
雖然每回合自身的防禦力增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_501]</color>，但<color=#28d9ed>休息時</color>將重置。
因詛咒與固定傷害受到的傷害分別不會超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_418]턴</color> 동안 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 감소시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_418] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_418]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_418]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_418]回合</color>內使目標的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>減少。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_419]턴</color> 동안 아군과 적군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 증가시킵다. (해제 불가)
English: Attacks an enemy, and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> to all allies and enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_419] turn(s)</color>. (Irremovable)
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、味方と敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_419]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。(解除不可)
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使全体友军和敌军的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_419]回合</color>。(无法解除)
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_419]回合</color>內使我軍和敵軍全體的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>增加。(無法解除)

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_420]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_420]</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 획득합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies, and gains a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> equal to <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_420]</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_420] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_420]</color>の<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_420]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并获得<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_420]</color>的<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_420]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_420]回合</color>內獲得<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_420]</color>的<color=#28d9ed>護盾</color>。

Korean: 적 전체의 공격력이 모두 감소하지만, 적이 공격이 아닌 스킬 사용 시 자신은 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_422]</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>고정 피해</color>를 입습니다.\n화속성 적에게 받는 피해가 감소하고, 지속성 적에게 받는 피해가 증가합니다.\n실드 보유 시 WG 피해를 받지 않습니다.
English: Reduces Attack of all enemies, but the caster takes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_422]</color> <color=#28d9ed>fixed damage</color> when an enemy uses a non-attack skill.\nReduces damage taken from Fire enemies, and increases damage taken from Earth enemies.\nImmune to Weakness Gauge damage while granted a Barrier.
Japanese: 敵全体の攻撃力がすべてDOWNするが、敵が攻撃以外のスキル使用時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_422]</color>の<color=#28d9ed>固定ダメージ</color>を与える。\n火属性の敵に受けるダメージがDOWNし、地属性の敵に受けるダメージがUPする。\nシールド状態の場合、WGダメージを受けない。
China_Simplified: 降低全体敌人的攻击力，若敌人使用非攻击类技能时，则自身受到<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_422]</color>的<color=#28d9ed>固定伤害</color>。\n降低火属性敌人造成的伤害，提升土属性敌人造成的伤害。\n附带护盾时不会受到WG伤害。
China_Traditional: 全體敵人的攻擊力減少，但當敵人使用非攻擊技能時，自身會受到<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_422]</color>的<color=#28d9ed>固定傷害</color>。\n火屬性敵人造成的傷害減少，但大地屬性敵人造成的傷害增加。\n具有護盾後，不會受到WG傷害。

Korean:
4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>오답의 대가</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체에게 큰 피해를 입힙니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>The Price of a Wrong Answer</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Deals heavy damage to all enemies.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間継続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【過ちの代価】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体に大ダメージを与える。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。
狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>错误代价</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
对全体敌人造成致命伤害。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>錯誤的代價</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
對全體敵人造成致命傷害。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_502]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 획득합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy. Upon attack, gains a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_502] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_502]ターン</color>の間、<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を獲得する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。攻击后，获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_502]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。攻擊後，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_502]回合</color>內獲得<color=#28d9ed>護盾</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력/치명 확률/치명 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_503]턴</color> 동안 감소시키고, <color=#28d9ed>회복형</color>이 아닌 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 모두 감소시킵니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Upon attack, decreases all Enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Attack/Critical Hit Chance/Critical Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_503] turns,</color> and reduces the <color=#28d9ed>Priority Gauge</color> of all non-<color=#28d9ed>Healer</color> Enemies to zero.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力/会心率/会心ダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_503]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせ、<color=#28d9ed>回復型</color>以外の敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を全てDOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力/暴击率/暴击伤害</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_503]回合</color>。使非<color=#28d9ed>恢复型</color>全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>全部减少。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力/暴擊率/暴擊傷害</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_503]回合</color>內減少，使非<color=#28d9ed>恢復型</color>的全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>全部減少。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 모두 해제시키고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_510]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>를 부여합니다.\n공격 후 추가 턴을 획득합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Upon attack, removes all <color=#28d9ed>Enhancement Effects</color> from all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_510] turns</color>.\nGrants an extra turn after attack.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を全て解除させ、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_510]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を付与する。\n攻撃後、追加ターンを獲得する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，解除全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_510]回合</color>。\n攻击后，获得额外回合。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。攻擊後，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>全部解除，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_510]回合</color>內賦予<color=#28d9ed>無法強化</color>。\n攻擊後，獲得追加回合。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
모든 공격 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.

단일 공격으로 피격 시 최종 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_514]</color> 감소하고, WG 피해를 받지 않습니다. 추가로 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_513]</color> 회복합니다. (최종 피해 감소는 가장 높은 값만 적용)

적이 공격이 아닌 스킬 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_515]</color>의 고정 피해를 2회 입습니다.

적이 <color=#28d9ed>버스트 스킬/협공/스킬 체인</color>을 제외한 행동을 할 때마다 암속성 적 전체의 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_516_child]</color> 증가합니다.

암속성이 아닌 적의 AP 소모량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_517]</color> 증가합니다.

보스가 입는 <color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.

모든 공격은 대상이 적을 수록 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Right after all attacks, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.

When hit by a single-target attack, final damage is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_514]</color>, and Weakness Gauge damage is not taken. Additionally, Weakness Gauge is recovered by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_513]</color>. (Only the highest final damage reduction value applies.)

When an Enemy uses a skill that is not an attack, they take <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_515]</color> Fixed Damage twice.

Each time an Enemy takes an action other than <color=#28d9ed>Burst Skill/Dual Attack/Skill Chain</color>, all Dark Enemies’ damage increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_516_child]</color>.

The Action Point cost for non-Dark Enemies increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_517]</color>.

The<color=#28d9ed>Cursed/Fixed Damage</color> the boss receives cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>.

All attacks deal more damage the fewer targets there are.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
すべての攻撃直後には敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n가장 <color=#28d9ed>좌측</color>에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격하며 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>회복형</color>이 아닐 경우 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>피해 감소</color> 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_471]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.

Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n一番<color=#28d9ed>左側</color>にいる敵を優先的に攻撃し、対象が<color=#28d9ed>回復型</color>でない場合、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>ダメージDOWN</color>効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_471]ターン</color>の間付与する。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
수속성 적에게 받는 피해가 증가하고, 수속성이 아닌 적의 효과 적중을 0으로 만듭니다.
약화 효과 보유 대상에게 피격 시 적의 CP가 30 감소합니다.
공격 후 자신이 해제 가능한 강화 효과를 보유했다면 WG를 10% 회복합니다.
협공으로 받는 WG 피해가 100% 증가합니다.
<color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_336]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
모든 공격은 대상이 적을 수록 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Takes Increased Damage from Water enemies, and sets the Effectiveness of non-Water enemies to 0.
When hit by enemies with a debuff, reduces their Chain Points by 30.
After attacking, if the caster has a removable Enhancement Effect, restores Weakness Gauge by 10%.
Takes 100% more Weakness Gauge Damage from Dual Attacks.
<color=#28d9ed>Cursed / Fixed Damage</color> is capped at <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_336]</color>.
Increases damage of all attacks inversely proportional to the number of targets.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
水属性の敵に受けるダメージがUPし、水属性以外の敵の効果命中を0にする。
弱体効果のある対象からダメージを受けた時、敵のCPを30DOWNさせる。
攻撃後、自分に解除可能な強化効果がある場合、WGを10%回復する。
連携で受けるWGダメージが100%UPする。
<color=#28d9ed>呪い・固定ダメージ</color>で受けるダメージは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_336]</color>を超えない。
すべての攻撃は対象が少ないほどダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified:
(被動效果)
水屬性敵人造成的傷害增加，非水屬性敵人的效果命中變為0。
受到具有弱化效果的目標攻擊時，敵人的CP減少30。
攻擊後，若自身具有可解除的強化效果，WG恢復10%。
夾攻所造成的WG傷害增加100%。
<color=#28d9ed>詛咒/固定傷害</color>的傷害不會超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_336]</color>。
所有攻擊造成的傷害會隨目標數量減少而提升。

After attacking, inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance/Critical Damage</color> on the caster and all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_267] turn(s)</color>, and <color=#28d9ed>detonates</color> all <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> stacks on the target.

English: Attacks an enemy, and increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the ally with the highest Attack by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_253]</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、最も攻撃力が高い味方単体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_253]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使攻击力最高的友军<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_253]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，使攻擊力最高的我軍<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>\n增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_253]</color>。

Korean: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_254]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>를 증가시킵니다.
English: Grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_254] turn(s)</color>.

China_Simplified: 使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>和<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_254]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_254]回合</color>內使全體我軍的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>及<color=#28d9ed>暴擊傷害</color>\n增加。

Korean: 적을 공격하고 대상 모두에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_256]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>을 부여합니다.\n공격 후 공격력이 가장 높은 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_257]</color> 증가시킵니다. 해당 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 증가한 상태라면, 대상의 스킬 쿨타임을 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 감소시킵니다.

If the ally target is granted increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color>, <color=#28d9ed>fully</color> reduces skill cooldowns of the target.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象全体に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_256]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n攻撃後、最も攻撃力が高い味方単体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_257]</color>UPさせる。その対象の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>がUPした状態の場合、対象のスキルターンを<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>減少させる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并使所有目标获得<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_256]回合</color>。\n攻击后，使攻击力最高的友军<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_257]</color>。若该目标的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>处于提升状态，则使目标的技能冷却时间<color=#28d9ed>全部</color>减少。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_256]回合</color>內賦予所有目標<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>。\n攻擊後，使攻擊力最高的我軍<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_257]</color>。若該目標的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>處於增加的狀態，使目標的技能冷卻時間<color=#28d9ed>全部</color>減少。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 감소시킵니다. (면역 및 효과 저항 무시, 해제 불가)\n턴 시작 시 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 해제시킵니다. (대상의 효과 저항 무시)
English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> of all enemies. (Ignores the target's Resilience and Immunity, Irremovable)\nAt the start of the turn, removes <color=#28d9ed>all</color> <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> from all enemies. (Ignores the target's Resilience)
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>をDOWNさせる。(免疫および効果抵抗無視、解除不可)\nターン開始時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除する。(対象の効果抵抗無視)
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低。(无视免疫和效果抵抗，无法解除)\n回合开始时，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color><color=#28d9ed>全部</color>解除。(无视目标的效果抵抗)
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>減少。(無視免疫及效果抵抗、無法解除)\n回合開始時，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color><color=#28d9ed>全部</color>解除。(無視目標的效果抵抗)

Korean: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4214002_2_1]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 증가시킵니다. 스킬 사용 후 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.

Japanese: 味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>と<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4214002_2_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。スキル使用後、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。

China_Traditional: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4214002_2_1]回合</color>內使全體我軍的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>及<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>增加。使用技能後，獲得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격 합니다. 방어력 증가 버프가 없는 대상은 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target's Defense on targets not granted Increased Defense.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。防御力UP効果がない対象は、防御力を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視する。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。无视未附带防御力提升效果目标的<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>防御力。\n此技能发动后，使敌人无法触发反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。無視未具有防禦力增加增益效果目標<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的防禦力。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n적 행동 시 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color> 증가합니다. 자신에게 강화 효과가 있다면 추가로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color> 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nWhen an enemy performs an action, increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>. When the caster is granted a buff, additionally increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n敵の行動時、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>UPする。自分に強化効果がある場合、追加で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n敌人行动时，使自身行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>。若自身附带强化效果，则额外提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n敵人行動時，自身的速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>。自身具有強化效果時，額外增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
적 행동 시 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color> 증가합니다. 자신에게 강화 효과가 있다면 추가로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color> 증가합니다.

화속성이 아닌 적 행동 시 WG는 3 회복하며, 화속성이 아닌 적의 효과 적중과 효과 저항이 감소합니다.
방어력 증가 상태의 적에게 받는 피해가 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
When an enemy performs an action, increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>. When the caster is granted a buff, additionally increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>.

Recovers 3 Weakness Gauge when a non-Fire enemy performs an action, and reduces Effectiveness and Resilience of non-Fire enemies.
Increases damage taken from enemies with increased Defense.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
敵の行動時、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>UPする。自分に強化効果がある場合、追加で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>UPする。

火属性以外の敵が行動時、WGを3回復し、火属性以外の敵の効果命中と効果抵抗をDOWNさせる。
防御力UP状態の敵から受けるダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
敌人行动时，使自身行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>。若自身附带强化效果，则额外提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>。

非火属性敌人行动时，WG恢复3，且使非火属性敌人的效果命中和效果抵抗降低。
防御力提升状态敌人带来的伤害提升。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
敵人行動時，自身的速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_1]</color>。自身具有強化效果時，額外增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4314002_12_2]</color>。

非火屬性敵人行動時，WG恢復3；非火屬性敵人的效果命中與效果抵抗減少。
處於防禦力增加狀態的敵人造成的傷害增加。

Korean:
4턴마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color> 증가합니다. 해당 효과는 최대 3회 누적되며, 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/대미지 감소와 실드 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>폭군, 강림</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격합니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns, and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack, reduces damage taken, and grants a Barrier for 3 turns. Recovers [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1] Weakness Gauge. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Descent of the Tyrant</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>UPする。この効果は最大3回まで累積し、ブレイクすると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWNとシールド効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【暴君、降臨】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与える。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>。该效果最多可叠加3次，且将持续至进入力竭状态为止。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低及护盾效果，持续3回合，使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>暴君，降临</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，攻擊力及速度增加
<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_turn]</color>。此效果最多累積3次，持續至進入休息前為止。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少以及護盾效果，並恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>暴君，降臨</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人。

China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_349]回合</color>內獲得<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 대상 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_350]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>를 부여합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 면역과 효과 저항을 무시하며, 해제되지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_350] turn(s)</color>. This effect ignores the target's Immunity and Resilience, and cannot be removed.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象全体に<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_350]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の免疫と効果抵抗を無視し、解除されない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，对全体目标造成<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_350]回合</color>。\n该效果无视目标的免疫和效果抵抗，且不会被解除。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_350]回合</color>內賦予全體目標<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>。此效果無視目標的免疫及效果抵抗，且不會被解除。

Korean: 지속성 적에게 받는 피해가 증가하지만, 지속성이 아닌 적에게 받는 피해가 감소합니다.\n\n고정 피해로 받는 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_351]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
English: Increases damage taken from Earth enemies, but reduces damage taken from non-Earth enemies.\n\nDamage taken from fixed damage does not exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_351]</color>.
Japanese: 地属性の敵から受けるダメージがUPするが、地属性以外の敵から受けるダメージはDOWNする。\n\n固定ダメージで受けるダメージは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_351]</color>を超えない。
China_Simplified: 受到来自土属性敌人的伤害提升，但受到来自非土属性敌人的伤害降低。\n\n固定伤害的所受伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_351]</color>。
China_Traditional: 雖然大地屬性敵人造成的傷害增加，非大地屬性敵人造成的傷害減少。\n\n固定傷害所造成的傷害不會超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_351]</color>。

Korean:
치명 피격 시 대상의 공격력을 영구적으로 감소시킵니다. 이 효과는 대상의 면역과 효과 저항을 무시하며, 해제되지 않습니다.

공격력이 감소한 적에게 받는 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_353]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.

턴 종료 시 자신이 보유한 강화 효과의 지속 턴이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_354]턴</color> 증가합니다.
English:
Upon taking a critical hit, permanently inflicts reduced Attack on the target. This effect ignores the target's Immunity and Resilience, and cannot be removed.

Damage taken from an enemy inflicted with reduced Attack does not exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_353]</color>.

At the end of the turn, increases duration of buffs granted to the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_354] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese:
会心ダメージを受けた場合、対象の攻撃力を永続的にDOWNする。この効果は対象の免疫と効果抵抗を無視し、解除されない。

攻撃力がDOWNした敵から受けるダメージは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_353]</color>を超えない。

ターン終了時、自分の強化効果の持続ターンが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_354]ターン</color>増加する。
China_Simplified:
受到暴击时，使目标的攻击力永久降低。该效果无视目标的免疫和效果抵抗，且不会被解除。

受到来自攻击力降低敌人的伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_353]</color>。

回合结束时，自身附带的强化效果的持续回合提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_354]回合</color>。
China_Traditional:
受到暴擊時，使目標的攻擊力永久減少。此效果無視目標的免疫及效果抵抗，且不會被解除。

攻擊力減少的敵人所造成的傷害不會超過
<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_353]</color>。

回合結束時，自身具有的強化效果持續回合增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_354]回合</color>。

Korean:
4턴마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>절망을 수확하는 낫</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고, 대상이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>를 폭발시킵니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns and recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Despair Reaper</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies, and detonates <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> stacks on the target.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【絶望を貪るカマ】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を破裂させる。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>绝望收割镰</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人，引爆目标附带的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>效果。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>收割絕望的鐮刀</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人，使目標具有的<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>引爆。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
스킬 체인을 제외한 모든 WG 피해를 받지않습니다.
행동 중 아군에게 약화 효과가 적용 된 경우 <color=#28d9ed>완성 : 변이체 확산</color>으로 반격합니다. 반격 시 스킬 쿨타임의 영향을 주거나 받지 않습니다.
매 턴 시작 시 자신이 받는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_494]</color> 감소합니다. (최대 5회 누적)
공격이 아닌 스킬을 사용한 적은 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_495_1]</color> 증가합니다. (최대 5회 누적)
모든 공격은 대상이 적을수록 피해가 크게 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Immune to all Weakness Gauge Damage except Skill Chains.
If an ally is inflicted with a debuff during the turn, counterattacks with <color=#28d9ed>Completion: Mutant Spread</color>.
Counterattacks are not affected by skill cooldowns.
At the start of each turn, reduces Damage Taken by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_494]</color> (stacks up to 5 times).
Enemies using non-attack skills take increased damage <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_495_1]</color> (stacks up to 5 times).
Deals more damage to fewer targets.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
チェーンスキル以外のすべてのWGダメージを受けない。
行動中、味方に弱体効果が適用された場合<color=#28d9ed>完成：変異体拡散</color>で反撃する。反撃時、スキルターンの影響は受けない。
毎ターン開始時、自分の受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_494]</color>DOWNする。(最大5回まで累積)
攻撃以外のスキルを使用した敵はダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_495_1]</color>UPする。(最大5回まで累積)
すべての攻撃は対象の数が少ないほど、ダメージが大きくUPする。
China_Simplified:
（被动效果）
不会受到除了连锁技能以外的所有WG伤害。
行动中若我军受到弱化效果，将以<color=#28d9ed>完成：变异体扩散</color>进行反击。 反击时不会造成或受到技能冷却时间的影响。
每回合开始时，自身所受伤害量减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_494]</color>。（最多累积5次） 
使用非攻击技能的敌人，所受伤害量将增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_495_1]</color>。（最多累积5次）
随目标数量减少，所有攻击的伤害将会增加。
China_Traditional:
（被動效果）
不會受到除了連鎖技能以外的所有WG傷害。
行動中若我軍受到弱化效果，將以<color=#28d9ed>完成：變異體擴散</color>進行反擊。 反擊時不會造成或受到技能冷卻時間的影響。
每回合開始時，自身所受傷害量減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_494]</color>。（最多累積5次） 
使用非攻擊技能的敵人，所受傷害量將增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_495_1]</color>。（最多累積5次）
隨目標數量減少，所有攻擊的傷害將會增加。

(패시브 효과)

적 속도형 캐릭터가 행동했다면 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4079001_12_5]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> granted to the caster.
When an enemy Defender takes an action, increases <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> of all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4079001_12_4] turn(s)</color>.
When an enemy Ranger takes an action, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4079001_12_5]</color>.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_211]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 필살기</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체에게 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_212]</color>를 감소시킨 후 공격합니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns and recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_211]. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Reduces all enemies' Health by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_212]</color> of Max Health, then attacks.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP/ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_211]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターン間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【必殺スキル】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体の最大HPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_212]</color>DOWNさせた後、敵全体にダメージを与える。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_211]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化必杀技</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
对全体敌人造成相当于生命值上限<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_212]</color>的伤害后攻击。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：在3回合內賦予自身不會被解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，並恢復[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_211]的WG。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化必殺技</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
使全體敵人的最大生命力減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_212]</color>後，進行攻擊。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
전투 시작 시 자신의, <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가합니다.

레지나가 생존 시 영구적으로 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>레지나의 세계</color>를 적용 받습니다.
매 턴 자신의 공격력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>증가 합니다. (최대 20회 누적)
English:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>.
When Regina is alive, grants a permanent irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Regina's World</color>.
Every turn, increases Attack of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>. (Max 20 stacks)
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>UPする。
ダメージを受けた後、対象が命中UP状態でない場合、WGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_4_1_1]</color>回復し、自分がミスヒットのダメージを受けた時、HPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_4_2]</color>回復する。
戦場に【レジーナ】がいる場合、解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>【レジーナワールド】</color>を付与する。
毎ターン自分の攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>UPする。(最大20階まで累積)
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
战斗开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。
受到攻击后，目标未处于命中提升状态时，WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_4_1_1]</color>，自身闪避受到的攻击时，生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_4_2]</color>。
蕾吉纳生存时，获得永久无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>蕾吉纳的世界</color>效果。
每回合自身的攻击力提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>。(最多可叠加20次)
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
戰鬥開始時，自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。
受擊後，若目標未處於命中增加狀態，恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_4_1_1]</color>的WG，自身受到擊偏的攻擊時，恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_4_2]</color>的生命力。
雷吉娜生存時，將永久套用不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>雷吉娜的天下</color>。
每回合自身的攻擊力增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>。(最多累積20次)

Korean: 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_2_1]개</color> 해제 후 적 전체를 공격하고, 1턴 동안 빙결 상태로 만듭니다.
English: Removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_2_1]</color> buff(s), then attacks all enemies, and inflicts Frozen for 1 turn.
Japanese: 強化効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_2_1]個</color>解除した後、敵全体にダメージを与え、凍結を1ターンの間付与する。
China_Simplified: 解除<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_2_1]个</color>强化效果后，攻击全体敌人，并对其造成冰冻效果，持续1回合。
China_Traditional: 解除<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_2_1]個</color>強化效果後，攻擊全體敵人，在1回合內進入冰凍狀態。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n공격 후 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>을 부여하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nAfter attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1] turn(s)</color> and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n攻撃後、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]回合</color>，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]</color>的几率造成<color=#28d9ed>速度降低</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n攻擊後，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_1]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>冰凍</color>，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000068_3_2]回合</color>內賦予<color=#28d9ed>速度減少</color>。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean: (패시브 효과) 레지나는 항상 빗나감 확률이 10% 증가하며, 전투 입장 시 자신에게 영구적으로 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>레지나의 세계</color>를 부여합니다.\n(발동 효과) 적 공격이 빗나감 발생 시 <color=#28d9ed>쇼 머스트 고 온</color>의 쿨타임이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]턴</color> 감소합니다. 피격 시 대상에게 반격하며 해당 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.(최대 50%)
English: (Passive Effect) Regina’s Miss chance is always increased by 10%, and upon entering battle, she gains an unremovable <color=#28d9ed>Regina’s World</color>.\n(Trigger Effect) When an enemy attack results in a Miss, the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>The Show Must Go On</color> is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]</color> turns. When hit, she counterattacks the attacker. The damage of this skill increases based on her <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> (up to 50%).
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)レジーナは常にミスヒット発生率が10%UPし、戦闘開始時に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>【レジーナワールド】</color>を自身に付与する。\n(パッシブ効果)敵の攻撃がミスヒットした場合、<color=#28d9ed>【ショー・マスト・ゴーオン】</color>のスキルターンが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]</color>ターン減少する。被弾時、対象に反撃する。このスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする(最大50%)。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）蕾吉纳的闪避概率始终提高10%，进入战斗时，为自身赋予无法解除的<color=#28d9ed>蕾吉纳的世界</color>。\n（触发效果）当敌方攻击发生闪避时，<color=#28d9ed>演出不能停</color>的冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]</color>回合。受到攻击时对目标进行反击。该技能的伤害会随着自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提高而增加。（最多50%）

Korean: 대상의 강화 효과를 모두 해제하고 적을 공격합니다. \n이 스킬은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시하며, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.(최대 50%) 강화 해제 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.
English: Removes all buffs from the target and attacks the enemy.\nThis skill ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target’s Defense, and damage dealt increases in proportion to the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color>. (Up to 50%) The buff removal effect ignores the target’s Resilience.
Japanese: 対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>をすべて解除し、敵単体にダメージを与える。\nこのスキルは対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視し、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする(最大50%)。強化効果の解除は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。
China_Simplified: 解除目标的全部<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>并攻击敌人。\n该技能无视目标<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的防御力，自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>越高，造成的伤害越高(最大50%)。强化解除效果无视目标的效果抵抗。

Korean: (패시브 효과) 레지나는 항상 빗나감 확률이 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가하며, <color=#28d9ed>레지나의 세계</color> 보유 시 피해가 크게 증가합니다.\n(발동 효과) 적 공격이 빗나감 발생 시 대상에게 반격하고, <color=#28d9ed>레지나의 세계</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>2회</color> 발생시킵니다. 이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.(최대 50%)
English: (Passive Effect) Regina always gains <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> increased Miss Chance, and deals greatly increased damage while she has <color=#28d9ed>Regina’s World</color>.\n(Trigger Effect) When an enemy attack results in a miss, counterattacks the target and triggers <color=#28d9ed>Regina’s World</color> <color=#28d9ed>2 time(s)</color>. Japanese: (パッシブ効果)レジーナは常にミスヒット確率が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPし、<color=#28d9ed>【レジーナワールド】</color>がある場合、ダメージが大幅にUPする。\n(パッシブ効果)敵の攻撃がミスした時、対象に反撃し、<color=#28d9ed>【レジーナワールド】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2回</color>付与する。このスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする(最大50%)。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)蕾吉纳的未命中几率常驻提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>，持有<color=#28d9ed>蕾吉纳的世界</color>时，伤害大幅增加。\n(触发效果)敌人攻击未命中时，对目标进行反击，并触发<color=#28d9ed>2次</color><color=#28d9ed>蕾吉纳的世界</color>。自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>越高，则该技能伤害越高(最大50%)。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)雷吉娜的擊偏率常駐增加<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>，持有<color=#28d9ed>雷吉娜的天下</color>時，傷害大幅增加。\n(發動效果)敵人攻擊發生擊偏時，對目標進行反擊，並使<color=#28d9ed>雷吉娜的天下</color>發動<color=#28d9ed>2次</color>。此技能造成的傷害隨自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>提升而增加(最大50%)。

This attack increases in damage each time it is used.

China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_1_1]</color>的几率对目标造成无法被解除的烧伤状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_1_1]回合</color>。该效果无视目标的效果抵抗。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_1_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_1_1]回合</color>內使目標進入無法被解除的燒傷狀態。此效果無視目標的效果抵抗。

Korean: 적 전체의 강화 효과를 모두 해제하고 공격합니다. 대상의 화상을 모두 폭발시킵니다.\n한 명이라도 폭발 했다면 적 전체를 <color=#28d9ed>즉사</color> 시킵니다.
English: Removes all buffs from all enemies and attacks. Detonates all Burned effects on the target.\nIf a target was detonated, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Instant Death</color> on all enemies.
Japanese: 敵全体の強化効果をすべて解除し、敵全体にダメージを与える。対象の火傷をすべて破裂させる。\n1体でも破裂した場合、敵全体を<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>させる。
China_Simplified: 解除全体敌人的所有强化效果，并进行攻击。引爆目标身上的所有烧伤效果。\n只要有一名敌人爆发，全体敌人都将<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>。
China_Traditional: 解除全體敵人的所有強化效果並進行攻擊。使目標的燒傷全部引爆。\n若已有一名引爆，使全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>立即死亡</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color> 상태로 만듭니다. (2회 적용) 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시하며, 적 처치 시 쿨타임이 초기화됩니다.
English: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1] turn(s)</color> (Applied 2 times). This effect ignores the target's Resilience, and resets cooldown when an enemy is defeated.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。対象に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>2個を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。敵を倒した場合、スキルターンが初期化する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。对目标造成无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1]回合</color>(可叠加2次)。该效果无视目标的效果抵抗，且击杀敌人时冷却时间重置。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1]回合</color>內使目標進入無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>狀態。(套用2次)此效果無視目標的效果抵抗，消滅敵人時，冷卻時間將會重置。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n전투 시작 시 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>피해 감소</color> 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>병사의 시</color> / <color=#28d9ed>지옥의 묵시록</color> 사용 후 피격 대상 중 화상 상태가 아닌 적이 한 명이라도 있다면 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color> 회복하고, 무작위 아군 한 명을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color> 상태로 만듭니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of battle, grants an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>reduced damage taken</color> effect to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter using <color=#28d9ed>Ballad of a Soldier</color> / <color=#28d9ed>Apocalypse Now</color>, when a target hit is not inflicted with Burned, recovers Weakness Gauge by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color>, and inflicts an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on a random ally for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>ダメージDOWN</color>効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n<color=#28d9ed>【兵士の詩】</color>/<color=#28d9ed>【地獄の黙示録】</color>使用後、ダメージを受けた対象が火傷状態でない場合、WGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color>回復し、ランダムな味方単体に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，自身获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>。\n使用<color=#28d9ed>战士之诗</color> / <color=#28d9ed>地狱启示录</color>后，受击目标中只要存在1名未处于烧伤状态的敌人，则WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color>，并对随机1名友军造成无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n戰鬥開始時，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>內賦予自身不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>傷害減少</color>效果。\n使用<color=#28d9ed>士兵之詩</color>/<color=#28d9ed>地獄啟示錄</color>後，受擊的目標中若有一名敵人非處於燒傷狀態，恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color>的WG，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3]回合</color>內使隨機一名我軍進入無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>燒傷</color>狀態。

(Passive Effect)

China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_2_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_2_1]回合</color>內使目標的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>減少，並以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_2_2]</color>的機率賦予全體我軍<color=#28d9ed>護盾</color>。護盾量隨自身的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提升而增加。

Korean: 적을 공격하고, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000044_2_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.\n적 처치 시 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000044_2_1] turn(s)</color>.\nWhen defeating an enemy, grants an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000044_2_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。\n敵を倒した場合、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，使自身<color=#28d9ed>效果命中</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000044_2_1]回合</color>。\n击杀敌人时，获得<color=#28d9ed>额外回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000044_2_1]回合</color>內使自身的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中</color>增加。\n消滅敵人時，獲得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
전투 시작 시 아군 전체에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>피해 감소</color> 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
아군 전체의 모든 공격은 대상이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>가 많을수록 피해가 증가합니다.
공격 시 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있다면 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_4]</color> 회복합니다.
공격 후 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 보유하지 않았다면 <color=#28d9ed>효과 저항</color>및 <color=#28d9ed>면역</color>을 무시하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_1]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color> 효과를 부여합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, grants an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>reduced damage taken</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s)</color>.
Increases damage dealt by all attacks of all allies proportional to the number of <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> inflicted on the target.
When attacking, if the target is inflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color>, recovers Weakness Gauge by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_4]</color>.
After attacking, if the target is not inflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color>, ignores <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color>, and inflicts an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_1] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時、味方全体に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>ダメージDOWN</color>効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]ターン</color>の間付与する。
味方全体のすべての攻撃は対象の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>の数に応じてダメージがUPする。
攻撃時、対象に<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がある場合、WGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_4]</color>回復する。
攻撃後、対象に<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がない場合、<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>および<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を無視し、解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
战斗开始时，全体友军获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>。
全体友军的所有攻击都是目标附带的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>越多，则造成的伤害越高。
攻击时若目标附带<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，则WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_4]</color>。
攻击后，若目标未附带<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，则无视目标的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>和<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>，并对目标造成无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>触电</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_1]回合</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果)
戰鬥開始時，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>內賦予全體我軍不會被解除的<color=#28d9ed>傷害減少</color>效果。
全體我軍所有攻擊的傷害會隨目標具有的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>數量增加而提升。
攻擊時，若目標具有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，恢復<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_4]</color>的WG。
攻擊後，目標不具有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>時，無視<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>及<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_1]回合</color>內賦予無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>觸電</color>
效果。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_2_1]턴</color> 동안 지속되는 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>를 2회 부여합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
English: Attacks an enemy.\nInflicts <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> twice on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_2_1] turn(s)</color>. This effect ignores the target's Resilience.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n対象に<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>2個を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n对目标造成2次<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_2_1]回合</color>。该效果无视目标的效果抵抗。\n此技能发动后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_2_1]回合</color>內持續賦予目標2次<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>。此效果無視目標的效果抵抗。\n使用此技能後，敵人不會發動反擊、復仇、迅速應對。

Korean: 적을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]</color>的機率在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000062_3_1]回合</color>內使目標的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>減少。

Korean: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color>의 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]개</color> 해제합니다.\n대상이 지속성이라면 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
English: Attacks 2 enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>buff(s)</color> from the target.\nIf the target is Earth element, inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵2体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]個</color>解除する。\n対象が地属性の場合、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
