Japanese: 演算能力強化
China_Simplified: 运算能力强化
China_Traditional: 運算能力強化

Korean: 방진을 갖춰라!
English: Form the Phalanx!
Japanese: 防陣を整えろ！
China_Simplified: 结成方阵！
China_Traditional: 結成方陣！

Korean: 기초적인 트릭
English: Basic Trick
Japanese: 基本的なトリック
China_Simplified: 基础戏法
China_Traditional: 基礎戲法

Korean: 약화 효과 보유 시 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>증가합니다.
English: When afflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>Debuff</color>, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>.
Japanese: 弱化効果を持つと、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>増加。
China_Simplified: 当拥有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。
China_Traditional: 當擁有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>時，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。

Korean: 보유한 강화 효과 수에 비례하여 피해량이 증가합니다.
English: Damage increases in proportion to the number of Buffs possessed.
Japanese: 所持している強化効果の数に応じてダメージが増加。
China_Simplified: 依据所持强化效果数量，造成的伤害增加。
China_Traditional: 依據所持強化效果數量，造成的傷害增加。

Korean: 매 턴 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color> 증가를 부여합니다.
English: Each turn, grants all allies <color=#28d9ed>Defense Up</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
Japanese: 毎ターン、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>防御力UP</color>（<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>）を付与。
China_Simplified: 每回合为我方全体赋予<color=#28d9ed>防御力提升</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 每回合為我方全體賦予<color=#28d9ed>防禦力提升</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

Korean: 빙결이 없는 대상들의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 해제 후 적 전체를 공격합니다. 이 스킬로 빙결 대상에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다. 또한 적 전체를 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 빙결 상태로 만듭니다.
English: Dispels <color=#28d9ed>1 Buff</color> from non-Frozen enemies, then attacks all enemies. Deals increased damage to Frozen targets and <color=#28d9ed>Freezes</color> all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
Japanese: 凍結状態でない対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果1個</color>を解除後、敵全体を攻撃。凍結状態の対象へのダメージが増加し、敵全体を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>凍結状態に。
China_Simplified: 先驱散非冻结目标的<color=#28d9ed>1个强化效果</color>，然后攻击全体敌人。对冻结目标造成的伤害增加，并使全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>冻结</color><color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 先驅散非凍結目標的<color=#28d9ed>1個強化效果</color>，然後攻擊全體敵人。對凍結目標造成的傷害增加，並使全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color><color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n약화 효과를 보유한 대상에게 WG 피해를 받지 않습니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nDoes not take WG damage from targets with Debuffs.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\n弱化効果を持つ対象からWGダメージを受けない。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n对拥有弱化效果的目标不会受到WG伤害。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n對擁有弱化效果的目標不會受到WG傷害。

Korean: (발동 효과) 아군이 전체 공격을 했을 때, 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]턴</color>동안 공격력을 증가시키고, 아군의 마법형 캐릭터는 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3_1]</color> 증가합니다.
English: (Trigger Effect) When an ally uses an AoE attack, increases Attack of all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]</color> turns, and increases Priority of Mage allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3_1]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)味方が全体攻撃を行った時、味方全体の攻撃力を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]</color>ターン増加し、味方の魔法型キャラの行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3_1]</color>増加。
China_Simplified: （触发效果）当我方使用群体攻击时，使全体我方攻击力增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]</color>回合，并使我方<color=#28d9ed>魔法型角色</color>的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3_1]</color>。
China_Traditional: （觸發效果）當我方使用群體攻擊時，使全體我方攻擊力增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]</color>回合，並使我方<color=#28d9ed>魔法型角色</color>的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3_1]</color>。

Korean:
적을 강격으로 공격합니다. 
대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_1]턴</color> 동안 저주를 부여합니다. (해제 불가)
English: Attacks an enemy with a Heavy Strike.\nWith a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_1]</color> chance, inflicts an undispellable <color=#28d9ed>Curse</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_1]</color> turns.
Japanese: 敵を強撃で攻撃。\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_1]</color>の確率で、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_1]</color>ターン持続の解除不可<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を付与。
China_Simplified: 用强击攻击敌人。\n有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_1]</color>概率施加持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_1]</color>回合的不可驱散<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>。
China_Traditional: 用強擊攻擊敵人。\n有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_1]</color>機率施加持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_1]</color>回合的不可驅散<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>。

Korean:
적 전체를 강격으로 공격합니다. 
피해를 준 대상마다 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000086_2_2]</color> 증가하고, 대상 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_2]턴</color> 동안 저주를 부여합니다. (해제 불가)
English: Attacks all enemies with a Heavy Strike.\nFor each target hit, increases own Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000086_2_2]</color>, and with a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_2]</color> chance, inflicts an undispellable <color=#28d9ed>Curse</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_2]</color> turns.
Japanese: 敵全体を強撃で攻撃。\n命中した対象1体ごとに自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000086_2_2]</color>増加。さらに<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_2]</color>の確率で、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_2]</color>ターン持続の解除不可<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を付与。
China_Simplified: 用强击攻击全体敌人。\n每命中一个目标，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000086_2_2]</color>。并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_2]</color>概率施加持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_2]</color>回合的不可驱散<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>。
China_Traditional: 用強擊攻擊全體敵人。\n每命中一個目標，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>+<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000086_2_2]</color>。並有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_hard_46_2]</color>機率施加持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_46_2]</color>回合的不可驅散<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>。

Korean: 임기응변
English: Improvisation
Japanese: 臨機応変
China_Simplified: 临机应变
China_Traditional: 臨機應變

Korean: 위험 등급 격상
English: Danger Level Up
Japanese: 危険等級格上げ
China_Simplified: 危险等级提升
China_Traditional: 危險等級提升

Korean: 피격 시 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color> 증가를 부여합니다.
English: When hit, grants all allies <color=#28d9ed>Defense Up</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
Japanese: 被撃時、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>防御力増加</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>付与する。
China_Simplified: 受到攻击时，我方全体获得<color=#28d9ed>防御力提升</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 受到攻擊時，我方全體獲得<color=#28d9ed>防禦力提升</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

Korean: 피격 시 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color> 증가를 부여합니다.(해제불가)
English: When hit, grants all allies <color=#28d9ed>Attack Up</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color> (Unremovable).
Japanese: 被撃時、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力増加</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する（解除不可）。
China_Simplified: 受到攻击时，我方全体获得<color=#28d9ed>攻击力提升</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>（无法解除）。
China_Traditional: 受到攻擊時，我方全體獲得<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力提升</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>（無法解除）。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n적 전체는 보유한 약화 효과에 비례하여 받는 피해가 증가합니다.\n피격 후 적 전체에게 각각 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000094_2_1_element]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000094_2_1_element]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAll enemies take increased damage proportional to the number of debuffs they are affected by.\nAfter being attacked, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000094_2_1_element]</color> chance of <color=#28d9ed>Burn</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000094_2_1_element]</color> turns on each enemy.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\n敵全体は保有する弱体効果数に比例して被ダメが増加する。\n被弾後、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000094_2_1_element]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000094_2_1_element]</color>ターンの間付与する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n敌方全体所受伤害随减益效果数量提高。\n被攻击后，对敌方全体分别以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000094_2_1_element]</color>的概率附加<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000094_2_1_element]</color>回合。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n敵方全體所受傷害隨減益效果數量提高。\n被攻擊後，對敵方全體分別以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000094_2_1_element]</color>的機率附加<color=#28d9ed>灼傷</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000094_2_1_element]</color>回合。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 시작 시 자신의 모든 강화 효과의 지속 시간이 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 증가하고, 해제 가능한 능력치 감소 효과를 보유한 적에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_52]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 부여합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.\n자신이 강화 효과 보유 중에는 WG 피해를 받지 않고, 약화 효과 피격 시 WG를 모두 회복합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of the turn, increases duration of all buffs on self by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color> and stuns enemies with dispellable debuffs for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_52]</color> turns. Ignores Resilience.\nWhile buffed, takes no WG damage and restores WG when hit by a debuff.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\nターン開始時、自分の全強化効果の持続時間を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>延長し、解除可能な能力値減少効果を持つ敵に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_52]</color>ターンの間<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を付与する（効果抵抗無視）。\n自分が強化効果を保有中はWGダメージを受けず、弱体効果を受けた場合、WGを全て回復する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n回合开始时，自身所有强化效果持续时间+<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，并对拥有可驱散的属性降低效果的敌人附加<color=#28d9ed>眩晕</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_52]</color>回合（无视效果抵抗）。\n自身处于强化状态时，不会受到WG伤害，并在受到减益效果攻击时完全恢复WG。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n回合開始時，自身所有強化效果持續時間+<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，並對擁有可驅散的屬性降低效果的敵人附加<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_52]</color>回合（無視效果抵抗）。\n自身處於強化狀態時，不會受到WG傷害，並在受到減益效果攻擊時完全恢復WG。

Korean: 반격 본능
English: Counter Instinct
Japanese: 反撃本能
China_Simplified: 反击本能
China_Traditional: 反擊本能

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n 자신이 공격받았을 때 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>반격</color>합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nWhen attacked, has a <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> chance to <color=#28d9ed>Counterattack</color>.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\n攻撃を受けたとき、<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>反撃</color>する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n受到攻击时，有<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>几率进行<color=#28d9ed>反击</color>。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n受到攻擊時，有<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>機率進行<color=#28d9ed>反擊</color>。

Korean: 자신보다 명중이 낮은 적에게 피격 시 피해량이 크게 감소하고, 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4004005_4_2_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 부여합니다.\n자신의 현재 체력이 85% 초과 시 적에게 입히는 피해가 크게 증가합니다.
English: When hit by an enemy with lower Accuracy, damage taken is greatly reduced and grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4004005_4_2_1]</color> turns.\nIf current HP exceeds <color=#28d9ed>85%</color>, damage dealt greatly increases.
Japanese: 命中が低い敵から被弾時、被ダメージを大幅に減少し、自分に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4004005_4_2_1]</color>ターンの間<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を付与する。\n現在HPが<color=#28d9ed>85%</color>を超える場合、与ダメージが大幅に増加する。
China_Simplified: 受到命中率低于自身的敌人攻击时，所受伤害大幅减少，并获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4004005_4_2_1]</color>回合。\n当前HP超过<color=#28d9ed>85%</color>时，造成的伤害大幅增加。
China_Traditional: 受到命中率低於自身的敵人攻擊時，所受傷害大幅減少，並獲得<color=#28d9ed>護盾</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4004005_4_2_1]</color>回合。\n當前HP超過<color=#28d9ed>85%</color>時，造成的傷害大幅增加。

Korean:
적을 공격 후 추가 턴을 획득합니다.

공격 전 대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> 이하라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1_element]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>우메이치린</color> 효과를 획득하고, 피해량이 증가합니다.

대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>를 초과한다면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2_element]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>사쿠라치루</color> 효과를 획득하고, <color=#28d9ed>CP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>15</color> 감소시킵니다.
English:
Attacks an enemy and gains an Extra Turn.

If the target’s HP is ≤<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, gains <color=#28d9ed>Umeichirin</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1_element]</color> turns and increases damage dealt.

If the target’s HP is ><color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, gains <color=#28d9ed>Sakurachiru</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2_element]</color> turns and reduces <color=#28d9ed>CP</color> by <color=#28d9ed>15</color>.
Japanese:
敵を攻撃後、追加ターンを獲得する。

対象HPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下なら<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1_element]</color>ターンの間<color=#28d9ed>ウメイチリン</color>効果を得て与ダメージが増加する。

対象HPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>を超える場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2_element]</color>ターンの間<color=#28d9ed>サクラチル</color>効果を得て、<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>15</color>減少させる。
China_Simplified:
攻击敌人后，获得追加回合。

若目标HP≤<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>，则获得<color=#28d9ed>梅一知林</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1_element]</color>回合，并提升造成的伤害。

若目标HP><color=#28d9ed>90%</color>，则获得<color=#28d9ed>樱散</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2_element]</color>回合，并减少<color=#28d9ed>CP</color><color=#28d9ed>15</color>点。
China_Traditional:
攻擊敵人後，獲得追加回合。

若目標HP≤<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>，則獲得<color=#28d9ed>梅一知林</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1_element]</color>回合，並提升造成的傷害。

若目標HP><color=#28d9ed>90%</color>，則獲得<color=#28d9ed>櫻散</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2_element]</color>回合，並減少<color=#28d9ed>CP</color><color=#28d9ed>15</color>點。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
전투 개시 시점에 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가하고, 적 전체에게는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_3]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color> 2개를 부여합니다. (대상의 효과저항 및 면역 무시)

체력이 <color=#28d9ed>80%</color>를 초과한다면 WG 피해를 받지 않습니다.

방어형이 아닌 적 턴 종료 시 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_6]턴</color> 동안 화상을 부여합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
At battle start, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> and inflicts 2 Unremovable <color=#28d9ed>Burns</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_3]</color> turns (ignores Resilience and Immunity).

If HP ><color=#28d9ed>80%</color>, does not take WG damage.

At the end of a non-Defense enemy’s turn, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burn</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_6]</color> turns.
Japanese:
（パッシブ効果）
戦闘開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>増加させ、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_3]</color>ターンの間解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>×2を付与する（効果抵抗・免疫無視）。

HPが<color=#28d9ed>80%</color>を超える場合、WGダメージを受けません。

防御型以外の敵ターン終了時、対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_6]</color>ターンの間<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を付与する。
China_Simplified:
（被动效果）
战斗开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，并对敌方全体施加2个不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_3]</color>回合（无视效果抵抗与免疫）。

当自身HP><color=#28d9ed>80%</color>时，不会受到WG伤害。

非防御型敌人回合结束时，对目标附加<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_6]</color>回合。
China_Traditional:
（被動效果）
戰鬥開始時，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，並對敵方全體施加2個不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>灼傷</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_3]</color>回合（無視效果抵抗與免疫）。

當自身HP><color=#28d9ed>80%</color>時，不會受到WG傷害。

非防禦型敵人回合結束時，對目標附加<color=#28d9ed>灼傷</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4014005_4_6]</color>回合。

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> : 적 전체를 공격합니다. 
광폭화 이후 영구적으로 <color=#28d9ed>받는 피해</color>가 감소하고 아군 전체에게 반격을 부여합니다.
English:
When HP is less than or equal to <color=#28d9ed>40%</color>, enters <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color>.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color>: Attacks all enemies.
After Berserk, permanently reduces <color=#28d9ed>damage taken</color> and grants <color=#28d9ed>Counter</color> to all allies.
Japanese:
HPが<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態になる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与える。
狂暴化後、永続的に<color=#28d9ed>被ダメージ</color>を減少し、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>反撃</color>を付与する。
China_Simplified:
当HP小于等于<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>时，进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>：攻击敌方全体。
进入狂暴化后，永久降低<color=#28d9ed>所受伤害</color>，并赋予我方全体<color=#28d9ed>反击</color>。
China_Traditional:
當HP小於等於<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>時，進入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>：攻擊敵方全體。
進入狂暴化後，永久降低<color=#28d9ed>所受</color>傷害，並賦予我方全體<color=#28d9ed>反擊</color>。

English: Irritation Inducer

English: Blessing of the Earth Tower
Japanese: 大地の塔の加護
China_Simplified: 大地之塔的加护
China_Traditional: 大地之塔的加護

Korean:
항상 관통력이 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>, 치명 확률이 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가합니다

턴 시작 시 자신의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>회복합니다.
턴 종료 시 적 팀의 CP를 <color=#28d9ed>25</color> 감소시킵니다.
English:
<color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> is always increased by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
At end of turn, restores your HP by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>.

At end of turn, reduces the enemy team’s CP by <color=#28d9ed>25</color>.
Japanese: <color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>、<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPされる。\nターン開始時、自分のHPを<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>回復する。\nターン終了時、敵のチームCPを<color=#28d9ed>25</color>DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified:
<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>始终+<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>+<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
回合结束时，回复自身生命值<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>。

回合结束时，降低敌方队伍CP<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。
China_Traditional:
<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>常時+<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>+<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
回合結束時，回復自身生命值<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>。

回合結束時，降低敵方隊伍CP<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。

English: Blessing of the Water Tower

China_Simplified: 水之塔的加护
China_Traditional: 水之塔的加護

턴 종료 시 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>15%</color>증가합니다.
턴 종료 시 적 팀의 CP를 <color=#28d9ed>25</color> 감소시킵니다.

<color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> is always increased by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
At end of turn, your Priority increases by <color=#28d9ed>15%</color>.

At end of turn, reduces the enemy team’s CP by <color=#28d9ed>25</color>.
Japanese: <color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>、<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPされる。\nターン終了時、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>UPされる。\nターン終了時、敵のチームCPを<color=#28d9ed>25</color>DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified:
<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>始终+<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>+<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
回合结束时，自身行动值+<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>。

回合结束时，降低敌方队伍CP<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。
China_Traditional:
<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>常時+<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>+<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
回合結束時，自身速攻值+<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>。

回合結束時，降低敵方隊伍CP<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。

Korean: 화염의 탑의 가호
English: Blessing of the Tower of Flames
Japanese: 火炎の塔の加護
China_Simplified: 火焰之塔的庇佑
China_Traditional: 火焰之塔的庇佑

Korean:
항상 관통력이 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>, 치명 확률이 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가합니다

받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>감소합니다.
턴 종료 시 적 팀의 CP를 <color=#28d9ed>25</color> 감소시킵니다.

<color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> is always increased by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
Damage taken is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>.

At end of turn, reduces the enemy team’s CP by <color=#28d9ed>25</color>.
Japanese: <color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>、<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPされる。\n受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>DOWNされる。\nターン終了時、敵のチームCPを<color=#28d9ed>25</color>DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified:
<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>始终+<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>+<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
受到的伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。

回合结束时，降低敌方队伍CP<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。
China_Traditional:
<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>常時+<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>+<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
受到的傷害降低<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。

回合結束時，降低敵方隊伍CP<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。

Korean: 출연료 대출혈
English: Appearance Fee Bleed-Out
Japanese: 出演料大出血
China_Simplified: 出场费大出血
China_Traditional: 出場費大出血

Korean: 제행무상 시생멸법
English: Dharma of Impermanence
Japanese: 諸行無常・是生滅法
China_Simplified: 諸行無常·是生滅法
China_Traditional: 諸行無常·是生滅法

Korean: 항상 좌측의 적을 먼저 공격합니다. 적을 공격하고 그녀의 하수인인 얼음 망령을 소환합니다. 이미 얼음 망령이 존재한다면 소환하지 않습니다.\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color> 상태라면 피해량이 증가합니다.
English: Always attacks the enemy on the left first. Attacks an enemy and summons an Ice Revenant, her underling. Does not summon a new Ice Revenant if one is already present.\nDeals increased damage if the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color>.
Japanese: 常に左側の敵を優先して攻撃する。敵単体にダメージを与え、彼女の手下である【氷の亡霊】を召喚する。すでに【氷の亡霊】が戦場にいる場合は召喚しない。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: 总是优先攻击左侧的敌人。攻击敌人，并召唤她的手下冰霜亡灵。若已存在冰霜亡灵，则不会进行召唤。\n目标处于<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态时，伤害量提升。
China_Traditional: 總是優先攻擊左側的敵人。攻擊敵人，並召喚她的手下冰晶亡靈。若冰晶亡靈已存在，則不會召喚。\n若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>冰凍</color>狀態，傷害量增加。

Korean: 생존한 아군의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_3_1]</color> 증가시킨 후, 사망한 아군 전체를 <color=#28d9ed>부활(강화)</color>시킵니다. 이후 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 넬라 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color>만큼 회복시키고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000083_3_4]턴</color> 동안 면역을 부여합니다.\n\n자신을 제외한 아군에게 추가적으로 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>공격력, 관통력</color> 증가 효과를 부여합니다.

턴 종료 시 자신에게 걸린 모든 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 해제합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>OK~! 더 월드 이즈 아워즈</color> 사용 전 사망 시, <color=#28d9ed>99턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>면역</color>을 부여하며, 자신이 입는 피해를 크게 감소시킵니다.
English: If the caster is <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color>, takes Fixed Damage equal to <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of Max Health upon taking a turn.\nAt the end of the turn, dispels all <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> from self.\nIf defeated before using <color=#28d9ed>OK~! The World Is Ours</color>, grants all enemies unremovable <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color> for <color=#28d9ed>99 turns</color> and greatly reduces damage taken by self.
Japanese: 自分が<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>状態の場合、ターン獲得時に最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>分の固定ダメージを受ける。\nターン終了時、自分にかかったすべての<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を解除する。\n<color=#28d9ed>OK~! ザ・ワールド・イズ・アワーズ</color>を使用する前に戦闘不能になった場合、敵全体に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を<color=#28d9ed>99ターン</color>付与し、自分が受けるダメージを大幅にDOWNする。
China_Simplified: 若自身处于<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>状态，则在获得回合时受到等于最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的固定伤害。\n回合结束时，解除自身所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。\n在使用<color=#28d9ed>OK~! The World Is Ours</color>之前被击败时，为全体敌人赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>持续<color=#28d9ed>99回合</color>，并大幅降低自身所受伤害。
China_Traditional: 若自身處於<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>狀態，於獲得回合時將受到相當於最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的固定傷害。\n回合結束時，解除自身所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。\n於使用<color=#28d9ed>OK~! The World Is Ours</color>之前被擊敗時，為全體敵人賦予無法解除的<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color><color=#28d9ed>99回合</color>，並大幅降低自身所受傷害。

Korean: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color> 확률로 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 해제하고 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n대상이 약화 화과를 가진 상태라면 피해가 크게 증가합니다.
English: Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color> chance to dispel <color=#28d9ed>all Buffs</color> from all enemies, then attacks all enemies.\nDeals greatly increased damage if the target is afflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color>.
Japanese: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除し、敵全体に攻撃する。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を受けている場合、ダメージが大幅UP。
China_Simplified: 有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color>概率解除全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>所有增益效果</color>，随后攻击全体敌人。\n若目标附带<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，伤害大幅提升。
China_Traditional: 以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color>機率解除全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>所有強化效果</color>，之後攻擊全體敵人。\n若目標帶有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，傷害大幅提升。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
매 턴 적의 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color> 감소합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다. (최대 20회 누적)

전투 입장 시 가장 빠르게 턴을 획득하며 유리 속성에게 받는 피해량이 크게 감소합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect)
Each turn, reduces enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color>. This effect ignores Resilience (stacks up to 20).

At the start of battle, takes the first turn and greatly reduces damage taken from elements disadvantaged against the caster.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\n毎ターン、敵の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color>DOWNさせる（効果抵抗無視、最大20回累積）。\n戦闘開始時、最速で行動し、自分に不利ではない属性から受けるダメージを大幅DOWNする。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n每回合使敌方<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color>（无视效果抵抗，最多叠加20次）。\n战斗开始时优先获得回合，并大幅降低来自对其不利元素的伤害。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n每回合使敵方<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color>（無視效果抵抗，最多累積20次）。\n戰鬥開始時優先取得回合，並大幅減少來自對其不利元素的傷害。

Korean: 적 대상을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> chance to increase the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> turn(s).
Japanese: 敵単体を攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>ターンの間UPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击1名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>概率使自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>回合。
China_Traditional: 攻擊1名敵人，並以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>機率使自身<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提升，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>回合。

Korean: 자신에게 걸려 있는 약화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 제거하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color> 증가 효과를 부여한 뒤 적 대상을 공격합니다.
English: Removes <color=#28d9ed>all</color> debuffs from the caster and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2] turn(s)</color>, then attacks an enemy.
Japanese: 自分の弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除し、<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>UP効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与した後、敵単体にダメージを与える。
China_Simplified: 解除自身附带的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color>弱化效果，并获得<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升效果，持续 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]回合</color>后，攻击敌人目标。
China_Traditional: 解除自身受到的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color>弱化效果，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]回合</color>內賦予<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>增加效果後，攻擊敵人目標。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다. 이 스킬로 사망한 적은 부활 및 소생이 불가능합니다.
English: Attacks an enemy. Enemies defeated by this skill cannot be revived or resurrected.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。本スキルで倒された敵は復活・蘇生できない。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。被此技能击倒的敌人无法复活或复苏。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。被此技能擊倒的敵人無法復活或復甦。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
전투 입장 시 자신에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>은신</color> 효과를 영구적으로 부여합니다.
턴 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]턴</color> 동안 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color> 및 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>가 증가합니다.
매 턴 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)
English:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, permanently grants the caster an un-dispellable <color=#28d9ed>Stealth</color> effect.
At the start of turn, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]</color> turn(s).
Each turn, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> (up to 10 stacks).
Japanese:
（パッシブ効果）
戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>隠密</color>を永続付与する。
ターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>と<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]</color>ターンの間UP。
毎ターン、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>ずつUP（最大10回）。
China_Simplified:
（被动效果）
进入战斗时，永久获得不可驱散的<color=#28d9ed>潜行</color>效果。
回合开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>与<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]</color>回合。
每回合自身<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多10层）。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n進入戰鬥時，永久獲得不可驅散的<color=#28d9ed>潛行</color>。回合開始時，自身<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>與<color=#28d9ed>暴擊傷害</color>提升，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]</color>回合。每回合自身<color=#28d9ed>貫穿力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多10層）。

Korean: 사모하는 선배님
English: My Admired Senpai
Japanese: 憧れの先輩
China_Simplified: 仰慕的前辈
China_Traditional: 仰慕的前輩

Korean: 자신 공격 후, <color=#28d9ed>이터널</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가시키고 적이 공격이 아닌 스킬 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>밤의 장막</color>으로 대상을 공격합니다.(밤의 장막 쿨타임 무시)
English: After the caster attacks, increases <color=#28d9ed>Eternal</color>’s <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>. When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, attacks the target with <color=#28d9ed>Veil of Night</color> (ignores Veil of Night’s cooldown).
Japanese: 自分が攻撃した後、<color=#28d9ed>【エターナル】</color>の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>UPする。敵が攻撃以外のスキルを使用した時、<color=#28d9ed>【夜のヴェール】</color>で対象を攻撃する（スキルのスキルターン無視）。
China_Simplified: 自身攻击后，使<color=#28d9ed>「永恒」</color>的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。当敌人使用非攻击技能时，以<color=#28d9ed>「夜之帷幕」</color>攻击其（无视该技能冷却）。
China_Traditional: 自身攻擊後，使<color=#28d9ed>「永恆」</color>的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。當敵人使用非攻擊技能時，以<color=#28d9ed>「夜之帷幕」</color>攻擊目標（無視該技能冷卻）。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]턴</color> 동안 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 감소시킵니다.\n추가로 지속성 대상에게는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>회복 불가</color>를 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> chance to decrease all enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> turn(s).\nAdditionally, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unhealable</color> on Earth enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> turn(s).
Japanese: 敵全体に攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>ターンの間DOWNさせる。\nさらに、地属性の敵に対しては<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>ターン付与。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>概率使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>与<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>回合。\n另外，对土属性目标有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>概率施加<color=#28d9ed>无法恢复</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>回合。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>機率使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>與<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>回合。\n另外，對大地屬性目標以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>機率賦予<color=#28d9ed>無法恢復</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>回合。

Korean: 친애하는 후배님
English: Dear Junior
Japanese: 親愛なる後輩
China_Simplified: 亲爱的后辈
China_Traditional: 親愛的後輩

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#28d9ed>영원히 살 수는 없어</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>이터널</color>은 전투 입장 시 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중 증가, 관통 증가</color>를 영구적으로 보유하는 대신, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 크게 감소합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nGrants an <color=#28d9ed>Extra Turn</color> upon using <color=#28d9ed>Can’t Live Forever</color>.\n<color=#28d9ed>Eternal</color> permanently gains un-dispellable <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness Up</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Penetration Up</color> at the start of battle, but her own <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> is greatly reduced.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\n<color=#28d9ed>『永遠には生きられない』</color>使用時、<color>#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。\n<color=#28d9ed>【エターナル】</color>は戦闘開始時に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中UP</color>と<color=#28d9ed>貫通UP</color>を永続で得る代わりに、自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が大幅にDOWNする。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n使用<color=#28d9ed>「不能永生」</color>时，获得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。\n<color=#28d9ed>「永恒」</color>在战斗开始时永久获得不可驱散的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中提升</color>与<color=#28d9ed>穿透提升</color>，但自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>将大幅降低。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n使用<color=#28d9ed>「不能永生」</color>時，獲得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。\n<color=#28d9ed>「永恆」</color>在戰鬥開始時永久獲得不可驅散的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中提升</color>與<color=#28d9ed>貫穿提升</color>，但自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>將大幅降低。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and grants <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> to the whole enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03] turns</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03]回合</color>内赋予全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03]回合</color>內賦予全體敵人<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。

Korean: 전투 시작 시, 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 크게 감소시키며 피격 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: At the start of battle, greatly reduces all enemies’ <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color>. When hit, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
Japanese: 戦闘開始時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を大幅DOWNする。被弾時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UP。
China_Simplified: 战斗开始时，大幅降低全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>。受击时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
China_Traditional: 戰鬥開始時，大幅降低全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>。受擊時，自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

Korean:
4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복한 뒤, 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 필살기</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color>시킵니다.
English:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Grants the caster un-dispellable Attack Up/DMG Reduction for 3 turns, recovers WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2], then inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>3</color> turns. Berserk lasts 3 turns.
<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Ultimate</color>: Used when Berserk ends. Attacks all enemies and <color=#28d9ed>Detonates</color> all <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> effects on them.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可の攻撃力UP/被ダメージDOWNを3ターン付与し、WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]を回復。その後、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>3ターン</color>の間付与。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。
<color=#28d9ed>狂暴必殺</color>：狂暴終了時に使用。敵全体に攻撃し、付与された<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>をすべて<color=#28d9ed>爆発</color>させる。
China_Simplified:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：为自身赋予不可驱散的攻击力提升/伤害降低，持续3回合；恢复WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]，随后对全体敌人施加<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>3</color>回合。狂暴持续3回合。
<color=#28d9ed>狂暴终技</color>：狂暴结束时施放。攻击全体敌人并<color=#28d9ed>引爆</color>其身上的全部<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果。
China_Traditional:
每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化與必殺技</color>：賦予自身不可驅散的攻擊力增加/傷害減少3回合，恢復WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]，接著對全體敵人施加<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>3</color>回合。暴走持續3回合。
<color=#28d9ed>暴走絕技</color>：暴走結束時使用。攻擊全體敵人並<color=#28d9ed>引爆</color>其全部<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n턴 시작 시 사망한 모든 아군을 부활(강화)시키고, 본체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\At the start of the turn, Resurrects (Greater) all dead allies and increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、倒れたすべての味方を復活(強化)させ、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n回合开始时，复活(强化)所有已死亡的友军，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n回合開始時，使所有已死亡的我軍復活(強化)，並使自身的<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

Korean: 적을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 감소시킵니다.\n아군 2인의 <color=#28d9ed>협공</color>을 발생시킵니다.
English: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color> chance to decrease the target’s <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]</color> turn(s).\nTriggers <color=#28d9ed>Dual Attacks</color> by two allies.
Japanese: 敵を攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]</color>ターンDOWNさせる。\n味方2人の<color=#28d9ed>連携</color>を発生させる。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color>概率使目标<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]</color>回合。\n触发2名友军的<color=#28d9ed>夹攻</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，並以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color>機率使目標<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>降低，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]</color>回合。\n觸發2名我軍的<color=#28d9ed>協攻</color>。

Korean: 허무의 열반
English: Nirvana of the Void
Japanese: 虚無の涅槃
China_Simplified: 虚无涅槃
China_Traditional: 虛無涅槃

Korean: 매 턴 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)\n매 턴 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 5회 누적)\n분신 생존 시 받는 피해가 감소합니다.
English: Each turn, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> (up to 10 stacks).\nEach turn, increases all allies’ <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> (up to 5 stacks).\nReduces damage taken while clones are alive.
Japanese: 毎ターン、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>ずつUP（最大10回）。\n毎ターン、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>ずつUP（最大5回）。\n分身が生存している間、受けるダメージがDOWN。
China_Simplified: 每回合使自身<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多10层）。\n每回合使全体友军<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>（最多5层）。\n分身存活时，所受伤害降低。
China_Traditional: 每回合使自身<color=#28d9ed>貫穿力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多10層）。\n每回合使全體我軍<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>（最多5層）。\n分身存活期間，所受傷害降低。

Korean: 4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 적 전체에게 피해를 입힌 뒤, 모든 아군을 부활(강화)시킵니다. 이후, 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>지속 회복</color>을 부여합니다.
English: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Deals damage to all enemies, then <color=#28d9ed>Resurrects (Greater)</color> all allies. Afterwards, grants <color=#28d9ed>Continuous Healing</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]</color> turn(s).
Japanese: 4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、味方全体を<color=#28d9ed>復活（強化）</color>させる。その後、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>持続回復</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]</color>ターン付与する。
China_Simplified: 每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：对全体敌人造成伤害后，使全体友军<color=#28d9ed>复活（强化）</color>；随后为全体友军赋予<color=#28d9ed>持续恢复</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]</color>回合。
China_Traditional: 每4回合轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化與必殺技</color>：對全體敵人造成傷害後，使全體我軍<color=#28d9ed>復活（強化）</color>；接著賦予<color=#28d9ed>持續恢復</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]</color>回合。

Korean: 플래시 프로토콜
English: Flash Protocol
Japanese: フラッシュプロトコル
China_Simplified: 协闪光协议
China_Traditional: 閃光協議

Korean: 전투 입장 시 가장 빠르게 턴을 획득합니다.
English: At the start of battle, takes the first turn.
Japanese: 戦闘開始時、最速でターンを獲得する。
China_Simplified: 进入战斗时，最先获得回合。
China_Traditional: 進入戰鬥時，最先取得回合。

Korean: 항상 좌측의 적을 먼저 공격합니다. 공격 전 대상의 강화 효과를 모두 해제한 뒤 공격하고 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만듭니다.(효과 저항 무시)
English: Always targets the leftmost enemy first. Before attacking, dispels all <color=#28d9ed>Buffs</color> from the target, then attacks and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02] turn(s)</color> (ignores Resilience).
Japanese: 常に左側の敵を最優先で攻撃する。攻撃前に対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>をすべて解除してから攻撃し、対象を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02]ターン</color>のあいだ<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>させる（効果抵抗無視）。
China_Simplified: 总是先攻击最左侧的敌人。攻击前先解除目标的全部<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，随后进行攻击并使其陷入<color=#28d9ed>眩晕</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02]回合</color>（无视效果抵抗）。
China_Traditional: 總是先攻擊最左側的敵人。攻擊前先解除目標的全部<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>，隨後進行攻擊並使其陷入<color=#28d9ed>眩暈</color>狀態，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02]回合</color>（無視效果抵抗）。

Korean:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>70%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 받는 피해 감소/절망의 하모니 효과를 4턴 동안 부여합니다. 광폭화는 4턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>월야의 녹턴</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 사망시킵니다.
English:
When the caster’s Max Health is at or below <color=#28d9ed>70%</color>, becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>.

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Entry</color>: Grants the caster irremovable Damage Taken Reduction and Despair’s Harmony for 4 turns. Enrage lasts for 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Moonlit Nocturne</color>: Used when Enrage ends.
Instantly kills all enemies.
Japanese:
最大HPが<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化突入】</color>：自分に解除不可の被ダメージDOWNと〈絶望のハーモニー〉を4ターン付与。狂暴化は4ターン持続。

<color=#28d9ed>〈月夜のノクターン〉</color>：狂暴化終了時に使用。
敵全体を即死させる。
China_Simplified:
当自身最大生命值≤<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>时，进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>进入狂暴化</color>：为自身赋予不可解除的伤害降低与「绝望的和声」，持续4回合。狂暴化持续4回合。

<color=#28d9ed>月夜夜想曲</color>：在狂暴化结束时发动。
使全体敌人立即死亡。
China_Traditional:
當自身最大生命值≤<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>時，進入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：為自身賦予不可解除的傷害減少與「絕望之和聲」，持續4回合。狂暴化持續4回合。

<color=#28d9ed>月夜夜想曲</color>：於狂暴化結束時施放。
使全體敵人立即死亡。

Korean: 견제 프로토콜
English: Distracting Protocol
Japanese: 牽制プロトコル
China_Simplified: 牵制协议
China_Traditional: 協議牽制

Korean: 전투 입장 시, 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color> 효과를 부여합니다.\n\n자신 행동 시, 적 전체에게 최대 체력 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 만큼의 <color=#28d9ed>고정 피해</color>를 입힙니다.
English: Upon entering battle, grants the caster an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> effect.\n\nOn the caster’s turn, deals <color=#28d9ed>Fixed Damage</color> equal to <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> of the caster’s Max Health to all enemies.
Japanese: 戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を付与する。\n\n自分の行動時、敵全体に自分最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>分の<color=#28d9ed>固定ダメージ</color>を与える。
China_Simplified: 进入战斗时，为自身赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果。\n\n自身行动时，对全体敌人造成等于自身最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>固定伤害</color>。
China_Traditional: 進入戰鬥時，為自身賦予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>效果。\n\n自身行動時，對全體敵人造成等於自身最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>固定傷害</color>。

Korean: 용의 기개
English: Dragon’s Valor
Japanese: 竜の気概
China_Simplified: 龙之气概
China_Traditional: 龍之氣概

Korean:
전투 입장 시, 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>관통, 피해 감소</color> 효과를 부여하고 가장 공격력이 높은 적의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소시킵니다.

매 턴 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)
자신이 입는 <color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>10000</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
English:
At the start of battle, grants the caster irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> and <color=#28d9ed>DMG Reduction</color>, and reduces the <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> of the enemy with the highest Attack by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.

Each turn, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> (up to 10 stacks).
Damage the caster takes from <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Fixed Damage</color> cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>10000</color>.
Japanese:
戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>貫通</color>と<color=#28d9ed>ダメージDOWN</color>を付与し、最も攻撃力が高い敵の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNさせる。

毎ターン、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>ずつUP（最大10回累積）。
自分が受ける<color=#28d9ed>呪い／固定ダメージ</color>は<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>を超えない。
China_Simplified:
进入战斗时，为自身赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>与<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>，并使攻击力最高的敌人的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

每回合使自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多叠加10次）。
自身受到的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒/固定伤害</color>不超过<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>。
China_Traditional:
進入戰鬥時，為自身賦予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>與<color=#28d9ed>傷害減少</color>，並使攻擊力最高的敵人的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

每回合使自身<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多累積10次）。
自身受到的<color=#28d9ed>詛咒／固定傷害</color>不會超過<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>。

최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>60%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>아이스 나인</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고 대상을 빙결 상태로 만듭니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.

<color=#ffd732>3턴 안에 광폭화할 시 80의 CP를 회복시킵니다.</color>
English:
When the caster’s Max Health falls below <color=#28d9ed>60%</color>, enters <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> state, increasing <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. The effect lasts until broken.

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Entry</color>: Grants the caster irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness Up</color> for 3 turns and <color=#28d9ed>Invincibility</color> for 1 turn, then recovers WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2] and summons her minion, the Giant Ice Wraith. Enrage lasts for 3 turns, and if the enemy is <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color>, the caster uses <color=#28d9ed>Shatter</color> immediately after entering Enrage.

<color=#28d9ed>Ice Nine</color>: Used when Enrage ends.
Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Freeze</color>. This effect ignores Resilience.

<color=#ffd732>Restores 80 CP if Enrage is triggered within 3 turns.</color>
Japanese:
最大HPが<color=#28d9ed>60%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に移行し、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>上昇する。ブレイクされるまで効果が持続。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化突入】</color>：自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中UP</color>を3ターン、<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を1ターン付与し、WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]を回復。その後、従者である巨大氷霊を召喚する。狂暴化は3ターンの間続き、敵が<color=#28d9ed>氷結</color>状態の場合、狂暴化突入後に<color=#28d9ed>「砕け散れ」</color>を使用する。

<color=#28d9ed>【アイスナイン】</color>：狂暴化終了時に発動。
敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>氷結</color>状態にする。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。

<color=#ffd732>3ターン以内に狂暴化すると、CPを80回復する。</color>

当自身最大生命值≤<color=#28d9ed>60%</color>时，进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，使<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。效果持续至被打破为止。

<color=#28d9ed>进入狂暴化</color>：为自身赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中提升</color>（持续3回合）和<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>（持续1回合），并恢复WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]，随后召唤她的仆从——巨型冰灵。狂暴化持续3回合，若敌人处于<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态，则在进入狂暴化后立即施放<color=#28d9ed>粉碎吧</color>。

攻击全体敌人并使其陷入<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态。该效果无视效果抵抗。

<color=#ffd732>在3回合内进入狂暴化时，恢复80点CP。</color>
China_Traditional:
當自身最大生命值≤<color=#28d9ed>60%</color>時，進入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態，使<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>與<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。效果持續至被打破為止。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：為自身賦予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中提升</color>（持續3回合）與<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>（持續1回合），並恢復WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]，隨後召喚她的隨從──巨大冰靈。狂暴化持續3回合，若敵人處於<color=#28d9ed>冰凍</color>狀態，則在進入狂暴化後立即施放<color=#28d9ed>粉碎吧</color>。

<color=#ffd732>若於3回合內進入狂暴化，恢復80點CP。</color>

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n공격 후, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter attacking, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color>の確率で対象に<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color>概率对目标赋予<color=#28d9ed>触电</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻击后，使自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color>的機率使目標陷入<color=#28d9ed>觸電</color>狀態，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻擊後，增加自身<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_licence_week_101]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_101]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n피해를 준 대상마다 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000052_3_2]</color> 증가합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_licence_week_101]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Shock</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_101]</color> turns.\nFor each enemy hit, increases all allies’ <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000052_3_2]</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_licence_week_101]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_101]</color>ターン付与する。\n命中した対象1体につき、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000052_3_2]</color>増加する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_licence_week_101]</color>几率施加<color=#28d9ed>感电</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_101]</color>回合。\n每命中1个目标，我方全体<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000052_3_2]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_licence_week_101]</color>機率施加<color=#28d9ed>感電</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_101]</color>回合。\n每命中1個目標，我方全體<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000052_3_2]</color>。

Korean: 매 턴 시작 시 무작위 적에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_485]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>이레귤러 감염증</color>을 부여합니다. (해제 불가)\n해제 가능한 약화 효과가 2턴 이상인 적이 행동 시, 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_50_1]</color> 증가합니다.\n약화 효과를 보유한 적에게는 WG 피해를 받지 않습니다.
English: At the start of each turn, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Irregular Infection</color> on a random enemy for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_485]</color> turns (undispellable).\nWhen an enemy with any dispellable debuff of 2 or more turns takes action, increases own Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_50_1]</color>.\nTakes no WG damage from enemies with debuffs.
Japanese: 毎ターン開始時、ランダムな敵に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_485]</color>ターンの<color=#28d9ed>イレギュラー感染症</color>を付与する（解除不可）。\n2ターン以上の解除可能な弱体効果を保有する敵が行動したとき、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_50_1]</color>増加する。\n弱体効果を保有する敵からWGダメージを受けません。
China_Simplified: 每回合开始时，随机对一名敌人施加<color=#28d9ed>异变感染</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_485]</color>回合（不可驱散）。\n当携带任一可驱散、持续≥2回合的减益的敌人行动时，自身行动值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_50_1]</color>。\n对携带减益的敌人不承受WG伤害。
China_Traditional: 每回合開始時，隨機對一名敵人賦予<color=#28d9ed>異變感染</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_485]</color>回合（不可驅散）。\n當持有任一可驅散且持續≥2回合減益之敵人行動時，自身速攻值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_50_1]</color>。\n不會受到帶有減益之敵人的WG傷害。

English: Attacks an enemy and increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>.If the caster is not affected by <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Petrify</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_1]</color> turn(s).
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>増加させる。自分が <color=#28d9ed>中毒</color> 状態でない場合、対象に <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_1]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>を付与する。
China_Simplified:
攻击敌人，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动条</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>。
若自身未处于<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>状态，则使目标在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_1]</color>回合内陷入<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>状态。
China_Traditional:
攻擊敵人，並使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行動條</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_doppelganger_light_1]</color>。
若自身未處於<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>狀態，則使目標在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_1]</color>回合內陷入<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>狀態。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 해제되지 않는 공격력 감소 효과를 [Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_2]턴 동안 부여합니다. 또한 공격 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts an unremovable <color=#28d9ed>Attack DOWN</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_2]</color> turns. After attacking, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、解除できない<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力ダウン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_2]</color>ターンの間付与する。攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并赋予无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力降低</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_2]</color>回合。攻击后，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动条</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並賦予無法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力降低</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_sphinx_2]</color>回合。攻擊後，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行動條</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 모두 해제하고, 강화 효과를 보유하지 않은 적에게 무작위 약화 효과를 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nRemoves all <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> from all enemies and inflicts a random <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color> on enemies without buffs.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>をすべて解除する。<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を持たない敵にランダムの<color=#28d9ed>弱化効果</color>を付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，解除所有敌人的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，并对未持有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>的敌人施加随机<color=#28d9ed>减益效果</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，解除所有敵人的<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>，並對未持有<color=#28d9ed>強化效果</color>的敵人施加隨機<color=#28d9ed>減益效果</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 시작 시 자신이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 감소합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>중독</color> 상태일 경우 받는 피해가 증가하고 그렇지 않을 경우에는 받는 WG피해가 50% 감소합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of each turn, reduces the duration of all <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> on self by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.\nWhen under <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color>, increases damage taken. Otherwise, reduces WG damage received by 50%.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\nターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>が<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>減少する。\n<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>状態の場合、受けるダメージが上昇し、そうでない場合は受ける<color=#28d9ed>WGダメージ</color>が50%減少する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n每回合开始时，自身持有的<color=#28d9ed>减益效果</color>持续时间减少<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。\n处于<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>状态时，受到的伤害增加；否则，受到的<color=#28d9ed>WG伤害</color>减少50%。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n每回合開始時，自身持有的<color=#28d9ed>減益效果</color>持續時間縮短<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。\n處於<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>狀態時，受到的傷害增加；否則，受到的<color=#28d9ed>WG傷害</color>減少50%。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n<color=#28d9ed>중독</color> 상태가 아닐 경우 피격 시 반격합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nCounters when attacked if not affected by <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color>.
Japanese: （パッシブ効果）\n<color=#28d9ed>【中毒】</color>状態でない場合、攻撃を受けると反撃する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n未处于<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>状态时，被攻击后进行反击。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n未處於<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>狀態時，被攻擊後會進行反擊。

Korean:
5턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>다 죽인다냥</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격합니다. 광폭화 종료 이후 영구적으로 치명 확률이 증가합니다.(해제 불가)
English:
Enters <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> state every 5 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Entry</color>: Grants the caster irremovable Attack Up and DMG Reduction for 3 turns, and recovers WG by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Kill Them All, Nyan!</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies and permanently increases the caster’s Critical Rate. (Irremovable)
Japanese:
5ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化突入】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP／被ダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WG[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]を回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【皆殺しニャン】</color>：狂暴化終了時に使用する。
敵全体にダメージを与え、自分の会心率を永続的に上昇させる。（解除不可）
China_Simplified:
每经过5回合，转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升和承受伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>全部消灭喵！</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击所有敌人，并永久提升自身的暴击率。（无法解除）
China_Traditional:
每經過5回合，轉換為<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身獲得無法被解除的攻擊力提升與承受傷害降低效果，持續3回合，並使WG恢復[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。
狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>全部殺光喵！</color>：狂暴化結束時發動。
攻擊所有敵人，並永久提升自身的爆擊率。（無法解除）

Korean: \n적을 공격 후 자신이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 보유하지 않을 경우 적에게 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_owlbear_1]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.(해제불가)
English: \nAfter attacking an enemy, if the caster is not affected by <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color> on the enemy for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_owlbear_1]</color> turns. (Undispellable)
Japanese: \n敵にダメージを与えた後、自分に <color=#28d9ed>出血</color>効果がない場合、敵に<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_owlbear_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。(解除不可)
China_Simplified: \n攻击敌人后，若自身未处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，则对敌人施加<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_owlbear_1]</color>回合。（无法驱散）
China_Traditional: \n攻擊敵人後，若自身未處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態，則對敵人施加<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_owlbear_1]</color>回合。（無法驅散）

Korean: 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_4]턴</color> 동안 부여하고, 자신의 약화 효과의 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 감소시킵니다.
English: Inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_4]</color> turns and reduces the duration of the caster’s debuffs by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_4]ターン</color>の間付与し、自分に与えた弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>減少させる。
China_Simplified: 对全体敌人施加<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_4]</color>回合，并将自身弱化效果的持续时间减少<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 對全體敵人施加<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_4]</color>回合，並使自身弱化效果的持續時間減少<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고, 대상 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_451]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다. (면역 무시, 해제 불가)
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_451]</color> turn(s). (Ignores Immunity, cannot be dispelled)
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、全体対象に<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_451]ターン</color>の間付与する。 (免疫無視、解除不可)
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并对所有目标施加<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_451]</color>回合。（无视免疫，不可驱散）
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並對所有目標施加<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_451]</color>回合。（無視免疫、不可解除）

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n출혈 보유 대상이 행동 시 <color=#28d9ed>WG</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_2]</color> 회복합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nWhen a target affected by Bleed takes an action, restores <color=#28d9ed>WG</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_2]</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n出血効果対象に<color=#28d9ed>WG</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_2]</color>回復する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n当处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态的目标行动时，恢复<color=#28d9ed>WG</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_2]</color>点。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n當處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態的目標行動時，恢復<color=#28d9ed>WG</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_2]</color>點。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n마법형이 아닌 적의 효과 적중이 90% 감소합니다. 자신이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 보유하지 않을 경우 받는 피해량이 대폭 감소합니다.
English: (Passive Effect)\nReduces Effectiveness of non-Mage enemies by 90%. If the caster is not affected by <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color>, damage taken is greatly reduced.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n魔法型以外の敵に効果命中を90%DOWNさせる。自分が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態でない場合、受けるダメージが大幅に減少する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）\n使非魔法型敌人的效果命中降低90%。自身未处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态时，所受伤害大幅减少。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）\n使非魔法型敵人的效果命中降低90%。自身未處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態時，所受傷害大幅減少。

Korean: 5턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. \n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color>시킵니다.
English: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 5 turns.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Activation & Ultimate</color>: Attacks all enemies and <color=#28d9ed>detonates</color> all <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color> effects on the targets.
Japanese: ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与える。対象に <color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を全て<color=#28d9ed>破裂</color>させる。
China_Simplified: 每5回合进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化启动与必杀技</color>：攻击全体敌人，并<color=#28d9ed>引爆</color>目标身上的全部<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果。
China_Traditional: 每5回合進入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化進入與必殺技</color>：攻擊全體敵人，並<color=#28d9ed>引爆</color>目標身上所有的<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果。

Korean:
스킬 사용 전, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 증가시키고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킨 뒤, 적을 공격합니다.
공격 후, 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 감소한 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다.
대상에게 걸린 <color=#28d9ed>약화</color> 효과가 많을 수록 피해가 증가합니다.
대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>규율 집행</color>으로 추가 공격합니다.
English:
Before attacking, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color> and decreases the target’s <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1] turns</color>, then attacks the enemy.
After attacking, if the target’s <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> is decreased, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Freeze</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2] turns</color>.
Damage dealt increases based on the number of <color=#28d9ed>Debuffs</color> on the target.
If the target is affected by <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color>, performs an additional attack with <color=#28d9ed>Execution of Discipline</color>.
Japanese:
スキル使用前、自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間UPし、対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせてから、敵にダメージを与える。
攻撃後, 対象の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>がDOWNしている場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>氷結</color>と<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
さらに、対象の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>が多いほどダメージがUPする。
対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color＞状態の場合、<color=#28d9ed>規律執行</color>で追加攻撃を与える。
China_Simplified:
在使用技能前，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，并降低目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1]</color>回合，然后攻击敌人。
攻击后，如果目标的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>已被降低，则有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color>概率使其陷入<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>与<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2]</color>回合。
目标身上的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>越多，造成的伤害越高。
若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，则追加发动<color=#28d9ed>规律执行</color>攻击。
China_Traditional:
在使用技能前，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提升，持續<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，並降低目標的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1]</color>回合，之後攻擊敵人。
攻擊後，若目標的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>已降低，則有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color>機率賦予其<color=#28d9ed>冰凍</color>與<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2]</color>回合。
目標身上的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>越多，造成的傷害越高。
若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態，則會追加使用<color=#28d9ed>規律執行</color>進行攻擊。

Korean:
항상 관통력이 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>, 치명 확률이 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가합니다

전투 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>지속 회복</color>을 부여합니다. (해제 불가)
턴 종료 시 적 팀의 CP를 <color=#28d9ed>25</color> 감소시킵니다.
English:
Always increases Penetration by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> and Critical Hit Chance by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.

Grants <color=#28d9ed>Continuous Recovery</color> for <color=#28d9ed>3 turns</color> at the start of battle (Irremovable).
Reduces enemy team's CP by <color=#28d9ed>25</color> at the end of the turn.
Japanese:
常時貫通力が<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>、会心率が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPする。

戦闘開始時、<color=#28d9ed>3ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>持続回復</color>を付与する。(解除不可)
ターン終了時、敵チームのCPを<color=#28d9ed>25</color>DOWNさせる。
China_Simplified:
穿透力始终提升<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，暴击率始终提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>

战斗开始时，赋予<color=#28d9ed>持续恢复</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>3回合</color>。(无法解除)
回合结束时，敌队CP减少<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。
China_Traditional:
貫穿力始終增加<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，暴擊率始終增加<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>

戰鬥開始時，賦予<color=#28d9ed>持續恢復</color>效果，持續<color=#28d9ed>3回合</color>。(無法解除)
回合結束時，敵隊CP減少<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。

与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPする。
ターン終了時、敵チームのCPを<color=#28d9ed>25</color>DOWNさせる。

穿透力始终提升<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>，暴击率始终提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>

伤害量提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
回合结束时，敌队CP减少<color=#28d9ed>25</color>。

傷害量增加<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과)\n전체 공격으로 입는 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color> 감소합니다.\n매 턴 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_35_1_6]</color> 증가합니다.(최대 20회 누적)
English: (Passive)\nDecreases damage taken from AOE attacks by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color>.\nIncreases Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_35_1_6]</color> every turn (Max 20 stacks).
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n全体攻撃から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color>DOWNする。\n毎ターンスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_35_1_6]</color>UPする。(最大20回累積)
China_Simplified: (被动效果)\n受到的全体攻击伤害量减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color>。\n每回合速度增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_35_1_6]</color>。(最多叠加20次)
China_Traditional: (被動效果)\n受到的全體攻擊傷害量減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color>。\n每回合速度增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_35_1_6]</color>。(最多累積20次)

English: (Passive) Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of <color=#28d9ed>Buffs</color> possessed.\n\n(Activation Effect) Uses <color=#28d9ed>Extra Attack</color> on all enemies when an enemy uses a non-attack skill.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果) 保有している<color=#28d9ed>強化</color>効果が多いほど、与えるダメージがUPする。\n\n(パッシブ効果) 敵が攻撃以外のスキル使用時、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>追加攻撃</color>を使用する。
China_Simplified: (被动效果) 持有的<color=#28d9ed>强化</color>效果越多，造成的伤害越高。\n\n(发动效果) 敌人使用非攻击技能时，对全体敌人发动<color=#28d9ed>额外攻击</color>。
China_Traditional: (被動效果) 持有的<color=#28d9ed>強化</color>效果越多，造成的傷害越高。\n\n(發動效果) 敵人使用非攻擊技能時，對全體敵人發動<color=#28d9ed>額外攻擊</color>。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)
자신이 전체 공격 피격시 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color> 를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52728]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
실드량은 시전자 체력에 기반합니다.
범위 공격으로 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color> 감소합니다.
English:
(Passive)
Grants <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52728] turn(s)</color> when hit by an AOE attack.
Barrier strength is based on the caster's HP.
Reduces damage taken from AOE attacks by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color>.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)
自分が全体攻撃を受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52728]ターン</color>の間付与する。
シールド量はスキル使用者のHPに基づく。
範囲攻撃から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color>DOWNする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果)
受到全体攻击时，获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_element_52728]回合</color>。
护盾量基于施展者的生命值。
受到的范围攻击伤害减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_28]</color>。

Korean: 스킬 사용 전 적 전체의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 감소시키고 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n강화 효과가 없는 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 부여합니다.

Korean:
적을 공격하고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_1_6]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.

공격 시 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>방어형</color>이 아니라면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다. (해제 불가)

대상 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>를 무시합니다.

Attacks an enemy and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_1_6] turns</color>.
Prioritizes attacking the <color=#28d9ed>leftmost</color> enemy.
If the target is not a <color=#28d9ed>Defender</color>, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>. (Irrmovable)
Ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target’s <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.

敵を攻撃し、対象に<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_1_6]ターン</color>付与する。
最も<color=#28d9ed>左側</color>にいる敵を優先して攻撃する。

対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>の<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>を無視する。

攻击时，若目标不是<color=#28d9ed>防御型</color>，自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。（不可解除）

攻擊敵人，並對目標施加<color=#28d9ed>灼燒</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_1_6]回合</color>。
優先攻擊<color=#28d9ed>最左側</color>的敵人。
攻擊時，若目標不是<color=#28d9ed>防禦型</color>，自身<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。（不可解除）
無視目標<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>的<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 보유한 대상에 대한 피해량이 증가합니다.

Attacks all enemies.

Inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_2_1_1] turns</color>.

Damage dealt to targets with <color=#28d9ed>Burneded</color> is increased.

敵全体にダメージを与える。

敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_2_1_1]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を付与する。

<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>状態の対象へのダメージがUPする。

对所有敌人施加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_2_1_1]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>灼烧</color>。

对持有<color=#28d9ed>灼烧</color>的目标造成的伤害提升。

攻擊全體敵人。

對所有敵人施加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_2_1_1]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>灼燒</color>。

적 전체를 공격합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>가 없는 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_3_2_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 보유한 대상에 대한 피해량이 증가합니다.

Attacks all enemies.

Targets without <color=#28d9ed>buff effects</color> are inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_3_2_1] turns</color>.

Damage dealt to targets afflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> is increased.

敵全体にダメージを与える。

<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がない対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500350_3_2_1]ターン</color>の間、<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を付与します。

<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>状態の対象へのダメージがUPします。

攻击全体敌人。

對處於<color=#28d9ed>灼燒</color>狀態的目標造成的傷害提高。

(패시브 효과)
<color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>가 없는 상태라면 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_2]</color> 감소하고, 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_1]</color> 감소합니다.
명속성 혹은 암속성 적의 행동 종료 시, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 모두 제거하고 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_3_3]</color> 증가합니다.
매 턴 시작 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>치명타 확률</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> 증가합니다. (최대 4회 누적)

보스가 입는 <color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
English:
(Passive)
If the caster has no <color=#28d9ed>Debuffs</color>, WG damage taken is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_2]</color> and damage taken is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_1]</color>.
When a Light or Dark enemy ends its action, removes all <color=#28d9ed>Debuffs</color> from the caster and increases the caster’s Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_3_3]</color>.
At the start of each turn, increases the caster’s <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>. (Stacks up to 4 times)

Japanese:
（パッシブ効果）
<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がない場合、受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_2]</color>と受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_1]</color>DOWNされる。
光属性または闇属性の敵の行動終了時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>をすべて解除し、行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_3_3]</color>UPする。
毎ターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>UPする。（最大4回累積）

ボスモンスターが受ける<color=#28d9ed>呪い/固定ダメージ</color>は<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>を超えない。
China_Simplified:
（被动效果）
若自身没有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，受到的WG伤害减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_2]</color>，受到的伤害减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_1]</color>。
光属性或暗属性敌人行动结束时，解除自身所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，并使自身行动条提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_3_3]</color>。
每回合开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>与<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。（最多叠加4次）

Boss所受到的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒/固定伤害</color>不会超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_3]</color>。
China_Traditional:
（被動效果）
若自身沒有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，受到的WG傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_2]</color>，受到的傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_1]</color>。
光屬性或暗屬性敵人行動結束時，解除自身所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，並使自身行動條提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500350_4_3_3]</color>。

Enters <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state every 4 turns.

China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n使目標的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>減少，持續<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>，並造成<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>황금의 저주</color> 상태로 만듭니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Golden Curse</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>黄金の呪い</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>黄金诅咒</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並對目標造成<color=#28d9ed>黃金詛咒</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

Korean:
(패시브 효과) 전투 시작 시 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.

대상에게 부여된 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>에 비례하여 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>씩 증가합니다.

약화 효과 보유 대상 행동 종료 시 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect) At the start of battle, decreases <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> of all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>3 turn(s)</color>.

Damage dealt increases by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> per <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color> on the target.

Increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> when a target with a debuff ends their action.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果) 戦闘開始時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>3ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。

対象に付与されている<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>1つにつき、ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>ずつUPする。

弱体効果を持つ対象の行動終了時、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>UPする。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果) 战斗开始时，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>3回合</color>。

根据目标附带的<color=#28d9ed>减益效果</color>数量，伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。

持有减益效果的目标行动结束时，<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果) 戰鬥開始時，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>減少，持續<color=#28d9ed>3回合</color>。

根據目標附帶的<color=#28d9ed>減益效果</color>數量，傷害增加<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。

持有減益效果的目標行動結束時，<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

Korean:
(패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>관통력 증가</color> 효과가 없는 대상에게 받는 최종 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>80%</color> 감소합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>치명 피해 증가</color> 효과가 없는 대상에게 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 감소합니다.

저주, 고정 피해로 받는 피해는 최대 <color=#28d9ed>10000</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
English:
(Passive Effect) Final damage received from targets without <color=#28d9ed>Penetration Increase</color> is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>80%</color>.

WG damage received from targets without <color=#28d9ed>Crit DMG Incr</color> is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>.

Damage received from Curse and Fixed Damage cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>10,000</color>.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>貫通力UP</color>効果がない対象から受ける最終ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>80%</color>減少する。

<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージUP</color>効果がない対象から受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>減少する。

呪い、固定ダメージで受けるダメージは最大<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>を超えない。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果) 受到未持有<color=#28d9ed>穿透力提升</color>效果的目标造成的最终伤害减少<color=#28d9ed>80%</color>。

受到未持有<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害提升</color>效果的目标造成的WG伤害减少<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。

因诅咒、固定伤害受到的伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果) 受到未持有<color=#28d9ed>穿透力增加</color>效果的目標造成的最終傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>80%</color>。

受到未持有<color=#28d9ed>暴擊傷害增加</color>效果的目標造成的WG傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。

因詛咒、固定傷害受到的傷害不超過<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>。

Korean:
4턴마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 적 전체를 공격합니다.
자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 필살기</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>모든 스킬</color>의 쿨타임이 초기화 됩니다.
English:
Enters <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> state every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enter Enrage</color>: Attacks all enemies.
Grants self irremovable Attack Increase/DMG Reduc effects for 3 turns and recovers WG by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]. Enrage lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Ultimate</color>: Used when Enrage ends.
Attacks all enemies and resets cooldowns of <color=#28d9ed>all skills</color>.
Japanese:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に移行する。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与える。
自分に解除不可の攻撃力UP/ダメージ減少効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]回復する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【必殺スキル】</color>：狂暴化終了時に使用。
敵全体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>すべてのスキル</color>のスキルターンが初期化される。
China_Simplified:
每4回合进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>进入狂暴化</color>：攻击全体敌人。
赋予自身无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并恢复WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化必杀技</color>：狂暴化结束时使用。
攻击全体敌人，并重置自身<color=#28d9ed>所有技能</color>的冷却时间。
China_Traditional:
每4回合進入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>狀態。

<color=#28d9ed>進入狂暴化</color>：攻擊全體敵人。
賦予自身無法解除的攻擊力增加/傷害減少效果，持續3回合，並恢復WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg1]。狂暴化持續3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化必殺技</color>：狂暴化結束時使用。
攻擊全體敵人，並重置自身<color=#28d9ed>所有技能</color>的冷卻時間。

English: Ultimate Guardian
Japanese: 究極の番人
