China_Traditional: 陰險的戰鬥方式

Korean: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_1_1]턴</color> 동안 획득합니다.\n실드량은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 높을수록 증가합니다.
English: Attacks the enemy and gains <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_1_1] turn(s)</color>.\nBarrier strength increases as own <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> increases.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_1_1]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を獲得する。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>が高いほどシールド量がUPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人并获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_1_1]回合</color>。\n护盾量随自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>的提升而增加。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人並獲得<color=#28d9ed>防護罩</color>，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_1_1]回合</color>。\n防護罩數值隨自身<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提高而增加。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n대상의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>, <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>, <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.\n공격 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nDecreases target’s <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter attacking, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n対象の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\n攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n使目标的<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>、<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻击后，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n使目標的<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>、<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>暴擊傷害</color>減少，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻擊後，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>。

Korean: 스킬 사용 전 적 전체의 강화 효과를 해제한 뒤, 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>, <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>, <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.\n공격 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: Before using the skill, removes Buff effects from all enemies, then attacks all enemies.\nIncreases own <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Critical Chance</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter attacking, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>.
Japanese: スキル使用前、敵全体の強化効果を解除した後、敵全体にダメージを与える。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>、<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。\n攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>UPさせる。
China_Simplified: 使用技能前解除全体敌人的强化效果，随后攻击全体敌人。\n使自身的<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>、<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>、<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻击后，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>。
China_Traditional: 使用技能前解除全體敵人的強化效果，隨後攻擊全體敵人。\n使自身的<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>、<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>、<color=#28d9ed>暴擊傷害</color>增加，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4500351_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻擊後，自身<color=#28d9ed>速攻值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_2_4]</color>。

Korean:
(패시브 효과)  <color=#28d9ed>재현: 용의 파동</color>으로 획득한 <color=#28d9ed>강화</color> 효과 개수에 비례하여 받는 피해가 최대 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> 까지 감소합니다.
보스가 입는 <color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4086007_4_28]</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태가 아니라면 받는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_4_3_1]</color> 감소합니다.
적 행동 종료 시 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>암속성</color> 이면 WG가 2 감소합니다.
English:
(Passive Effect) damage taken decreases by up to <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> in proportion to the number of <color=#28d9ed>Buff</color> effects obtained from <color=#28d9ed>Reproduction: Dragon’s Wave</color>.
Damage of <color=#28d9ed>Curse/Fixed Damage</color> taken by the boss does not exceed <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4086007_4_28]</color>.

If not in <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state, WG damage taken decreases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_4_3_1]</color>.
At the end of enemy action, if the target is <color=#28d9ed>Dark</color> attribute, WG decreases by 2.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>再現：竜の波動</color>で獲得した<color=#28d9ed>強化</color>効果の数に比例して、受けるダメージが最大<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>までDOWNする。
ボスが受ける<color=#28d9ed>呪い/固定ダメージ</color>は<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4086007_4_28]</color>を超えない。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態でない場合、受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_4_3_1]</color>DOWNする。
敵の行動終了時、対象が<color=#28d9ed>闇属性</color>であればWGが2減少する。
China_Simplified:
(被动效果) 根据<color=#28d9ed>再现：龙之波动</color>获得的<color=#28d9ed>强化</color>效果数量，受到的伤害最多降低<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>。
首领受到的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒/固定伤害</color>不超过<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4086007_4_28]</color>。

若不处于<color=#28d9ed>狂暴</color>状态，受到的WG伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_4_3_1]</color>。
敌方行动结束时，若目标为<color=#28d9ed>暗属性</color>，则WG减少2点。
China_Traditional:
(被動效果) 根據<color=#28d9ed>再現：龍之波動</color>獲得的<color=#28d9ed>強化</color>效果數量，受到的傷害最多減少<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>。
首領受到的<color=#28d9ed>詛咒/固定傷害</color>不會超過<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4086007_4_28]</color>。

若不處於<color=#28d9ed>狂暴</color>狀態，受到的WG傷害減少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500351_4_3_1]</color>。
敵方行動結束時，若目標為<color=#28d9ed>暗屬性</color>，則WG減少2。

Korean: (패시브 효과) 모든 공격은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>무시하고, <color=#28d9ed>재현: 용의 파동</color>으로 획득한 <color=#28d9ed>강화</color> 효과 개수에 비례하여 대상의 방어력을 추가로 최대 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.\n적 행동 종료 시 대상이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>약화</color> 효과 개수에 비례하여 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 최대 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가시킵니다.
English: (Passive Effect) All attacks ignore <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target’s Defense, and additionally ignore up to <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target’s Defense in proportion to the number of <color=#28d9ed>Buff</color> effects obtained from <color=#28d9ed>Reproduction: Dragon’s Wave</color>.\nAt the end of enemy action, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by up to <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> in proportion to the number of <color=#28d9ed>Debuff</color> effects the target has.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果) すべての攻撃は対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視し、<color=#28d9ed>再現：竜の波動</color>で獲得した<color=#28d9ed>強化</color>効果が多いほど、対象の防御力を追加で最大<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視する。\n敵の行動終了時、対象が保有する<color=#28d9ed>弱体</color>効果が多いほど、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を最大<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>UPさせる。

Japanese: (パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>【パンデモニウムのために!】</color>使用時、ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>为了潘德莫尼姆！</color>时，伤害提高<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>為了潘德莫尼姆！</color>時，傷害提高<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>마법형</color> 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect) Increases all <color=#28d9ed>Mage</color> allies' <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>がUPする。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）全体<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>友军的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>与<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提高。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）全體<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>友軍的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>與<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>提高。

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 보유 대상에 대한 아군 피해량이 증가합니다.
English: (Passive Effect) Increases ally damage dealt to targets inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>出血</color>がある対象に対する味方全体のダメージがUPする。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）对处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态的目标，友军造成的伤害提高。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）對處於<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>狀態的目標，友軍造成的傷害提高。

Korean: 적을 공격합니다.\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color> 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_1_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_1_2]턴</color> 동안  <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만듭니다.
English: Attacks an enemy.\nIf the target is <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color>, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_1_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_1_2] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>状態なら、<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_1_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_1_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击敌人。\n若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>感电</color>状态，则有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_1_2]</color>的概率使其<color=#28d9ed>眩晕</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_1_2]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人。\n若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>狀態，則有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_1_2]</color>的機率使其<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_1_2]回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n공격 후, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
English: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter attacking, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n攻撃後、自分の <color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]ターン</color>の間UPする。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人，并以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color>的概率赋予<color=#28d9ed>感电</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻击后，自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人，並以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_2_1]</color>的機率賦予<color=#28d9ed>感電</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_1]回合</color>。\n攻擊後，自身<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提升，持續<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_2_2]回合</color>。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n피해를 준 대상마다 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000052_3_2]</color> 증가하고\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color> 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_3_3]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 추가로 부여합니다.
English: Attacks all enemies.\nFor each target hit, increases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000052_3_2]</color>, and\nif the target is <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color>, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_3_3]</color> chance to inflict additional <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_3_3] turn(s)</color>.
Japanese: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\nダメージを与えた対象ごとに味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000052_3_2]</color>UPされ、\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>状態なら、さらに<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_3_3]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_3_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: 攻击全体敌人。\n每命中一个目标，全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000052_3_2]</color>。\n若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>感电</color>状态，则有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_3_3]</color>的概率额外赋予<color=#28d9ed>感电</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_3_3]回合</color>。
China_Traditional: 攻擊全體敵人。\n每命中一個目標，全體友軍的<color=#28d9ed>行動值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000052_3_2]</color>。\n若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>狀態，則有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000052_3_3]</color>的機率額外賦予<color=#28d9ed>感電</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000052_3_3]回合</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>에드온: 런쳐 스트라이크</color> 사용 시, 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color> 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만듭니다.
English: (Passive Effect) When using <color=#28d9ed>Add-on: Launcher Strike</color>, if the target is <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>【殲滅：エクスタミネーション】</color>使用時、対象が<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>状態の場合、\n<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>扩展：发射打击</color>时，若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>感电</color>状态，则使其<color=#28d9ed>眩晕</color><color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>擴展：發射打擊</color>時，若目標處於<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>狀態，則使其<color=#28d9ed>暈眩</color><color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과) 공격 시 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.
English: (Passive Effect) Ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> when attacking.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果) 攻撃時、対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）攻击时无视目标<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）攻擊時無視目標<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>。

English: (Passive Effect) As Health decreases, increases <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)残りHPが低いほど<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>がUPする。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）生命值越低，<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>越高。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）生命值越低，<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>越高。

Korean: (패시브 효과) 전체 공격 피격 시, 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 증가합니다.

Japanese: (パッシブ効果)全体攻撃を受けた場合、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>UPする。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）受到全体攻击时，自身行动值增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）受到全體攻擊時，自身行動值增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>나인 인치 네일스</color> 사용 시, 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color> 시킵니다.
English: (Passive Effect) When using <color=#28d9ed>Nine Inch Nails</color>, detonates all <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> effects on the target.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>【ナイン・インチ・ネイルズ】</color>使用時、対象の<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>をすべて<color=#28d9ed>破裂</color>させる。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>九寸钉</color>时，引爆目标身上的所有<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>九寸釘</color>時，引爆目標身上的所有<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果。

Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、自分以外の味方の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>UPさせる。(永続効果)
China_Simplified: （被动效果）回合开始时，使除自身外的友军<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>。（永久）
China_Traditional: （被動效果）回合開始時，使除自身外的友軍<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>。（永久）

Korean: (패시브 효과) 턴 시작 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> 증가시킵니다.(최대 20회 누적)
English: (Passive Effect) At the start of the turn, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>. (Max 20 stacks)
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>UPさせる。(最大20回まで累積)
China_Simplified: （被动效果）回合开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>。（最多叠加20次）
China_Traditional: （被動效果）回合開始時，自身<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>。（最多疊加20次）

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>용서받지 못할 죄인</color>사용 시 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.
English: (Passive Effect) When using <color=#28d9ed>Unforgivable Sinner</color>, ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n<color=#28d9ed>【許しがたき罪人】</color>使用時、対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視する。
China_Simplified: （被动效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>无法饶恕的罪人</color>时，无视目标<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。
China_Traditional: （被動效果）使用<color=#28d9ed>無法饒恕的罪人</color>時，無視目標<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防禦力</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>초패왕폭룡유성흑염권</color> 사용 시 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color>동안 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color> 상태로 만듭니다\n이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.
English: (Passive Effect) When using <color=#28d9ed>Conquering Dragon Meteor Fist</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color>.\nThis effect ignores the target's Resilience.
Japanese: (パッシブ効果)\n<color=#28d9ed>【超覇王暴竜流星黒炎拳】</color>使用時、対象に<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。\nこの効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。

Korean: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_420]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_420]</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 획득합니다.\n이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.

Japanese: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_event_monster_buff_420]</color>の<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_420]ターン</color>の間獲得する。\nこのスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。

Korean:

공격형 : 방어력 감소 3턴
마법형 : 효과 적중 감소 3턴
방어형 : 공격력 감소 3턴
속도형 : 속도 감소 3턴
회복형 : 스턴 2턴
모든 효과는 해제 불가입니다.
English:
(Passive Effect) Depending on the class not present among enemies, inflicts the following effects on all enemies.

Striker: Decreased Defense for 3 turns
Mage: Decreased Effectiveness for 3 turns
Defender: Decreased Attack for 3 turns
Ranger: Decreased Speed for 3 turns
Healer: Stunned for 2 turns
All effects are Irremovable.
Japanese:
(パッシブ効果)敵にはないクラスによって敵全体に以下の効果を与える。

攻击型：防御力降低3回合
魔法型：效果命中降低3回合
防御型：攻击力降低3回合
速度型：速度降低3回合
恢复型：眩晕2回合
所有效果不可解除。
China_Traditional:
（被動效果）根據敵方未包含的職業，對全體敵人賦予以下效果：

魔法型：效果命中降低3回合
防禦型：攻擊力降低3回合
速度型：速度降低3回合
恢復型：暈眩2回合
所有效果不可解除。

(Ignores Immunity and Resilience)\nWhen critically hit, decreases all enemies' <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color>.\nDamage taken from <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> increases by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>.

China_Traditional: （被動效果）戰鬥開始時，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>暴擊率</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>10回合</color>。（無視免疫與效果抵抗）\n受到暴擊時，使全體敵人的<color=#28d9ed>攻擊力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。\n受到<color=#28d9ed>詛咒</color>的傷害提高<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。

Korean: (패시브 효과) 적 처치 시 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> 증가합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 보유한 적에게 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 증가합니다.

Korean: 적을 공격하고 자신의 행동 게이지를 [Buff_V_2000102_1_1] 증가시킵니다. [Buff_C_2000102_1_2] 확률로 적 대상의 속도가 [Buff_T_2000102_1_2]턴 동안 감소합니다.

China_Traditional: 攻擊敵人，並使自身行動值增加[Buff_V_2000102_1_1]。有[Buff_C_2000102_1_2]的機率使目標速度降低，持續[Buff_T_2000102_1_2]回合。

Korean: (패시브 효과) 자신이 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color> 감소 상태가 아니라면 모든 공격이 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>마법형</color>으로 부터 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52751]</color> 만큼 감소하고 <color=#28d9ed>공격형</color>으로 부터 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52752]</color> 만큼 증가합니다.

Japanese: (パッシブ効果)自分に<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>DOWN効果がない場合、全ての攻撃が対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視する。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>魔法型</color>から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52751]</color>DOWNされ、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃型</color>から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52752]</color>UPする。

Korean: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 보유한 대상에게 피격 시 받는 피해와 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>마법형</color>으로 부터 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52751]</color> 만큼 감소하고 <color=#28d9ed>공격형</color>으로 부터 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_element_52752]</color> 만큼 증가합니다.
